jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Sincelaunchingour ad-supported tier in 2022, the momentum has been unstoppable—we reach over94 millionglobal monthly active users! As we enter ourfourth year, our ambition is massive, and we are just getting started.

About The Team

The Live Ad Insertions team sits at the intersection of broadcast engineering, streaming infrastructure, and digital advertising. Our mission is to deliver a seamless, high-reliability ad insertion experience across live and linear streams, from primetime tentpole events like the NFL and live sports to 24/7 linear feeds and breaking news. We own the full stack of tools, systems, and operational infrastructure required to trigger, stitch, monitor, and verify ad breaks in real time at scale, without compromising the member experience.

Live advertising is one of the highest-stakes, highest-reward surfaces in CTV. When tens of millions of concurrent viewers are watching a single event, there are no second chances. A break happens once, in real time, and the window to act is measured in seconds. That demands more than reliable systems: it demands proactive observability tooling that can detect anomalies before they surface to members, and the ability to make real-time corrections mid-event when something does go wrong. This team operates with the precision of a broadcast NOC and the velocity of a software startup. We are responsible for the technology that turns a live signal into a monetized ad experience, at scale, millisecond by millisecond.

As an Engineering Manager, You Will

Lead a team of engineers building the real-time infrastructure, tooling, and operational systems for live ad insertion across server-side, client-side, and server-guided delivery models.

  • Own the reliability and operational excellence of ad insertion during 24/7 linear streams and high-stakes live events, including NFL games, live sports, and awards shows.

  • Define the technical roadmap for live ad insertion, including SCTE signal ingestion and validation, ad pod management, manifest stitching, slate handling, and ad decisioning integration.

  • Partner with ad operations, broadcast engineering, content delivery, and ad serving teams to ensure seamless signal-to-slot execution from ingest to client playback.

  • Drive hiring, retention, and development of a high-performing engineering team capable of operating in a demanding live environment.

  • Establish the on-call and incident response culture for live ad systems, setting SLAs and runbooks for break-glass scenarios during high-profile live events.

  • Contextualize your team's larger advertising strategy and translate business priorities into a technically sound, executable plan.

  • Serve as the technical authority in cross-functional discussions on live ad capabilities, representing the team to leadership, partners, and vendors.

Skills and Experience We Are Seeking

Technical Skills & Domain Expertise

  • Streaming Pipelines & Architecture:Deep hands-on experience with live streaming pipelines (from ingest protocols like RTMP, SRT, or TS through to CDN) and ad insertion architectures, including SSAI, CSAI, and SGAI (HLS interstitials/DASH).

  • Broadcast Standards & Splicing:Expertise in broadcast signaling (SCTE-35, SCTE-104, SCTE-224) and manifest manipulation for ad stitching, alongside familiarity with master control and linear playout systems.

  • Ad Pod Construction & Encoding:Advanced knowledge of managing live break constraints, including slate/fallback handling, break reconciliation, and encoding constraints (codec/bitrate matching, frame rate alignment) to prevent playback artifacts.

  • Ad Tech Decisioning:Strong understanding of ad servers, DSPs, and VAST 4.x/VMAP in live contexts, with a focus on managing strict decisioning latency budgets, timeout handling, tracking event firing, and mitigating the cascading effects of decision failures.

  • Operational Tooling:Proven track record of engineering for high-availability, zero-downtime live events, including building operational tooling for ad ops (e.g., real-time fill rate tracking, signal health visualization, and break monitoring workflows).

Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • 10+ years of total engineering experience with 3+ years managing software engineering teams in a live media, streaming, or ad tech context.

  • Effective communicator across both technical and business stakeholders, including ad sales, ad operations, broadcast engineering, and executive leadership.

  • Experience collaborating with content and distribution partners, including MVPDs, vMVPDs, and broadcast networks, on joint live ad insertion implementations.

jobs.excerpt: Unlock Your Potential at Eaton: Where Diversity Drives Innovation.
jobs.description:
Unlock Your Potential at Eaton: Where Diversity Drives Innovation.

At Eaton, we believe diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds drive innovation and success. We're committed to empowering people and creating a brighter, more sustainable future.

Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is one of the company's fastest-growing and most strategic businesses, helping power the digital economy. As cloud computing, AI, and high-density compute environments continue to accelerate, data centers face increasing demands for performance, resiliency, sustainability, and speed-to-market. Leveraging a broad portfolio of power, cooling, software, services, and infrastructure solutions, Eaton helps customers deploy scalable, integrated data center architectures that meet today's needs while preparing for the future.

Position Summary

Eaton is seeking a Senior Systems Architect – IT Module to join the Data Center Architecture Team.

This senior technical leadership role will define and drive the architecture of the data center IT Module (white space), including high-density power distribution, cooling integration, rack infrastructure, modular deployment strategies, and pod-level system design. The position serves as the primary systems integrator across white space components, ensuring scalable, repeatable, and optimized designs that enable rapid deployment of compute capacity for hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and next-generation AI data centers.

As a key member of the Data Center Architecture Team, you will help develop end-to-end reference architectures and collaborate directly with customers to shape future data center solutions.

What you’ll do:

Be knowledgeable of current trends and innovate the market.
Identify and build positive relationships with all account decision-makers and influencers who impact current or future business with Eaton.
Gain an in-depth understanding of the client development and buying process and be able to articulate it effectively.
Perform VoC by understanding and capturing clients' challenges and requirements and resolve them by co-designing to help evolving Eaton's portfolio.
Ensure an effective handover to Global Product Lines and Business Units so that they develop the right portfolio to respond to large customers’ requirements. Support the application engineers in charge of key accounts in implementing your designs for specific customers.
Maintain oversight of all advanced engineering-related engagements to ensure customer success and satisfaction, as well as Eaton's performance as a vendor.
Be highly knowledgeable about the client's business, commercial condition, structure, strategy, operations, and challenges. Articulate this knowledge in terms of opportunity, growth, and risk with respect to Eaton's business.
Be highly knowledgeable about Eaton's products, services, general business, structure, strategy, and operations. Articulate this knowledge in terms of value to the client's business.
Act as an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits of supporting your proposed architecture within the Eaton organization.
Act as an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits of supporting Eaton within the client engineering organization.
Collaborate effectively with other sales and stakeholders at the function, country, region, and global levels. Provide and gain support so others can meet their responsibilities to the account.
Provide all internal stakeholders and functional departments with the account-specific guidance and insights required to execute their roles and add value to the client.
Build a multi-lane bridge between Eaton and the client organization. This may include GPL leaders, Engineering leaders, Product line managers, BU Engineers, BDM, Marketing, PMO, Services, Sales Operations & Order Management, Supply Chain, Leadership & Executive Management.
Work with the Segment Marketing team to create white papers and other technical material to promote our designs and value proposition.

Qualifications:

Leadership & experience: 15+ years in critical power system design and electrical distribution engineering (advanced degree strongly preferred).

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent recognized qualification
Minimum of 10 years of related experience in the data center business across core domains of whitespace, cooling, power, fiber, controls, and rack systems

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters degree in engineering or technical discipline

Skills:

Has led multiple complex programs delivering medium- and low-voltage power architectures for large data centers or similar mission-critical facilities, spanning from medium-voltage (e.g. 15–35 kV) substation design to high-current low-voltage and ~1500 V direct-current systems. Experience includes end-to-end oversight from conceptual architecture through deployment, with a record of on-time, reliable power system commissioning at multi-megawatt scale.
Technical expertise: Expert in power conversion architectures for data centers, including MV AC distribution, LV AC, and high-voltage DC networks. Mastery of protective coordination, converter and switchgear integration, busway and panelboard systems, large-scale UPS and energy storage, and DC power protection schemes. Keeps abreast of emerging 380 → 800 V DC standards and cutting-edge power electronics (e.g. new 800 VDC components) and is a recognized innovator (patents or contributions to industry standards such as OCP open DC architectures or IEC committees on data center power).
Systems & architecture skills: Thinks at system level beyond the white space – ensures the IT Module design aligns with upstream power (Block 2) and facility cooling systems (Block 4) for a cohesive data center architecture. Provides direction across multiple product and engineering teams (racks, busbars, cooling, monitoring, etc.) to develop standardized, integrated solutions. Mentors multi-disciplinary engineers and champions a shift from traditional, labor-intensive buildouts to automated, modular deployment approaches that improve speed-to-market and reliability.
Leadership & communication: Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive leadership and initiative, with experience guiding cross-functional teams or projects. Demonstrated mentoring ability and influence in a matrixed organization, helping train and direct other engineers.
Customer focus: Strong customer engagement skills – experience interacting with enterprise or hyperscale data center customers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that address their challenges. Ability to incorporate Voice of Customer feedback into technical designs and roadmaps.

Technical knowledge in data centers design and construction, specifically POD-level architecture and modular design, high-density compute environments (AI/ML workloads) and/or liquid cooling architectures
Project Management Experience: Experience with Product Design or Product Management with a working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Waterfall. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite is required
Specialized Industry Knowledge: Ability to create customized data center physical layer solutions tailored to various data center subsegments, including (but not limited to) Hyperscale, liquid cooling, and the modular edge
DMAIC experience for process improvement and drive for excellence
Experience delivering POD-level architecture and modular design
High-density compute environments (AI/ML workloads) and cross-domain system integration (cooling, power, structural)
Proven ability to author whitepapers and thought leadership and lead system-level design trade-off discussions
To perform effectively, the individual shall maintain sufficient market and competitor intelligence, understand client and market primary trends and requirements and how competition addresses them and how Eaton uniquely and preferentially meets them
Highly proficient at consultative selling and at communicating Eaton's differentiated value at company, product, and service levels. Additionally, function in a research and development function
Strong customer-facing technical engagement experience

What will make you successful:

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience leading large-scale, mission-critical power architectures from concept through deployment.
  • Technical;
    • Medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution
    • UPS systems
    • Energy storage
    • Power electronics
    • AC and DC power architectures
    • Protective coordination
    • Switchgear and busway systems
  • Knowledge of emerging high-voltage DC architectures and future power distribution technologies.

Leadership & Influence

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive, engineering, and operational audiences.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in matrixed organizations.
  • Demonstrated success mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction.

Customer-Focused Innovation

  • Strong customer-facing experience working with enterprise or hyperscale data center operators.
  • Ability to incorporate customer requirements into product roadmaps and solution architectures.
  • Proven ability to develop white papers, technical publications, and thought leadership content.

Continuous Improvement

  • Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, or DMAIC methodologies.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and traditional project management methodologies.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

jobs.excerpt: “Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!
jobs.description:
“Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!”

WHO ARE WE?

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based out of San Antonio, TX, but are truly a remote and telecommuting company.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The Product Lead Engineer serves as the technical authority across multiple Agile scrum teams inside a vertical product. While this role carries no personnel management responsibilities, the Product Lead Engineer has the highest technical voice within the team — setting direction, making implementation calls, and ensuring the team delivers reliable, well-engineered software. Beyond their own contributions, their output raises the technical capability of everyone around them.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

1.Technical Team Leadership

  • Serve as the technical authority within the development teams, making implementation decisions, resolving technical disagreements, and ensuring the team operates to a consistently high engineering standard.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex features across backend, frontend, and mobile platforms — from design through deployment and monitoring — while actively guiding teammates through their portions of the work.
  • Decompose ambiguous requirements into well-scoped tasks for the team, and proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks.
  • Regularly and actively contribute production code — this is a player-coach role. The Product Lead Engineer is expected to be a consistent, high-quality committer and to model the engineering standards to which the rest of the organization is held.

2.Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews that improve quality and accelerate the growth of junior engineers.
  • Mentor Software Engineers through pairing, design discussions, and regular technical guidance.
  • Drive best practices for testing, branching, documentation, and security within the team.

3.Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements, estimate accurately, and deliver reliable features on schedule.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively about technical risks, progress, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

4.Technical Ownership & Cross-Training

  • Take primary ownership of one or more significant product areas — maintaining deep expertise in their architecture, behavior, and failure modes, and serving as the authoritative resource for decisions and issues in those areas.
  • Proactively lead knowledge transfer of your owned areas to teammates, ensuring the team can operate effectively without you and no single engineer becomes a bottleneck.
  • Actively participate in cross-training led by others, developing meaningful familiarity with product areas outside your primary ownership to strengthen overall team resilience.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

Technical Quality

  • Code, designs, and architectural decisions within the domain consistently meet peer review standards without significant rework.
  • Technical debt and reliability risks in areas of ownership trend downward over time.

Delivery & Reliability

  • Complex features are delivered on schedule with accurate estimation; risks are surfaced early with proposed mitigations.
  • Production incidents in areas of ownership are resolved rapidly with durable root cause fixes.

Organizational Impact

  • Software Engineers who regularly work with this role demonstrably improve in code quality and technical judgment.
  • Technical recommendations are trusted by peers and leads without requiring repeated validation.

Leadership & Communication

  • Ambiguous requirements are clarified and decomposed without waiting for direction.
  • Feedback given in code reviews and design discussions is specific, actionable, and consistently improves the work.

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including production SaaS environments.
  • Deep proficiency in PHP and JavaScript/React, including design patterns, performance, and security best practices.
  • Strong command of relational database design, SQL optimization, and data modeling (MySQL/MariaDB).
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and upskill less experienced engineers.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tooling and workflows.

WHAT SETS YOU APART?

  • 7+ years of professional software development with full-stack ownership in a cloud environment.
  • Experience with cloud architecture on AWS (IaaS/PaaS) including serverless and managed databases.
  • Experience with React Native for cross-platform mobile development.
  • Working knowledge of security benchmarks: OWASP, CIS, SOC2.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience working in regulated environments with compliance requirements (HIPAA, HITECH, PCI DSS, or similar).

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The company sponsors health insurance, long-term disability, and life insurance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • 10 paid Holidays.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Work Anniversary Bonus.
  • Participation in the Employee of the Quarter Program.
  • Monthly $100 Connectivity Stipend Reimbursement.
  • RealTime matches employee 401K contributions at 100% of the first 3% invested and 50% of the next 2% invested.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Milestone is an innovator in post-settlement solutions, providing technology-enabled administration services to law firms managing complex mass tort settlements. Through its proprietary Pathway® platform, Milestone has transformed post-settlement distribution by delivering a more efficient, transparent, and data-driven process for managing claims administration and settlement disbursement.

Position Description:

Support the day-to-day operations of Milestone's Probate Department by partnering with the Managing Attorney to ensure the efficient administration of probate matters, coordinate with external legal partners, and promote operational excellence across the department. Serve as a key legal resource by overseeing local counsel relationships, supporting team coordination, monitoring case progress, and helping drive the successful execution of departmental priorities.

Essential Duties & Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with the Managing Attorney to support the day-to-day operations and overall effectiveness of the Probate Department.
  • Provide operational oversight and guidance to probate team members, supporting efficient workflows, collaboration, and timely case progression.
  • Coordinate team workloads and case assignments to help ensure deadlines, quality standards, and departmental objectives are achieved.
  • Review probate matters for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable laws, court requirements, settlement agreements, and internal policies.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for probate and bankruptcy counsel across multiple jurisdictions, fostering strong working relationships and effective communication.
  • Coordinate the assignment of probate matters to external counsel and monitor case activity to promote timely, high-quality legal services.
  • Monitor the performance and responsiveness of third-party probate counsel, identifying trends, opportunities for improvement, and operational concerns.
  • Collaborate with the Managing Attorney on probate strategies, legal issue resolution, and departmental initiatives.
  • Review project and case status reports to identify workflow bottlenecks, improve operational efficiency, and support continuous process improvement.
  • Prepare operational reports, case updates, and departmental metrics for leadership.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to support probate-related initiatives and ensure seamless case administration.
  • Assist with the development, implementation, and refinement of departmental procedures, workflows, and training materials.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound legal judgment when handling sensitive claimant and estate information.
  • Respond promptly to internal and external communications while effectively managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Perform additional legal and operational responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Active license to practice law and member of a state bar in good standing.
  • Two (2) to four (4) years of experience practicing probate law.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, supervising, or mentoring legal professionals or support staff.
  • Strong knowledge of probate procedures, estate administration, and court processes across multiple jurisdictions preferred.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and team workloads in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in Mass Tort Law preferred.

The employee frequently views a computer monitor and frequently uses a computer keyboard. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee is regularly required to be mobile, and the employee occasionally travels both short and long distances via a variety of conveyances.

At NVIDIA, we address some of the world’s most exciting challenges with our unique approach to accelerated computing. As a Senior Quantum Algorithm Researcher you will help grow the adoption of our products and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to drive innovation at the intersection of quantum computing applications and AI. Your work will contribute to NVIDIA quantum product in key areas such as AI methods for quantum algorithm discovery, advanced quantum simulations, and digital twins.

NVIDIA’s Quantum group is a small, high-impact team visible both internally within NVIDIA and externally across the global quantum community. We’re looking for passionate quantum algorithm researchers who want to help define the future of the field. Do you have deep technical expertise in quantum algorithms and applications, and a drive to push the boundaries of technology? If yes, we’d love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Establish and lead technical collaborations with supercomputing centers (SCCs) on hybrid quantum-classical application development across multiple industry verticals.

  • Spearhead research pathfinding in AI for quantum algorithms.

  • Guide all aspects of and drive the execution of technical results for projects in collaboration with our strategic partnerships, including SCCs, leading QPU builders, and needle-moving researchers, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and customer success.

  • Contribute to NVIDIA’s revenue stream through strategic technical engagement and the development of innovative solutions that support customer adoption and long-term partnerships.

  • Publish impactful research works and represent NVIDIA at relevant scientific, technical, and industry conferences.

What We Need To See:

  • Ph .D. in Quantum Computing, Physics, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience) with over 5+ years of experience working on Quantum Algorithms and Applications.

  • Deep insider knowledge of, and strong connections within, the Singapore quantum ecosystem.

  • Demonstrated leadership in technical collaborations with industry partners. Excellent programming skills in Python, C++, and a parallel programming model (e.g., CUDA).

  • World-class communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to articulate a value proposition to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A track record of research excellence demonstrated in publications and presentations at leading conferences.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Recognized thought-leadership in the cross section of quantum applied research and high-performance computing.

  • Experience with the NVIDIA Quantum platform (cuQuantum and CUDA-Q)!

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Generalist Embodied Agent Research - PhD New College Grad 20
jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA is searching for an outstanding research scientist to build humanoid robot foundation models and systems in the Generalist Embodied Agent Research (GEAR) group.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is searching for an outstanding research scientist to build humanoid robot foundation models and systems in the Generalist Embodied Agent Research (GEAR) group. Everything that moves will eventually be autonomous. Our mission is to build general-purpose embodied agents that learn to explore and master complex skills across the virtual and the physical world.

You will work with an amazing and collaborative research team that consistently produces influential works on multimodal foundation models, large-scale robot learning, game AI, and physical simulation. Our past projects includeEureka,VIMA,Voyager,MineDojo,MimicPlay,Prismer, and more. One of our team’s most recent milestones includes Project GR00T, a foundation model for humanoid robots. Your contributions will have a significant impact on our moonshot research projects and product roadmaps.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design and implement novel AI algorithms and models for general-purpose humanoid robots and embodied agents;

  • Develop large-scale AI training and inference methods for foundation models;

  • Optimize and deploy AI models in physical simulation and on robot hardware;

  • Collaborate with research and engineering teams across all of NVIDIA to transfer research to products and services.

What we need to see:

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, etc., or equivalent research experience.

  • Outstanding engineering skills in rapid prototyping and model training frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, Tensorflow, etc.). Python or C++ is required; CUDA or ROS proficiencies are a plus;

  • Excellent knowledge and hands-on experience for training LLMs, multimodal foundation models, or large generative models.

  • Experience in foundation and diffusion models, reinforcement learning, agent learning, and applied robotics

  • Experience across one or both of these fields:

Multimodal Foundation Models

  • Hands-on training experience and publications in at least one of the following topics: LLMs; Large vision-language models; Video generative models and diffusion algorithms; Action-based transformers.

  • Excellent skills in working with large-scale machine learning/AI systems and compute infrastructure.

Robotics

  • Hands-on training experience and publications in robot learning, such as reinforcement learning, imitation learning, classical control methods, etc.

  • Deep understanding of robot kinematics, dynamics, and sensors;

  • Ability to safely operate robot hardware, lab equipment, and tools;

  • Knowledge of control methods, including PID, model predictive control, and whole-body control;

  • Familiarity with physics simulation frameworks such as MuJoCo and Isaac Sim;

  • Robot hardware design and hands-on building experience.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and productive people in the world. Please join us and be part of the forefront of developing general-purpose robots and embodied agents!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 264,500 USD for Level 3, and 192,000 USD - 304,750 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until January 13, 2026.

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA is the world leader in accelerated computing.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is the world leader in accelerated computing. Our innovations in GPU technology, AI, and data center solutions are transforming industries worldwide. Join our engineering group passionate about local product development in Israel to play a meaningful role in bringing powerful hardware products from building to mass production.

The Local Product Engineering (LPE) group bridges the gap between hardware build, NPI phase and high-volume manufacturing. We work closely with contract manufacturers (CMs) globally to ensure mechanical readiness, production quality, and manufacturing excellence across NVIDIA’s networking product portfolio. We are looking for a Mechanical Product Engineer to own the mechanical aspects of production test fixtures, jigs, and enclosures. This role leads upkeep and adjustment oversight across CM sites. It supports NPI mechanical readiness and brings a strong manufacturing perspective into hardware development reviews.

What you'll be doing:

  • Fixture & Jig Support — Maintenance, and continuous improvement of production testing setups, jigs, mechanical enclosures, and assembly tooling. Ensure compatibility, standardization, and seamless integration of jigs across multiple product lines and CM sites.

  • Maintenance & Calibration Governance — Own and enforce maintenance/calibration processes across all products and contract manufacturing locations. Author process documentation. Lead quarterly maintenance audits at CM facilities. Drive calibration frequency reduction initiatives.

  • Equipment Limit Management — Perform data-driven analysis of test equipment limits (mating cycles, cable wear). Recommend and approve limit extensions based on engineering data and risk assessment.

  • NPI Mechanical Support — Escort new products through mechanical readiness achievements — from prototype through V&V station approval to large-scale manufacturing. Support station duplication and mechanical training for CM technicians.

  • Cross-Site CM Coordination — Provide hands-on technical support to global CMs (Flex Israel, Jabil India, Foxconn Vietnam). Resolve mechanical gaps, fixture issues, and production blockers in real-time.

  • Quality Audits & Compliance — Conduct structured quality audits at manufacturing sites focused on mechanical processes, fixture condition, and maintenance compliance. Drive corrective actions.

  • Participate in KO, PDR, CDR sessions passionate about hardware build, contributing insights from production and manufacturing perspectives. Identify potential mechanical issues early in the design cycle.

  • ECO Management — Review and process Engineering Change Orders related to fixtures, mechanical assemblies, and production tooling. Ensure documentation and version control via Agile/PDP.

What we need to see:

  • B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

  • 3+ years of experience working as a mechanical engineer in a production/manufacturing environment

  • Hands-on experience with fixture and jig design for electronics manufacturing or test

  • Strong ability to read, interpret, and review mechanical drawings and assembly drawings.

  • Proficiency in 3D CAD tools (Creo Parametric / SolidWorks / similar)

  • Knowledge of maintenance and calibration processes in high-volume manufacturing

  • Experience working alongside contract manufacturers or EMS providers

  • Strong analytical skills — data-driven limit analysis and evaluation of potential hazards

  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience in the semiconductor or data center hardware industry

  • Familiarity with Agile PLM / PDP systems for ECO and BOM management

  • Background in V&V (Validation & Verification) environments

  • Experience conducting supplier/manufacturing audits

  • Knowledge of thermal management and thermal pad/TIM applications

jobs.title: Senior GPU Raytracing Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a self‑motivated senior engineer for the Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin team.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a self‑motivated senior engineer for the Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin team. This hire will lead the design and implementation of a real‑time, GPU‑accelerated propagation engine that predicts how radio signals travel through realistic 3‑D environments — producing both per‑link channel characterisations and radio maps at the speed required by production RAN stacks! This position offers the opportunity to work on foundational technology for 5G and 6G network simulation, using NVIDIA's world‑class GPU and ray‑tracing platforms.

What you'll be doing:

As a member of NVIDIA's Aerial team, you will architect and implement a GPU ray‑tracing engine that operates at two time scales. At the planning scale, the engine produces volumetric radio maps — coverage, SINR, and best‑server maps at multiple resolutions, composable across cells, frequencies, and beam configurations — that network operators use to design and optimise deployments. At the real‑time scale, the same engine delivers per‑link multipath channel updates at the millisecond cadence that a production RAN stack requires, using adaptive algorithms that exploit temporal coherence to avoid recomputing what hasn't changed. Laying the foundations for real‑time ray tracing on GPU hardware — algorithms, data structures, and multi‑GPU scaling strategies that make sub‑millisecond propagation updates feasible — is the defining technical challenge of this role.

What we need to see:

  • PhD in computer graphics, high‑performance computing, computational electromagnetics, or a closely related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of relevant experience.

  • Hands‑on proficiency with CUDA and at least one GPU ray‑tracing framework (OptiX, Vulkan RT, Embree), with a track record of writing production‑quality GPU code.

  • Proficiency in GPU‑friendly spatial data structures (BVH, space‑filling curves, hash maps) and the ability to reason about memory hierarchy, occupancy, and compute‑vs‑bandwidth trade‑offs at the kernel level.

  • Working knowledge of electromagnetic wave propagation phenomena (reflection, transmission, diffraction, scattering) sufficient to implement and validate a propagation engine.

  • Impactful publications in GPU ray tracing, real‑time rendering, or deterministic propagation modelling.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with real‑time or near‑real‑time ray‑tracing engines shipping in production systems.

  • Prior work on multi‑GPU partitioning for ray‑tracing or large‑scale simulation workloads.

  • Familiarity with 3GPP channel models and wireless network planning tools.

  • Knowledge of geospatial coordinate systems and tiling schemes.

jobs.excerpt: EdOps School Finance Specialist The school finance specialist position is ideal for an individual looking to apply accounting, finance, business, and analytical skills to the social sector.
jobs.description:
EdOps School Finance Specialist

The school finance specialist position is ideal for an individual looking to apply accounting, finance, business, and analytical skills to the social sector. You will have the opportunity to support schools with their day-to-day operations as well as help drive strategic decisions with data-driven insights.

Reports to a Finance Team Manager. Location flexible.

Who we are:

EdOps is a B-Corp which partners with schools to provide expert support in finance, accounting, and student data management, helping education leaders make informed decisions while minimizing the financial, operational, and compliance burdens of running a school. Simply put, we make it easier for school leaders to increase student achievement. Our experience working with a wide range of schools – from newly authorized charter schools to independent schools with century-long histories, and from microschools to multi-campus networks – allows us to provide high-quality finance, accounting, and student data support across diverse educational environments.

Our team of over 100 professionals currently serves over 100 independent and public charter schools and networks across D.C., Louisiana, Maryland, Missouri, Michigan, New Jersey, and New York. We are serious about being the best possible partners to schools, and it shows in our 93% annual client retention rate. We work hard at being a rewarding, enjoyable workplace where staff can grow professionally and make an impact. We are looking for education focused, accounting and finance loving, collaborative people to join our team.

What you will do:

  • Serve as an outsourced accountant and financial advisor for a portfolio of schools
  • Oversee all day-to-day full-cycle accounting and compliance aspects of the schools, including accounts payable, payroll, grants administration, and regulatory compliance.
  • Close the books monthly/quarterly/annually and prepare monthly financial statements.
  • Project manage schools’ annual fiscal audit, completing necessary end of year statements and schedules, serve as schools' primary contact during field work and assist with 990 preparation
  • Analyze, model, and solve problems on a wide range of business issues.
  • Liaise with the state education authority (SEA), and the charter authorizer as relevant.
  • Partner with EdOps School Finance Manager to provide high quality customer service.
  • Invest in other members of the EdOps team, supporting their efforts and demonstrating a desire to contribute to the growth of the internal team.

What you will accomplish:

  • By Year 1 you will:
    • Solve small, real problems for schools on a daily basis.
    • Learn the accounting and finance cycle of school finance
    • Learn the ins-and-outs of annual school fiscal compliance reporting
    • Work with several schools in different stages of growth and with different academic models.
    • Own the day-to-day financial and monthly accounting close process for multiple schools.
    • Independently manage the annual financial cycle for a portfolio of schools.
    • Serve as an integral part of several internal teams demonstrating a strong desire to help.
  • By Year 2 you will:
    • Continue to solve small and real problems for schools every day.
    • Refine skills learned in year 1 resulting in independent and proficient completion of cyclical compliance reporting and annual fiscal audit.
    • Develop deep expertise in charter school accounting and financial compliance reporting.
    • Potential to develop a specialization (e.g. facilities finance, quality assurance, regional expertise, etc.) that supports the broader team.

Who you are:

  • Find joy in solving accounting and financial problems for individual schools. The little things make schools actually work.
  • Care about education and outcomes for students as much as you care about well-designed accounting processes.
  • Able to zoom in and out between high level strategic perspective and detailed, daily accounting and financial work.
  • Desire to be involved in the accounting and financial processes from input to analysis. Strong in independent problem solving. We are a very collaborative community that supports each other, but our specialists solve new problems every day.
  • Energized by being in a customer service role, as we are here first and foremost to serve our school clients.
  • Know schools and how they work .
  • Committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Open to learning and growing in these areas together so that each of us can contribute to building a culture of equity and support our schools in advancing these values. Please see more on EdOps's commitment here.

What you need:

  • Strong organization and time management skills. There is a lot going on here.
  • Intermediate Excel knowledge, such as formulas like vlookups and sumifs, because Excel will be your best friend in your everyday accounting and financial work.
  • Direct work experience and/or degree in finance or accounting or related field.
  • Strong quantitative analysis, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, as every school is different, and approaches and solutions often have to be customized.
  • Ability to collaborate with people at every level of an organization with a strong desire to help others do their best work.
  • Strong client communication and interpersonal skills, including presenting and explaining info (both verbally and in writing) to people with varying financial literacy. In one day, you might email a school business manager about reclassifying expenses and answer an auditor’s technical accounting question.
  • Experience with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Intacct or Blackbaud
  • General comfort with technology systems (e.g., Google suite, financial systems) because we are not big fans of paper at EdOps.
  • Work experience: typically, Finance Specialists have 5-8 years of work or post-secondary educational experience.

What you get:

  • Purpose driven work focusing on student achievement through operational excellence. That is what it is all about.
  • An opportunity to work every day with colleagues who are committed to kids and supportive of each other’s efforts….and
  • EdOps salaries are commensurate with relative experience and geographic location. The range for the School Finance Specialist position is $64,931-$89,605/year.
  • Check out other perks of working at EdOps here. And some details on benefits here.

We know that a team from a wide range of backgrounds with different life experiences, identities, opinions, and talents makes us better able to innovate and deliver on our mission of supporting schools to improve student outcomes. Every day we work to build an inclusive company culture where everyone can be themselves at work and do their best work.

Apply:

If you are passionate about our mission, skilled in your field, ready to learn, and looking for a place where you can be yourself, we want to hear from you! To apply, please complete our application

What you can expect from the hiring process:

Salary: $66,717 – $92,069 / year

  • Optional moonlighting during off-weeks — read when you want, no obligation

  • Our state-of-the-art IT infrastructure ensures efficiency and seamless collaboration across the practice:
  • Unified PACS platform connecting all RAF sites with a smart, subspecialty-aware worklist
  • Built-in communication tools for easy case sharing, consultations, and real-time support
  • 24/7 access to radiology assistants and dedicated IT support
  • Advanced AI-powered tools, including:
    • Automatic detection of urgent findings (e.g., intracranial hemorrhage, fractures, pulmonary embolism)
    • AI-assisted searches for evidence-based guidelines and decision support
    • Generative AI integrated into PowerScribe for automatic, personalized impression generation

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW

RAF is a leading radiology practice in Florida. We serve the most prestigious, established health systems in the state, including on the east and west coasts, the Florida Panhandle, and the Keys. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibility in study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at the cutting edge, encouraging subspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, and facilitating collaboration and consultation between our radiologists. Our state-of-the-art IT suite includes universal PACS across the practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders. We are the teaching physicians for the University of South Florida Department of Radiology in Tampa. In Sarasota, our physicians’ staff the Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists work and socialize together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to know us better!

Get to know our practice! www.radflorida.com.

  • Board eligible or board certified by the American Board of Radiology (ABR) or American Osteopathic Board of Radiology (AOBR)

  • Medical license or eligibility to obtain licensure in the state of Florida

POSITION SUMMARY

Radiology Associates of Florida (RAF) seeks aremote, full-time evening neuroradiologist to staff the evening shift (3 pm - 11 pm EST) at Tampa General Hospital in an academic role. This position is 7 on/7 off with a 100% focused neuro case mix. In Tampa, we serve a growing health care system that is a stroke center of excellence and collaborate with our other RAF divisions around the state to offer candidates an optimal study mix. We perform a full breadth of neuroradiology examinations, including in the domains of trauma, stroke (including CT perfusion with RAPID software), oncology, dementia, movement disorders, and functional MRI.

We are affiliated with the University of South Florida. We have eight residents per year and one neuroradiology fellow. Our ideal candidate has an interest in teaching neuroradiology, particularly to the fellow. This position offers the opportunity for faculty appointment. Dedicated didactic lectures are not required but are welcome.

We have a team-based style of practice, and our next neuroradiologist will be able to collaborate with an experienced team of subspecialists.

We offer an internal moonlighting program with unmatched flexibility, allowing radiologists to moonlight from home as much or as little as they prefer, without having to commit to extra shifts.

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW

RAF is the largest radiology practice in Florida. We serve the most prestigious, established health systems in the state, including on the east and west coasts, the Florida Panhandle, and the Keys. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibility in study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at the cutting edge, encouraging subspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, and facilitating collaboration and consultation between our radiologists.

Our state-of-the-art IT suite includes universal PACS across the practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders. We are the teaching physicians for the University of South Florida Department of Radiology in Tampa. In Sarasota, our physicians staff the Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists works and socializes together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to know us better!

Get to know our practice!

In Tampa, discover blue skies and sunshine, a sparkling waterfront, world-class chefs, and family fun! There is beautiful weather year-round, with average highs of 82 degrees and average lows of 65 degrees. Florida has no state income tax, estate tax, or inheritance tax.

See where we work and play!

jobs.description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Benefícios de trabalhar na Stefanini:

  • Ambiente inclusivo: A Stefanini Group é comprometida em promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e respeitoso, onde todas as pessoas têm oportunidades iguais de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Oportunidades de carreira: Oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento contínuos. Na Stefanini Group, você terá a chance de evoluir profissionalmente e alcançar seus objetivos.
  • Ambiente colaborativo: Valorizamos a colaboração e o trabalho em equipe. Nossos colaboradores têm a oportunidade de participar de projetos desafiadores e inovadores, trabalhando lado a lado com profissionais talentosos e experientes.
  • Reconhecimento e valorização: Acreditamos que o reconhecimento é fundamental para o engajamento e a motivação dos colaboradores. Na Stefanini Group, seu trabalho será reconhecido e valorizado, através de programas de premiação e incentivos.
  • Benefícios abrangentes: Além de um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, oferecemos uma ampla gama de benefícios para todos os nossos colaboradores.

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Operations Specialist to join our growing Operations team. This role is critical in ensuring smooth and efficient management of our operational workflows — from onboarding and contract management to bordereaux processing and reporting. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments, is data-driven, and brings a passion for process improvement and collaboration across teams.

Key Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Manage operational workflows across onboarding, policy administration, and bordereaux lifecycle stages to ensure data completeness, timeliness, and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Data, Underwriting, Compliance, Finance) to maintain integrity across systems and processes.
  • Support the centralization of master/reference data, ensuring consistent and auditable records across all operational systems.
  • Monitor and report KPIs such as submission cycle time, processing duration, and SLA adherence.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, reduce manual touchpoints, and enhance the member experience.
  • Partner with internal teams to define and document standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Leverage tools like Snowflake, Power BI, and Excel to create reports and insights that inform business decisions.
  • Assist in onboarding new members and contracts, ensuring all documentation, systems, and workflows are aligned before activation.

Bonus Points For

Accelerant Holdings is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Rather than functioning as a traditional marketing manager, you'll act as a strategic growth partner responsible for building scalable marketing systems, translating complex scientific concepts into compelling commercial narratives, and driving marketing performance from end to end.

Accountability

Your success as the Head of Marketing will be defined by your ability to build a scalable marketing engine, generate qualified pipeline, and establish marketing as a key driver of commercial growth. Here's how you'll make an impact:

Marketing Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the company's end-to-end marketing strategy across brand, demand generation, and commercial growth.
  • Build a scalable marketing engine that supports long-term business objectives.
  • Define positioning and messaging for highly technical pharmaceutical products.
  • Translate complex scientific concepts into compelling, commercially relevant narratives.
  • Continuously refine the company's value proposition based on customer insights and market feedback.

Brand & Positioning

  • Own the company's brand identity, messaging architecture, and positioning strategy.
  • Ensure consistency across the website, presentations, sales collateral, campaigns, and digital channels.
  • Develop messaging tailored to biotech and pharmaceutical audiences.
  • Balance scientific credibility with clear, engaging commercial storytelling.

Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Partner with external design and development agencies to improve website performance.
  • Optimize messaging, user experience, and conversion pathways.
  • Run A/B tests and landing page experiments to improve conversion rates.
  • Identify friction points throughout the customer journey and implement data-driven improvements.

Demand Generation

  • Build scalable inbound and outbound marketing campaigns that generate qualified opportunities.
  • Develop LinkedIn thought leadership and content strategies.
  • Create email nurture sequences and outbound marketing initiatives.
  • Support Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs targeting strategic prospects.

Agency & Vendor Management

  • Manage relationships with external agencies, freelancers, and marketing partners.
  • Develop creative briefs and project requirements.
  • Ensure high-quality execution, accountability, and timely delivery.

Sales Enablement & Marketing Operations

  • Partner closely with the Chief Commercial Officer and founders to support commercial initiatives.
  • Develop sales presentations, case studies, marketing collateral, and customer-facing assets.
  • Translate customer feedback into marketing improvements.
  • Strengthen alignment between Sales and Marketing through scalable processes and enablement resources.

Marketing Analytics & AI Operations

  • Build dashboards, attribution models, and marketing reporting frameworks.
  • Measure marketing effectiveness through qualified pipeline, conversion, and ROI metrics.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve productivity, streamline execution, and optimize workflows.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies that enhance marketing performance.

Colleagues

You'll work closely with the founders, Chief Commercial Officer, external agencies, sales stakeholders, and cross-functional teams, acting as the strategic marketing leader responsible for driving brand growth, demand generation, and commercial success.

At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans Talent, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity across the business. As the Head of Marketing, your vertical focus will be on marketing strategy, demand generation, and brand leadership, while your horizontal focus will include analytics, sales enablement, AI-powered marketing operations, and commercial growth.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience leading B2B marketing initiatives within high-growth startups or fast-paced technology environments.
  • Marketing Leadership: Demonstrated experience developing marketing strategy, building demand generation programs, and owning marketing outcomes from planning through execution.
  • Brand & Messaging: Strong ability to position complex technical products, develop compelling messaging, and communicate effectively with sophisticated B2B audiences.
  • Demand Generation: Experience driving inbound and outbound marketing campaigns, lead generation initiatives, and Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs.
  • Website & Conversion Optimization: Proven success improving website performance, conversion rates, user journeys, and marketing funnel effectiveness.
  • Marketing Analytics: Strong analytical capabilities with experience building dashboards, attribution models, and KPI frameworks to guide marketing decisions.
  • Agency & Stakeholder Management: Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, and cross-functional stakeholders while maintaining high execution standards.
  • AI Fluency: Strong familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms, with experience integrating AI into marketing workflows and productivity.
  • Industry Experience: Experience in Pharma, Biotech, Healthcare Technology, Deep Tech, CDMO, CRO, or other highly technical B2B industries is strongly preferred.

During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Marketing Strategy & Growth: How you develop scalable marketing strategies that drive commercial growth.
  • Brand Positioning & Messaging: How you translate complex technical concepts into compelling customer value propositions.
  • Demand Generation & Conversion Optimization: How you build campaigns, optimize funnels, and generate qualified pipelines.
  • Marketing Analytics & Performance: How you use data, attribution, and experimentation to improve marketing effectiveness.
  • AI-Enabled Marketing Operations: How you leverage AI to improve execution, automate workflows, and increase productivity.
  • Leadership & Ownership: How you independently drive marketing initiatives, manage stakeholders, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

jobs.description:
Genpact (NYSE: G) is a global professional services and solutions firm delivering outcomes that shape the future. Our 125,000+ people across 30+ countries are driven by our innate curiosity, entrepreneurial agility, and desire to create lasting value for clients. Powered by our purpose – the relentless pursuit of a world that works better for people – we serve and transform leading enterprises, including the Fortune Global 500, with our deep business and industry knowledge, digital operations services, and expertise in data, technology, and AI.

Thispostis for a position within the Experience unit at Genpact(FormerlyRightpoint).Experience is Genpact’s capability for designing and improving the platforms, interactions and journeys employees and customers use every day. With deep expertise across leading platforms like Adobe, Microsoft, Sitecore, and Optimizely, we unite strategy, human-centered design, engineering and AI inside core enterprisesystems,so experiences don’t just look better, they perform better, drive adoption and turn advanced technology into measurable business outcomes at scale.

The Agentic Workspace Solution Director is the strategic leader and senior subject matter expert for Genpact's Agentic Workspace solution. You will support the vision, intellectual property, and go-to-market for how we help enterprise clients reimagine the modern workplace through agentic AI — building, configuring, and demonstrating solutions on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, and Microsoft Foundry, while remaining fluent across the broader agentic ecosystem (Adobe, Opal (Gemini), Anthropic, and beyond).

You will lead Genpact's proprietary IP in this space, Agentic Experience suite, and our Digital Workspace IP Spark Workspace and Spark Connect. You will partner with sales to run demos and hands-on configuration sessions, shape multi-platform proposals, and guide our internal teams in solutioning. Success in this role is measured by growth in Agentic Workspace pipeline and wins, the maturity and adoption of our IP, and the enablement of teams to deliver client outcomes that increase employee productivity and unlock new ways of working.

What You Will be Doing:

Solution Development & Sales Enablement

Define tailored Agentic Workspace solutions combining Microsoft technologies and translate technical capabilities into executive-friendly value stories with clear linkage to productivity gains, cost takeout, and revenue enablement.
  • (Required) Microsoft Platform Mastery:Serve as Genpact's senior solution SME for the Microsoft agentic stack. Maintain deep, current expertise in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. Maintain a deep understanding of Microsoft's agentic roadmap (new releases, private previews, partner programs) and translate that into opportunities for our clients.
  • (Bonus) Multi-Vendor Agentic Fluency:Bring credible, hands-on experience across the broader agentic ecosystem including Adobe, OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic. Advise clients on when to lead with Microsoft, when to compose across vendors, and how to make pragmatic build/buy/compose decisions. Use this fluency to design heterogeneous agent architectures and to position Genpact as a platform-agnostic transformation partner.
  • Sales Demos & Live Configuration:Act as the lead solution architect in the sales cycle for Agentic Workspace opportunities. Run high-impact, customer-facing demos and live configuration sessions. Showcase Agentic Experience suite, Spark Workspace and Spark Connect scenarios in front of client audiences. Drive discovery workshops, craft compelling proposals and RFP responses, scope effort, and coordinate with engineering to validatefeasibility (scope, timeline, budget). Your goal is to increase win rate by delivering proposals that are both visionary and credible.

IP Ownership, Go-to-Market & Thought Leadership

  • Agentic Experience Suite IP Leader:Own the roadmap, productization, and evolution of Genpact's Agentic Experience suite. Define the offers, reference architectures, accelerators, and demo assets that make up the suite. Prioritize investment based on client demand and competitive differentiation; and ensure each component has clear value propositions, pricing, and delivery playbooks. Partner with Delivery and Engineering to harden field-built solutions into reusable IP and retire or refactor assets as the agentic landscape evolves.
  • Digital Workspace IP Leader (Spark Workspace & Spark Connect):Serve as the senior product owner forGenpact Experience's Digital Workspace IP, including Spark Workspace and Spark Connect. Set the vision and feature roadmap, drive design and engineering priorities, oversee productization and packaging, and ensure tight alignment with the Microsoft platform stack and the broader Agentic Experience suite.
  • Thought Leadership:Be a recognized thought leader internally and externally for Agentic Workspace. Author whitepapers, blog posts, and whitepapers; speak at industry events, Microsoft partner forums, and client roundtables; and contribute to Genpact's brand as a leading agentic systems integrator.
  • Change Management for Agentic Adoption:Recognize that introducing agents into the workplace is a change management challenge as much as a technology one. Advise clients on agent governance, role design, training, and adoption and bake these into the solution so that Agentic Transformation is sustainable, responsible, and measurable.

Success Metrics / KPIs

  • Solution win ratein deals supported (e.g., percentage of proposals with this architect’s designs that convert to project wins), indicating ability to craft compelling, value-aligned architectures.
  • Quality of architecture in delivery: measured by post-implementation results such as performance benchmarks, scalability (can the platform handle expected load), and low incidence of architecture-related issues or rework during build.
  • Client satisfaction and business outcomesattributable to architecture: e.g., a client’s improved site performance or quicker content deployment times due to the designed solution (mapping back to KPIs the architect aimed to achieve).
  • Reusability of designs / accelerators: number of times architecture templates or components (developed under the architect’s guidance) are reused across projects, indicating creation of scalable best practices.
  • Continuous learning: staying certified/up-to-date– for example, maintaining relevant certs and attending partner training; success can be partially measured by completing new certifications or contributing to thought leadership (blogs, tech talks) on multi-platformsolutions.

What We’d Like to See:

  • 10+ years in technical architectureroles for digital workspace and employee experience platforms, including substantial hands-on experience withMicrosoft products(M365, Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint) in complex enterprise implementations.
  • Microsoft Agentic Platform Mastery:Deep expertise across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, and Azure AI Foundry, with working knowledge ofPower Platform, SAM, Entra, and Purview as they relate to agent governance.Hands-on experience building and configuring agents is required.
  • Customer-Facing Sales & Solution Strength:10+ years in solution consulting, pre-sales, or digital strategy, including a strong track record of leading executive sales demos and hands-on configuration sessions for enterprise audiences. Proven ability to shape and win large, multi-million-dollar digital transformation programs from discovery through proposal and SOW.
  • IP Ownership Experience:Demonstrated experience owning and evolving productized IP including roadmap definition, packaging, GTM enablement, and field adoption. You understand the difference between a one-off solution and a repeatable asset, and you can build the latter.
  • Digital Workspace Domain Depth:Strong understanding of the modern digital workplace; intranets, employee portals, knowledge management, frontline tooling, and the Microsoft 365 collaboration stack.
  • AI and Digital Innovation Mindset:Demonstrated enthusiasm for and fluency in agentic AI, automation, and emerging tech. You can envision "what's next" for clients and incorporate that into solution plans, positioning Genpact as an innovator.
  • Collaboration & Leadership:Team-oriented leader who thrives in a matrixed consulting environment. Able to lead cross-functional solution teams without formal authority (strategists, UX, engineers, and partner alliance colleagues) toward a unified proposal. Agency or consulting experience strongly preferred.
  • Self-Starter with Organizational Savvy:Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You manage your own time and priorities across multiple pursuits, develop new ideas with minimal guidance, and exercise sound judgment on when to involve others.

Why Genpact Experience?

  • Be a transformation leader and work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation
  • Make an impact by driving change for global enterprises and solving business challenges that matter
  • Thrive in a values-driven culture
  • Flexible PTO – If you need a day off or an extended vacation, take the time! (US Only)

  • Great insurance coverage (Multiple Options) and flexible spending accounts
  • 401K with Company Matching

Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion: We care about making Genpact Experience a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization to bring about meaningful and measurable changes to representation, team member experience, and client engagement. Our Employee Resource Groups (ERG) are created and run by team members who share a common community, identity, or allyship. These groups play a vital role in contributing to Genpact Experience’s inclusive environment where all are valued and empowered to succeed

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
