jobs.description:
The Global Process Owner (GPO) – Opportunity to Cash (O2C) is responsible for setting the strategy, governing, and continuously improving the end-to-end Opportunity to Cash process. The role is accountable to lead and drive transformation through standardization, simplification and automation across the entire process while ensuring operational excellence, cost efficiency, and process compliance. This role is a key member the Global Business Services Leadership Teams, and leads a cross-functional governance team with key Commercial Leaders that align on priorities, resolves process issues, limit customizations while ensuring appropriate risk and compliance. The O2C GPO is embedded into key business decisions and is accountable for translating the cross-functional strategy into a consistent, executable plan for the organization.

Strategy

  • Define and drive the long-term vision for the Opportunity to Cash process, ensuring alignment with enterprise goals and cross-functional stakeholders including Commercial Excellence, Country Group Leaders, Finance, IT, Supply Chain, Procurement and Legal.
  • Develop and maintain a global transformation roadmap focused on digital enablement, process standardization, and innovation, while influencing company priorities and investment decisions.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs to measure end-to-end performance, ensuring alignment with business strategy and continuous improvement goals.
  • Own global Opportunity to Cash policies and controls, ensuring clarity, consistency, and compliance with governance, regulatory standards, and industry best practices.
  • Promote policy adoption and compliance through effective governance, communication, training, and change management.
  • Utilize robust reporting, analytics, and governance practices to provide actionable insights that enhance visibility, support decisions, and ensure compliance throughout the O2C process.

Continuous Improvement

  • Lead global initiatives to eliminate inefficiencies and optimize the Opportunity to Cash process through innovation, stakeholder collaboration, and agile execution.
  • Use data analytics, process tools, and performance benchmarks to identify opportunities and drive measurable process improvements.
  • Implement improvement efforts across regions and functions, embedding a culture of continuous learning and adaptability as solutions are deployed.
  • Benchmark internal performance against industry standards and best practices to identify gaps and improvement areas.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure consistent, high-quality execution of the Opportunity to Cash process across geographies and delivery locations through standardized policies, processes, and systems.
  • Oversee third-party managed service providers Opportunity to Cash execution including but not limited to Customer Service Operations, Credit, Cash, & Collections Management, managing SLAs, KPIs, and governance to ensure accountability, performance, and alignment with internal standards.
  • Collaborate with Treasury to deliver clear, timely insights into cash performance, implementing process and policy improvements to accelerate cash flow and improve DSO.
  • Drive optimization of CRM capabilities and ensure seamless, high‑performing integration across CRM, ERP, workflow automation, and telephony platforms to enable an efficient, data‑driven Opportunity‑to‑Cash process.
  • Lead continuous improvement in banking platform connectivity and cash application automation, ensuring strong internal controls, data accuracy, and visibility into incoming payments and customer accounts.
  • Ensure aggressive but realistic productivity targets are set and achieved annually.
  • Implement automation and digital solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and enable standardization.
  • Support change management initiatives to embed operational excellence principles across the organization.

People Leadership & Development

  • Lead and develop a global team of process and subject matter experts and change agents, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture.
  • Direct strategic oversight and support of the process and subject matter experts managing external service partnerships.
  • Build organizational capability through mentoring, training, and career development, while championing change management to support adoption of new processes and technologies.
  • Recognize and reward contributions that drive excellence and transformation across the Opportunity to Cash process in alignment with the Power of Glass drivers and behaviors.

Personal Development

  • Conduct other duties as assigned which could include process design effort oversight and project leadership and support.
  • Set and pursue individual development goals aligned with organizational priorities and future career aspirations.
  • Foster a growth mindset by regularly soliciting feedback and applying learnings to improve performance and leadership impact.
  • Stay current with industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging innovations to inform strategic decision-making.

Please submit your resume in English.

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in business or related field
  • Senior process expert with strong business acumen and ability to lead through influence
  • 7+ years of experience working in a GBS/multi-functional shared services environment, including but not limited to; Master Data Management, Opportunity to Cash, Commercial Support, Record to Report
  • Demonstrated highly effective experience partnering with various cross functional teams including stakeholders from Commercial, Country Group Leadership, Finance, Treasury, IT, Procurement, HR, Audit, and external Managed Service Providers working with global processes and systems
  • Dynamic leadership abilities to adapt quickly and lead through change
  • Experience working in Global Opportunity to Cash processes leading internal and external GBS Teams is highly desired
  • Excellent financial acumen and understanding of the P&L and working capital
  • Takes initiative to drive results and quickly assimilates new information, tools, and processes to stay ahead of evolving business needs.
  • Experience with implementing Global processes and usage of SAP, C4C CRM, credit management solutions, and customer service telephony platforms
  • Working knowledge of SOX and internal controls, including policies and procedures ensuring a strong Control Environment
  • Experience in different innovative technologies like RPA, AI, Machine Learning, and business query & analytics tools is highly desired
  • Ability to identify and drive transformation efforts through direct and indirect influence.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills and strong ability to lead change management efforts for new system implementations
  • Ability to lead global process development while ensuring local compliance
  • Provide leadership to process design and subject matter experts as well as Managed Services team
  • Strong communication, change management and influence skills to move toward consensus at all levels of an organization
  • Excellent analytical abilities

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, including people with disabilities.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

Position reports to VP, Global Business Service and has 4 subject matter process expert direct reports and a team of 70 Managed Services members.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

O-I is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact O-I at and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

To be the leading producer of glass bottles and jars worldwide you need passion, commitment and innovation baked into the very fabric of a business and its people. For more than 120 years, our glass makers have honed their craft - channeling their creativity into more than 1,800 patents held today. When you join O-I you become part of that story.

O-I has more than a century of experience crafting pure, sustainable, brand-building glass packaging for many of the world’s best-known food and beverage brands. We are proud to provide high quality glass packaging for beer, wine, spirits, food, non-alcoholic beverages, cosmetics and pharmaceuticals. We are dedicated to make what matters to shape a healthier, more sustainable and more exciting world. We transform the industry to make glass more relevant and more accessible to more people.

With nearly 19,000 employees and an unparalleled footprint spanning almost 64 plants in 18 countries, O-I is a truly global maker of glass packaging.

jobs.excerpt: About MarcoPolo LearningMarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education.
jobs.description:
About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app andThe PolosTV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.

Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale — and we’re looking for a Financial Controller who thrives in a fast-scaling, international SaaS environment.

Role Overview

Marco Polo Learning is building a self-purchase, subscription website and end-to-end buying experience for individual customers (a "bottom-up" growth motion, distinct from our top-down sales team). We're looking for someone who sits between product design and marketing: someone who can design the look, flow, and feel of the purchase experience, and who deeply understands how subscription businesses are built and activated — pricing and packaging, onboarding and activation sequences, trial-to-paid conversion, and retention. Implementation support (website build, integrations) is available via AI tools and an engineering partner — this role is not being hired primarily for coding ability. It is being hired for the combination of design judgment and subscription marketing/business judgment: what the funnel should look like, say, and do at each step, and why.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design the self-purchase subscription experience: landing pages, sign-up, trial, and checkout — the layout, flow, and presentation of pricing/packaging.
  • Design the activation and onboarding sequence: what a new user sees, is told, and is prompted to do after signing up, so they reach their first "aha" moment and convert to paid.
  • Own the copy and messaging strategy across the funnel (emails, in-app messaging, landing pages) — writing it or directing whoever does.
  • Partner with an engineering/automation resource and/or AI tools to get the designed funnel actually built and wired up — this role directs and reviews the build, it does not need to personally code it.
  • Bring a proven subscription business background — pricing, activation, churn, and growth-loop thinking — so we are not starting from zero on funnel strategy or design.
  • Define what to test (design variations, pricing, onboarding steps, messaging) and read the results to keep improving conversion and activation.
  • Track and report on subscription funnel metrics: sign-ups, activation rate, trial-to-paid conversion, and early retention.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not primarily an engineering or coding role — implementation support is available via AI tools and an engineering partner; this hire is for the design and marketing/business thinking behind the funnel.
  • Not a purely visual/UI design role — this role needs design paired with subscription business and marketing judgment, not visual design alone.
  • Not a pure automations/ops role — this hire owns funnel design and marketing strategy and directs engineering/AI resources for execution rather than building or automating internal systems.

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing and/or growing a subscription or self-serve SaaS/consumer product — you can point to a funnel or subscription business you designed, built, or materially improved.
  • Product design skills — able to design clean, conversion-minded web and email experiences (wireframes/mockups at minimum), not just direct a designer.
  • Strong grasp of subscription business fundamentals: activation, trial-to-paid conversion, churn/retention, pricing and packaging.
  • Hands-on growth marketing experience: email/lifecycle marketing, landing page strategy, basic analytics and experimentation.
  • Comfortable directing a technical build (via AI tools or a partner engineer) even if not writing the code personally — enough fluency to know what's possible and review the output.
  • Strong written English for copywriting and stakeholder communication with a US-based team.
  • Self-directed: able to ask the right questions, propose a plan, and execute with minimal day-to-day oversight.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in EdTech or a subscription product sold to consumers/parents.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, N8N, ClickUp, or similar tools already in use at Marco Polo.
  • Enough technical/no-code fluency (Webflow, AI website builders) to prototype ideas quickly, even if the final build is handed off for implementation.

Engagement Details

Location: India-based (remote)

Engagement type: Contract to start, with potential to expand

Reports to: Founder / Leadership team

Works closely with: An engineering/automation team member who supports the technical build

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a Technical Project Manager with deep Splunk expertise to lead and deliver enterprise-scale Splunk and observability initiatives.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Technical Project Manager with deep Splunk expertise to lead and deliver enterprise-scale Splunk and observability initiatives. This role requires a strong blend of project management discipline and hands-on technical knowledge to successfully drive complex Splunk deployments, enhancements, and migrations.

The ideal candidate understands the Splunk ecosystem end-to-end and can effectively manage cross-functional teams while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of Splunk-related projects, including implementations, upgrades, migrations, and optimization initiatives
  • Define project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Manage project plans, track progress, and ensure adherence to schedules
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers, and proactively drive resolution
  • Provide regular status reporting to stakeholders and leadership

Splunk Technical Oversight

  • Serve as the technical liaison for Splunk architecture, data onboarding, and platform enhancements
  • Collaborate with engineers to design and implement scalable Splunk solutions (indexers, search heads, forwarders)
  • Oversee data ingestion pipelines, parsing, and normalization strategies
  • Ensure best practices are followed for performance, scalability, and security
  • Validate technical deliverables and ensure alignment with requirements

Stakeholder & Team Coordination

  • Coordinate across engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams
  • Translate business requirements into actionable technical plans
  • Facilitate meetings, workshops, and technical discussions
  • Manage vendor relationships and external partners as needed

Governance & Process

  • Establish and enforce project governance, standards, and documentation
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements
  • Support Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies as appropriate

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Splunk Enterprise and/or Splunk Cloud (REQUIRED)
  • Deep understanding of:
    • Splunk architecture (indexers, search heads, forwarders)
    • Data onboarding, parsing (props/transforms), and SPL
    • Observability, logging, and/or SIEM use cases
  • Proven experience managing complex, enterprise-level Splunk projects
  • Strong ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Splunk certifications (e.g., Splunk Core Certified Power User, Admin, or Architect)
  • Experience with tools like Cribl, Kafka, or other data pipeline technologies
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Experience in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government)
  • PMP, Scrum Master, or similar project management certification

What Success Looks Like

  • Projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality
  • Splunk environments are scalable, efficient, and aligned with business needs
  • Stakeholders are informed, aligned, and confident in delivery progress
  • Risks are identified early and managed effectively

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position description

The Pharmacy and Consumer Wellness Operations Analytics team is helping lead the effort to transform healthcare and drive improved consumer experience by partnering with key business areas across CVS Health to deliver impactful analytic solutions and insights. As a member of this team within Analytics & Behavior Change (A&BC) Data Science team, you will be at the forefront of delivering high visibility analytic projects for key CVS Retail strategic priorities. Specifically, you will have the opportunity to drive revenue and profitability in CVS Health’s Retail Pharmacy business with end-to-end analytical solutions. You will have the chance to solve complex problems, build predictive models and simulate impact of business decisions to improve profitability.

We are a fast-paced team focused on building innovative analytic solutions using advanced analytics and cloud capabilities. Within our team, we believe a cutting-edge analytics product can only be delivered if every aspect of the solution from data to model to front end UI is fully designed and developed by SMEs within the team. As a Decision Scientist, you will be part of a team driving pharmacy contracting and profitability analytics. You will be working with stakeholders and team members to identify/refine problem statement, develop options to provide analytics solutions, determine methodology to quantify the impact and develop impactful visualizations/presentations to tell the story. We are looking for talented individuals who have a strong sense of teamwork, accountability, and a desire to deliver high quality end to end intuitive and impactful analytic products using advanced data driven approaches.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and present meaningful and insights-driven materials on analytical results with recommendations and go forward planning to guide a variety of audiences including internal stakeholders and senior leadership
  • Act as the point of contact for stakeholders across multiple projects to understand strategic business analytics requirements, create document and communicate project status
  • Leverage AI tools and techniques that yield solutions to maximize productivity and profitability
  • Partner with data scientists and data engineers to define a solution approach and make recommendations.
  • Performs analyses of structured and unstructured data to solve complex business problems
  • Use data visualization techniques to effectively communicate analytical results and support business decisions.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in industry
  • 3+ years of experience programming in SQL and Python
  • 3+ years of data visualization platforms (Power BI, Tableau etc.) with experience developing POCs as well as end-to-end product implementations
  • 1+ years implementing AI based solutions for analytics and business intelligence use cases
  • Expertise in providing strategy and thought leadership around problem statement identification and analytical approaches
  • Proficiency in understanding semantic models, data models, and ability to analyze large datasets in cloud platforms
  • Strong knowledge of the underlying mathematical and statistical principles that are foundational to data science
  • Strong project management, organizational skills & Strong presentation skills with the ability to present findings and influence others as well as expertise in the use of PowerPoint
  • Experience and familiarity with cloud computing like Snowflake Azure, & GCP

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial analytics
  • Demonstrates strong ability to communicate technical concepts and implications to business partners
  • AI Savvy
  • Anticipates and prevents problems and roadblocks before they occur
  • Strong knowledge of advanced analytics tools and languages to analyze large data sets from multiple data sources
  • Demonstrates proficiency in most areas of mathematical analysis methods, machine learning, statistical analyses, and predictive modeling and in-depth specialization in some areas

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering) with 4–7+ years of relevant experience,
    OR
  • Master’s degree or equivalent in an analytic discipline with 2+ years of relevant experience.

Job Title: Global Regulatory Affairs Director - Inflammation and Rare Disease

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Regulatory Affairs Director - Inflammation and Rare Disease

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. Amgen is seeking a Regulatory Affairs Director supporting products in the Inflammation and Rare Disease Therapeutic Area. Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) provides global regulatory leadership, expertise, and execution for the development, registration, and life cycle management of all Amgen molecules.

In this vital, product-facing role you will lead the Global Regulatory Team (GRT) in the Regulatory Affairs organization. The role of the Regulatory Affairs Director is to lead GRTs within Amgen’s GRAAS organization, develop a comprehensive regulatory strategy that takes into account worldwide regulatory requirements to drive product development, global registration, achievement and maintenance of desired regional labeling, and effective regulatory agency interactions, and to provide regulatory expertise and guidance to product teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the global regulatory product strategy
  • Lead GRTs
  • Represent Regulatory on the product team and other key commercialization governance bodies
  • Develop Global Regulatory Strategic Plan and provide regulatory input into the product’s Global Strategic Plan. Obtain input from the GRT members to develop a global regulatory strategy which supports product development, registration and lifecycle maintenance. Identify and communicate regulatory risks
  • Represent GRA on the product team
  • Develop registration strategies and plans aimed at achieving regulatory approval and product labeling
  • Provide regulatory direction in the development of the core data sheet to align commercial objectives in the context of available and expected scientific data, regulatory guidance and precedent
  • Lead the planning and implementation of global regulatory filings (e.g. clinical trial applications, marketing applications, label extensions, CMC changes)
  • Ensure consistency of evidence-based global product communication (e.g. regulatory submission documents)
  • Monitor and assess impact of relevant global regulations, guidance, and current regulatory environment
  • Ensure guidance on regulatory mechanisms to optimize product development (e.g. expediting FIH studies, Orphan Drug, Fast Track, conditional /accelerated approval, compassionate use and pediatric plan) is assessed and incorporated into the global regulatory strategy
  • Communicate consistently well defined, successful regulatory strategies throughout the organization such that expectation is understood
  • Ensure effective regulatory agency communications by leading core regulatory and cross functional teams (e.g. GRTs, filing teams)
  • Attend key regulatory agency meetings which could impact the global product strategy

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Account Partner - Veeva Commercial Basics Job Location: Boston, MA Job Location Type: Remote Job Contract Type: Full-time Job Seniority Level: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Account Partner - Veeva Commercial Basics

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Account Partner to grow Veeva Commercial Basics, a suite of highly scalable medical and commercial applications that significantly impact how emerging Biotechnology and MedTech companies transition more efficiently and effectively from a clinical to a commercial organization. These are standardized, pre-configured applications without implementation and maintenance costs.

The Veeva Commercial Basics Account Partner will be responsible for meeting annual sales goals and helping the team achieve the long-range growth targets. In this role you will be responsible for generating new opportunities, winning new business, and managing executive level relationships with emerging Biotech and MedTech companies.

What You’ll Do

    • You’ll be a foundational member of the Veeva Commercial Basics sales organization and help make the product recognized as the go-to solution for emerging Biotechs and MedTech companies
    • Achieve team quarterly and annual sales goals
    • Execute fast sales cycles working directly with C-level Executives
    • Become knowledgeable on the Veeva Commercial Basics Commercial product suite
    • Responsible for running demos and fielding questions
    • Keep current with industry trends and engage customers in addressing their business challenges
    • Act with urgency, integrity, and a relentless focus on customer success

Requirements

    • Bachelors degree required
    • 4+ years of work experience
    • Including 3 years of Sales experience; a minimum of 1 year of software sales experience
    • Experience selling complex, out of the box solutions
    • Experience independently managing and driving a full sales cycle
    • Ability to sell directly to C-Level executives
    • Strong track record of hitting or exceeding sales quotas
    • We require candidates to be based in the general vicinity of the location posting

Nice to Have

    • A history of working with or selling to Life Sciences companies
    • Strong computer skills and experience with Gmail, Excel, PPT, CRM, Sigma or other reporting and analytics software
    • Entrepreneurial mindset and experience.
    • Familiarity with Veeva’s Commercial software and data products.
    • Experience prospecting as a SDR, BDR, Associate Account Partner, or Account Partner

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $80,000 - $300,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

jobs.excerpt: A Aprova e a missão do timeA Aprova é Govtech líder em crescimento no Brasil.
jobs.description:
A Aprova e a missão do time

A Aprova é Govtech líder em crescimento no Brasil. Nosso objetivo é utilizar o potencial da tecnologia para ajudar o governo a melhorar a vida das pessoas, impactando de forma positiva na redução do gasto com papel, no meio ambiente, na burocracia, evitando o deslocamento e reduzindo o tempo necessário para aprovações.

Em 2022, recebemos o nosso segundo aporte, no valor de R$ 22,5 milhões, liderado pela Astella e Vox Capital, passando a ser o maior investimento feito em uma Govtech da América Latina. Esses recursos vieram para impulsionar ainda mais os nossos produtos e alcançar nosso maior objetivo, tornar as prefeituras e câmaras 100% eficientes, menos burocráticas e digitais pra todos.

Nosso time está em constante crescimento e estamos em busca de profissionais que queiram resolver grandes desafios, construir sua carreira com a gente e, juntos, desburocratizar este Brasilzão!

Sobre a vaga:

Nós temos a missão de garantir que os nossos clientes tenham a melhor experiência possível, alcançando os seus resultados através da adoção da Aprova como plataforma para gerir os processos de sua Prefeitura. Uma grande responsabilidade, já que a Aprova é a plataforma líder do mercado de Licenciamento de Obras digital com mais de 50 clientes, atualmente com a Prefeitura de Joinville e São Paulo como grande cases.

Na sua atuação como CSA a partir do primeiro marco de sucesso atingido, você entrará em cena e será responsável por garantir a definição e entrega dos outros marcos de sucesso e, consequentemente, a retenção e expansão desse cliente! Você fará isso analisando a saúde de cada cliente da sua carteira e sendo proativo na criação de ações para aumentar a adoção da nossa plataforma.

Primárias:

  • Trabalhar a retenção de clientes;
  • Manter comunicação ativa com os clientes;
  • Parametrização do Aprova em face das regras de negócio dos nossos clientes;
  • Resolver dúvidas enviadas por e-mail ou helpdesk de forma proativa e reativa;
  • Investigação, documentação e resolução de desafios encontrados pelos nossos clientes;
  • Realizar reuniões remotas e presenciais de acompanhamento dos clientes com foco tático e estratégico;
  • Elaborar fluxos e materiais de engajamento e aprendizado para clientes;
  • Analisar a saúde da sua carteira e fornecer soluções adequadas para supri-los, gerando crescimento de receita por meio de cross-sell, up-sell e expansão na base de clientes, criar planos de ação para clientes em perigo.

Secundárias:

  • Desenvolver estratégias para alcançar métricas de adoção de produtos;
  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho e utilização dos produtos;
  • Realizar checkpoints com os clientes demonstrando o valor alcançado com a utilização do produto.
  • Graduação completa;
  • Afinidade com tecnologia, conhecimento em linguagens de programação e de sistemas de gestão;
  • Que goste de desafios e seja motivado a superá-los a cada dia;
  • Comunicativo e que saiba se expressar bem de forma oral e escrita;
  • Vontade de implementar e melhorar processos do seu time;
  • Softskills de relacionamento com clientes high touch;
  • Conhecimento iniciante em Google Sheets;
  • Experiência em áreas relacionadas ao atendimento ao cliente (suporte, pós-venda, vendas, etc).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Diferencial

  • Formação em Engenharia Civil, Arquitetura, Processos Industriais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com Govtech;
  • Vivência no ambiente de startup;
  • Experiência com negociação, conhecimento sobre métricas SaaS e/ou experiência com serviço de software
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jestor);
  • Experiência com Helpdesk (movidesk) e CRM (Salesforce);
  • Experiência com processos licitatórios.

Informações adicionais

OFERECEMOS:

  • Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela empresa;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TotalPass;
  • Licença paternidade de 20 dias;
  • Ambiente informal, descontraído e com pessoas incríveis;
  • Aprendizados e desafios diários.

jobs.description:
This role is open to remote based candidates based in Canada with a preference for PST/EST

We're looking for a Senior Product Developer to join our team as we enter our next stage of growth. As a Senior Product Developer, you'll play a key role in advancing how we build best-in-class SaaS products and AI agents across two environments: the Salesforce platform and our modern, cloud-native stack. You'll develop and refine the techniques, patterns, and tools that help us deliver impact faster and with greater quality across both. This role is about tackling complex challenges, setting a high bar for technical excellence, and driving best practices throughout our development efforts.

Who we are

At Traction Rec, community is at the heart of everything we do. We empower nonprofit organizations like YMCAs, Jewish Community Centers (JCCs), Boys & Girls Clubs of America (BGCA), and Salvation Army Kroc Centers to strengthen their communities through great technology built on the Salesforce platform. By enabling these organizations to deliver their services more efficiently, we help them focus on creating meaningful connections and driving positive change where it matters most.

We believe that business is a powerful force for good. As part of this belief, we’ve committed to the Pledge 1% for the Planet, dedicating 1% of our time, product, profit, or equity to supporting environmental and community causes. This commitment reflects our dedication to creating a positive impact that extends beyond technology.

Our passion for community and innovation has earned us recognition, including:

  • Salesforce Nonprofit Sales Partner of the Year and ISV Partner of the Year
  • Globe & Mail's Top Growing Companies of 2024 and 2025
  • Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 winner 2024

jobs.description:
The Project Manager leads cross-functional teams to deliver Salesforce and CRM-related initiatives on time and within budget, ensuring client satisfaction through strong planning, communication, and risk management. This role is responsible for driving execution, aligning deliverables to business goals, and managing scope, resources, and stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

About Bolt Data

A connected workplace focused on innovation Bolt Data is a connected group of technology enthusiasts that believe collaboration and genuine care for each other are at the core of everything we do. As a long-standing partner of some of the world’s most successful platforms, we offer endless opportunities to expand your technology expertise. We're deeply committed to our team members' career advancement and helping them achieve their professional goals.

Description

A Project Manager is responsible for managing all aspects of a project, or specified project component when working within a larger project structure. The Project Manager will develop comprehensive project proposals in response to client requests for support; focused on understanding client needs and constraints, defining scope and deliverables, creating timelines, managing the resource forecast, holding team members accountable for achieving forecasts and determining the costs and resources required to meet client expectations. The Project Manager will mobilize and manage high-performing project teams; ensuring the pre-requisite skills are available to deliver project commitments. The Project Manager will develop, gain consensus upon, and execute project plans to agreed cost, quality, and timelines, including the management of risks and issues. The Project Manager will manage client stakeholders, setting and managing client expectations through effective communications. The Project Manager will ensure project benefits are clearly defined and realized in alignment with the client business case for change.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Establish effective working relationships with key client and project team stakeholders
  • Communicate and manage expectations regarding delivery updates, risks, issues, and opportunities with key stakeholders
  • Facilitate/Lead workshops to define project objectives, success criteria, scope, exclusions, timelines, methods/standards, individual roles and responsibilities, and project steering/governance
  • Establish and facilitate project meetings to remain current on delivery status, position upcoming activities, and manage risks; documenting and communicating key messages for stakeholders
  • Ensure functional requirements and solution designs are developed in alignment with industry standards, meets business requirements, and has been accepted by the key stakeholders
  • Ensures adherence to the Bolt Data methodology and possesses the ability to assess risks in process, people, or technology and adjusts project plans to address accordingly.
  • Ensure that the change control mechanism is clearly communicated and managed appropriately with the client.
  • Liaise between clients, delivery teams (including vendors) to drive delivery performance, manage risks, and remove barriers
  • Contributes domain expertise (in addition to project management) in multiple areas such as business analysis, vertical or horizontal domain expertise, Agile development practices, Salesforce cloud offerings, etc.
  • Ensure client opportunities to iteratively review and steer interim project deliverables
  • Manage scope change; ensuring changes are governed for design and commercially reflected
  • Ensure final solution documentation is completed and lead knowledge transition to client support team
  • Ensure client acceptance and sign-off of key project milestones and deliverables
  • Ensure key project assets are preserved for future leveraging
    Provides mentoring, guidance and general care and feeding to project team members, including offshore team members and other Project Managers.
  • Ensure forecasts are accurate and up to date
  • Ensure team members are aware of their forecasts and billing to those forecasts

Professional Capabilities:

  • Experience managing a remote consulting group
  • Experience with process improvement initiatives and automation
  • Experience with SFDC administration and implementation
  • Proficient in data manipulation (Excel, Access, Google Analytics, etc)
  • Ability to manage time effectively, set priorities and meet deadlines
  • Outstanding written, presentation and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently, as well as part of a team on multiple projects

Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • 8+ years experience successfully leading projects using a structured approach (e.g., PMP, Prince2, SAFE/Agile)
  • 5+ years of Salesforce implementation experience utilizing proven project management processes and framework
  • Experience leading Salesforce.com projects or other CRM software (Siebel, Clarify, Vantiv, Peoplesoft, NetSuite, RightNow, etc.)
  • Experience managing projects with large enterprise initiatives
  • Proven ability to manage budgets for projects greater than $500K
  • Experience estimation/sizing, SOW/Change Order contracting
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Technology, or otherwise relevant subject
  • Project Management certification (e.g., Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification)
  • Field service experience; including customer service management and call center support
  • Demonstrable experience managing medium to large-sized teams of cross discipline resources with complex, multi-location programs while maintaining budget
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills – ability to decipher project health/issues through hard and soft metrics before they become major issues
  • Experience managing customer relationships; including critical communications and influencing
  • Experience working independently and within a cross-functional and cross-vendor team environment; collaborating effectively, creating consensus, and driving outcomes
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally with client and project team as needed.

We comply with all Federal, State, and Local laws and no person at Bolt Data shall be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, age, lifestyle, disability, marital/family status, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: HR Consultant + Project Lead
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreLegacy HR Consulting puts the human back into HR.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Legacy HR Consulting puts the human back into HR. We're passionate about creating workplaces where people feel supported, respected, and empowered. We partner with mission-driven and social justice organizations to build inclusive workplaces that attract and retain dream teams. Our clients are committed to advancing social justice, including reproductive rights, LGBTQ+ equality, racial equity, and economic justice.

At Legacy HR Consulting, we're not just a team; we're a community. We value authenticity, empathy, and collaboration in all our relationships, whether with our clients or each other.

What You’ll Be Doing

We're looking for a strong HR Generalist who is confident working across multiple HR domains, including multi-state leaves and compliance, and is capable of leading project-based deliverables from start to finish. You'll balance support for our fractional HR clients and project-based HR work. For assigned projects, you'll serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact, responsible for executing deliverables from kickoff to closeout, including deliverable development, timeline tracking, internal coordination, and client communications.

  • Core Responsibilities (Weekly/Retained Work)
    • Serve as an HR point of contact for assigned clients, providing responsive and thoughtful support.
    • Handle employee relations questions, policy interpretation, and general HR compliance support, including leave and accommodation administration and compliance across multiple states (California and New York/NYC experience required).
    • Join client meetings to provide updates, follow-ups, and documentation.
    • Use internal tools like ClickUp, Clockify, and Slack to track your work and communicate updates.
  • Project-Based Responsibilities
    • Own and drive execution on HR deliverables such as employee handbooks, policies, onboarding/offboarding toolkits, and performance frameworks, ensuring high-quality, human-centered work throughout.
    • Draft and refine deliverables independently, escalating only for strategic or unfamiliar issues. Apply an equity-informed lens to all content.
    • Track timelines, milestones, and deliverables in ClickUp. Update task statuses daily, flag bottlenecks or retainer/utilization concerns early to the Client Lead or CAM, and keep all collaborators aligned.
    • Coordinate with the Client Account Manager (CAM) for scope-related questions and meeting logistics.
    • Delegate formatting, research, or administrative tasks to Project Support. Assign subtasks to Project Support or Client Lead as needed to move work forward.
  • Internal Team Growth
  • Draft and refine internal SOPs and processes as our internal systems mature.
  • Offer feedback and input on internal People practices as we scale, helping us practice what we consult on.
  • Attend monthly team meetings

Equity in Practice

At Legacy HRC, we don’t just talk about equity—we build it into how we show up. In this role, you'll apply an equity lens to everything you do: from drafting policies to handling employee questions. We encourage learning, curiosity, feedback, and humility in our efforts to build workplaces that center justice and inclusion. This also includes ensuring our deliverables are accessible, inclusive, and aligned with each client’s cultural and operational context.


Who You Are

We're looking for someone who brings both hands-on HR experience and the confidence to manage workstreams and timelines. You take initiative, communicate clearly, and are aligned with our mission and values.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of HR generalist experience (preferably with nonprofits or values-aligned clients)
  • An equity-informed mindset and commitment to social justice
  • Hands-on experience administering leave and accommodation processes across multiple states, with working knowledge of California, New York, Massachusetts, and Oregon requirements specifically
  • Experience leading HR projects like policy creation, audits, or onboarding/offboarding systems
  • Experience managing end-to-end HR project delivery, including client communication, timeline management, and task coordination
  • Working knowledge of compliance areas like FMLA, ADA, EEOC, and wage & hour law
  • Strong interpersonal and written communication skills
  • Proficiency (or willingness to learn) ClickUp, Slack, and Google Suite
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently
  • Can work independently with minimal supervision while contributing meaningfully to a collaborative team
  • Comfortable using remote work tools including ClickUp, Slack, and Google Suite, and keeping tasks and communication up to date daily
  • A track record of building processes or documentation that others can pick up and use, not just work that lives in your own head

A Plus:

  • Experience with compensation structuring and job leveling
  • Experience supporting employee relations investigations and conflict resolution
  • Experience designing performance frameworks or onboarding programs

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation: This is a W2 position with an hourly pay range of $34 to $37. We are committed to paying a livable wage and strive to provide annual cost-of-living adjustments when the budget allows.

Benefits Include:

  • 20 hrs Vacation Time
  • 40 hrs Sick Time
  • 11 paid holidays, including a fully paid winter break
  • Ability to participate in a 401(k)
  • Discount on Peloton Membership
  • Opportunities for growth and leadership roles, including increased project ownership and strategic client engagement.

Why Join Legacy HR Consulting?

  • Be part of a culture that truly embodies what we teach—one that values empathy, authenticity, and the human experience. We prioritize well-being, collaboration, and continuous learning, creating an environment where your contributions are valued and your growth is supported.
  • Work with a team that believes in balancing excellence with humanity and empowers you to bring your whole self to work.

Work Hours:

This role starts at 15-20 hours per week. We anticipate this role could grow to 20-25 hoursper week, depending on business growth and onboarding. We can't guarantee a timeline, but we genuinely intend to increase this role's hours over time.

  • You must be available to work a set schedule during core business hours (9 AM – 5 PM CST).
  • Due to the nature of our client work, we cannot accept candidates who are only available during evenings or have other roles restricting weekday availability.
  • We're intentionally looking for someone who's excited about our mission and the clients we work for, and their missions, and who's excited to grow with us. This isn't the right fit for someone building their own independent HR practice or looking for a flexible part-time role on the side.

About DeleteMe:

DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.

DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce.
DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy.
Job Title: Director, Growth

Job Summary:

Attacker Doesn't Sleep. Neither Should Our GTM Stack.
DeleteMe helps people and companies delete the personal data that fuels phishing, doxxing, and AI-powered social engineering attacks. We're the category leader in personal data removal — and we're now defining the next category: Human Attack Surface Management (HASM).
We move fast, ship faster, and think in systems, not tickets. We're looking for a Director of Growth who doesn't just manage marketing campaigns but a AI-native growth machine.
If "growth hacking” to you means Zapier and a few HubSpot workflows, this isn't your role. If it means dynamic campaigns, agentic pipelines, LLM-orchestrated lead scoring, and infrastructure that gets smarter every week without a headcount increase, keep reading.

Responsibilities:

-You'll sit at the intersection of marketing, sales, RevOps, and data — but you'll operate like a growth hacker, not a coordinator.
-Build the AI-native GTM stack: Design and own the systems architecture connecting our CRM, marketing automation, enrichment, intent data, and outbound motion — with AI agents doing the work humans used to do manually.
-Automate the funnel, end to end: From lead scoring and routing to personalization at scale, you'll build pipelines that use LLMs and agentic workflows to make every touch smarter than the last.
-Instrument everything: Attribution, pipeline velocity, campaign performance — you'll build the dashboards and data models that let leadership make real-time decisions, not monthly ones.
-Prototype relentlessly: You'll stand up scrappy internal tools and agents in days, not quarters — proving value fast, then hardening what works.
-Partner cross-functionally: You'll work directly with marketing leadership (including our CMO) on campaigns like our co-branded research initiatives with 451 Research/S&P Global, translating category-defining content strategy into scalable, systemized execution.
-Build the team: You'll start as a builder and grow into a leader — hiring and mentoring GTM engineers who share your obsession with automation and speed.

Experience:

-You're AI-first, not AI-curious: You've built real workflows with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and automation tooling — not just used ChatGPT to write emails. You have opinions about prompt architecture, context windows, and where agents fail.
-You code: Python, SQL, and API-level fluency are table stakes. You're comfortable in a CRM's data model and in a Jupyter notebook in the same afternoon.
-You've lived in the GTM stack: Salesforce or HubSpot, Clay, Outreach/Salesloft, 6sense/ZoomInfo, Segment — you know how these systems actually talk to each other (and where they lie to each other).
-You think like a founder: You default to building over buying, shipping over planning, and you measure your own impact in pipeline and velocity, not activity.
-You've done this before: 5+ years in GTM/RevOps/marketing engineering, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS or security company, with real ownership of systems and outcomes.
-You're allergic to bureaucracy: You'd rather build the automation than write the ticket asking someone else to.
-Bonus: experience in security, privacy, or risk categories — you understand urgency-driven buyers and how to build pipeline around a category the market is still learning to name.

The Lead Associate will oversee the full product lifecycle across active and emerging markets and play a critical role in advancing Protective's Employee Benefits growth, with a strong focus on building out and scaling our Disability and Life offerings alongside our PFML portfolio.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for Group Life and AD&D, Disability (STD/LTD), and Statutory PFML products, including market entry and expansion, product enhancements, renewals, and ongoing optimization.

• Collaborate with Marketing and Sales to inform product positioning, value proposition, group benefits best practices go-to-market strategy, and market expansion efforts.
• Partner with Actuarial and Underwriting to support pricing strategy, rate development, forecasting, and loss ratio performance.
• Lead cross-functional alignment and governance across Legal, Claims, Operations, Underwriting, Actuarial, Finance, and Technology, throughout the product development process.
• Serve as the central product authority and subject matter expert for Group Benefits products driving alignment on strategy, regulatory interpretation, and execution, and supporting internal training and business enablement.
• Leverage data, analytics, and AI tools to support product research, development, and performance insights.
• Oversee operational readiness for product launches and enhancements, including systems, processes, and cross-functional training.
• Mentor and guide junior members of the team
• Represent Product, in partnership with Legal and Compliance, in engagement with industry groups and trade associations.
• Support and lead broader product strategy initiatives as assigned by EB management.
Required Skills and Abilities
• Proven leadership skills and the ability to succeed in a highly matrixed, cross-functional environment, building alignment among diverse stakeholders and delivering results.
• Demonstrated ability to lead complex strategic initiatives from concept through implementation, driving progress and accountability without direct authority.
• Strategic mindset; consistently contributes thoughtful continuous improvement perspectives and new ideas.
• Deep analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
• Strong project management skills, with advanced knowledge of agile methodologies and project management / collaboration tools.
• Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively to develop solutions and achieve objectives under limited oversight.
• Executive-level communication and presentation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to travel as needed (~10–15%).
Education and Experience
• 15+ years of experience in product management within the insurance or employee benefits industry, with expertise across Group Benefits products including Group Life and AD&D, Disability (STD/LTD), and Statutory PFML, and multi-state regulatory environments.

• In-depth knowledge of Group insurance products and best practices.
• Experience with product filings, legislative interpretation, and regulatory compliance.
• Expertise in effectively engaging external partners, including consultants, research firms, and third-party service providers, to advance product initiatives and deliver business outcomes.
• Demonstrated experience launching products on new administrative or digital platforms, including requirements definition, testing, and go-live support.

We aim to protect the wellbeing of our employees and their families with a broad benefits offering. In addition to offering comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, we support emotional wellbeing through mental health benefits and an employee assistance program. Work/life balance is important and Protective offers a variety of paid time away benefits (e.g., paid time off, paid parental leave, short-term disability, and a cultural observance day). The financial health of our employees is just as important as physical and emotional health. jobs.description:
Transition to a Career in Cybersecurity at a Dynamic Cybersecurity Company

The cybersecurity industry is poised to grow by double digits again this year. Join the growing team at InfoDefense to provide exceptional services to our customers. Gain private-sector experience and expand your skill set with the latest in security methods and technology!

This is a remote position, but candidates must live in or near Dallas, TX, or Anchorage, AK, or be willing to relocate if offered a permanent position.

InfoDefense is an Authorized SkillBridge Organization. This position is open to personnel transitioning out of the military. The objective is to facilitate a smooth transition to a civilian career in Cybersecurity. The Cybersecurity
Internship Program was designed to provide exposure to private sector business as well as a flexible schedule to accommodate out-processing. Theinternship will last for a minimum of 90 days. All candidates are required to pass a background check prior to beginning work and must be approved for the program by a commanding officer.

Job Description

We are looking for a motivated self-starter that is passionate about cybersecurity and has a strong desire to be an integral part of a dynamic team. The Cybersecurity Internship Program is designed to offer interns business and technical exposure to core elements of the cybersecurity discipline, including:

  • Network Security (including firewalls and NIDS/NIPS)
  • Identity & Access Management (including single sign-on, public key infrastructure, privileged access management)
  • Security Operations Center (including security information & event management)
  • Endpoint Threat Protection Technologies
  • Cyber Incident Response Planning, Training, and Execution
  • Governance, Risk and Compliance (including policies, standards, procedures, risk analysis)
  • Security Awareness
  • Threat and Vulnerability Management
  • Security Audit and Assessment
  • Social Engineering and Red Team Exercises

Each intern is expected to participate in industry-related activities and customer meetings as well as author three 1,000-word articles/blogs on cybersecurity-related topics.

Qualifications

Desire and ability to learn quickly, a great attitude, and good work ethic. To be considered for this internship, the candidate must be currently serving in the United States military, be eligible for the SkillBridge program, seeking an associate, bachelor, or master's degree in cybersecurity, computer engineering, or a related discipline, and have had exposure to core information security functions, including network and application vulnerability testing, role-based access control (RBAC), security information and event management, and/or computer incident management. To be successful, a candidate should be proficient in Linux and Windows, and have at least two years of information technology experience and exposure to three or more of the following security technologies:

Interns must have a home office environment and sufficient Internet connectivity to enable remote work.

Interns can successfully perform the skills described in the training with minimal assistance. Evaluations are provided as either "Satisfactory" or "Unsatisfactory".

A turn-key cybersecurity solutions provider, InfoDefense provides best-in-class information protection, network security, system security, and identity and access management, as well as IT governance, and risk and compliance solutions. With a current focus on Department of Defense contractors with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) compliance requirements, InfoDefense has also served financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and government customers since 2001.

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote Position Type: 12-Month Contract with the possibility of conversion to a permanent role Reports to: Director of Programs and Community Development About the RoleDigital Moment is seeking a senior Learning Experience Designer to help us bring our learning content into a new era - designing applied AI education and translating powerful in-person learning experiences into effective self-paced digital learning on our platform.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Type: 12-Month Contract with the possibility of conversion to a permanent role
Reports to: Director of Programs and Community Development

About the Role

Digital Moment is seeking a senior Learning Experience Designer to help us bring our learning content into a new era - designing applied AI education and translating powerful in-person learning experiences into effective self-paced digital learning on our platform.

Your anchor project is funded and concrete: design and produce a 40-hour applied AI apprenticeship course. This starts with building a modular, competency-based AI curriculum system - a framework and module library covering AI foundations, practical AI use, responsible AI, and career pathways - with its first application serving a diverse cohort of youth who are not currently in education, employment, or training (NEET).

But the role is bigger than one course. Over the contract, you will help convert our existing catalog of educator and youth content into instructionally sound, self-paced digital experiences, and originate new content for audiences we're just beginning to serve — including parents, small businesses, and seniors. You'll work embedded within our Programs team, partnering closely with Digital Product, and demonstrating what great digital learning looks like by building it.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates with autonomy, originates content rather than only adapting it, and wins people over by proof rather than persuasion.

What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver the AI apprenticeship course (anchor project)

  • Develop an applied AI competency framework: the knowledge, skills, behaviors, and confidence the curriculum builds, from foundational through intermediate levels.
  • Design a modular curriculum architecture - module categories, sequencing logic, standards for structure and assessment, and guidelines for combining modules into programs of different lengths and focuses.
  • Develop the library of learning modules across areas such as AI foundations, practical AI use (prompting, AI-supported workflows, no-code tools), responsible AI (ethics, bias, privacy, human oversight), and application pathways (problem-solving, sector use cases, careers, entrepreneurship).
  • Produce complete, delivery-ready learning materials, including a comprehensive facilitator guide that enables trained Digital Moment facilitators to deliver the program without you in the room, so it can scale across a growing facilitator network and be translated into self-paced digital formats.
  • Configure the modules into the apprenticeship pathway for our first cohort, including applied projects and a flexible capstone model, and validate coherence, pacing, and progression.
  • Build flexible assessment and impact-measurement tools (baseline/endline surveys, knowledge checks, rubrics) aligned with program and funder reporting needs.

2. Adapt the catalog for digital

  • Convert existing educator and youth content into instructionally sound, self-paced learning experiences on our digital platform.
  • Design within platform constraints and in step with the platform roadmap, in close partnership with our Digital Product Manager.
  • Establish reusable patterns and standards for in-person-to-digital conversion that others can follow.

3. Originate content for new audiences, ensuring inclusivity and cultural awareness

  • Build toward learning experiences for new audiences over time, including parents sole proprietors, and seniors.
  • Originate new content where no in-house playbook exists, working with program staff as subject-matter reviewers and validating with real users (e.g., advisory groups, user testing).
  • Design for self-directed adult learners: low-time, motivation-driven, and coming in with widely varying confidence and AI literacy.

4. Measure, maintain, and model

  • Gather participant and facilitator feedback; iterate on modules and materials.
  • Keep AI-related content current as tools, workplace practices, and learner needs evolve.
  • Work embedded in the Programs group, building confidence in digital learning through visible, high-quality delivery.

Who You Are

We are looking for a rare mix of technical know-how and human-centric education experience. If you meet most of these qualifications, we encourage you to apply.

Instructional Design & Digital Learning

  • Strong instructional-design / learning-science foundation, with demonstrated experience converting in-person training into digital and e-learning formats.
  • Experience designing modular, competency-based curricula or learning systems — not only individual courses.
  • A portfolio of learning artifacts you have created (course modules, facilitator guides, e-learning experiences, assessment tools, or equivalent).

Applied AI Expertise

  • Credible working proficiency with current AI tools and concepts — LLMs, generative AI tools, no-code/low-code applications, prompting, data literacy, and responsible AI — deep enough to author an applied AI course.
  • The ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging, everyday language, grounded in how AI is genuinely used across industries today.

Content Creation & Audience Range

  • Content creation and writing strength — you originate new material, not just adapt existing content.
  • Experience designing for adult and informal learners (self-directed, time-constrained, motivation-driven), not only K–12 settings.
  • Experience designing for or working with diverse and underserved learners — experience with marginalized, vulnerable, or NEET youth is a strong asset for the anchor project.
  • Bilingualism (English/French) is an asset.

How You Work

  • Senior individual contributor: self-directed, resourceful, comfortable owning outcomes with autonomy.
  • Collaborative with product teams; comfortable designing within platform and technical constraints.
  • A builder of champions: you bring colleagues along by demonstrating value, not by lobbying for it.

Working at Digital Moment includes:

  • 20 days of annual vacation (including 5 days in December during office closure);
  • Group benefits including RRSP, parental top-up, medical and dental;
  • Working from home, and a flexible 35 hour work week;
  • 10 annual wellness days;
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities.

Digital Moment is proud to be an equal opportunity employer who champions collaboration, innovation, and diversity of thought.

We pride ourselves on being a truly collaborative, innovative and diverse team. We celebrate the big - and small - wins. We laugh often and love to build connections. We support and help each other learn and grow. We are really good at what we do and we care a lot about doing it. Apply if you belong!

Application process:

  • Apply through our job posting link. Applications must include a resume, and candidates will be asked to answer a few questions about their professional experience.
  • Selected candidates will have a 30-min video screening call with our People & Culture Specialist.
  • Following the screening call, selected candidates will have a 60-min video call with our Director of Programs & Operations and a member of our Programs team.
  • We make sure to contact every applicant by email in a timely manner.

*************************************************************************

Lieu de travail : Télétravail
Type de poste : Contrat de 12 mois, avec possibilité de conversion en poste permanent
Relève de : Directrice des Programmes et du Développement communautaire

À propos du poste

Moment Numérique est à la recherche d'une personne chevronnée en conception d'expériences d'apprentissage pour faire entrer son contenu éducatif dans une nouvelle ère : concevoir une formation appliquée en intelligence artificielle (IA) et transposer de puissantes expériences d'apprentissage en présentiel en formations numériques autoportées et efficaces sur notre plateforme.

Votre projet phare est financé et concret : concevoir et produire un programme d'apprentissage appliqué en IA de 40 heures. Le travail commence par la création d'un système de curriculum modulaire axé sur les compétences — un cadre de référence et une bibliothèque de modules couvrant les fondements de l'IA, l'utilisation pratique de l'IA, l'IA responsable et les parcours de carrière — dont la première application servira une cohorte diversifiée de jeunes qui ne sont ni en emploi, ni aux études, ni en formation (NEET).

Mais le rôle dépasse largement un seul cours. Au cours du contrat, vous contribuerez à convertir notre catalogue actuel de contenus destinés au personnel éducateur et à la jeunesse en expériences numériques autoportées et pédagogiquement rigoureuses, en plus de créer du contenu original pour des publics que nous commençons tout juste à desservir — notamment les parents, les petites entreprises et les personnes aînées. Vous travaillerez intégrée à l'équipe des Programmes, en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Produit numérique, et vous démontrerez ce qu'est un apprentissage numérique de qualité en le réalisant concrètement.

Il s'agit d'un poste senior de contribution individuelle (sans gestion d'équipe), pour une personne qui travaille de façon autonome, qui crée du contenu original plutôt que de simplement l'adapter, et qui rallie ses collègues par la démonstration plutôt que par le plaidoyer.

Vos responsabilités

1. Concevoir et livrer le programme d'apprentissage en IA (projet phare)

  • Élaborer un cadre de compétences en IA appliquée : les connaissances, les habiletés, les comportements et la confiance que le curriculum développe, du niveau fondamental au niveau intermédiaire.
  • Concevoir une architecture curriculaire modulaire : catégories de modules, logique de séquençage, normes de structure et d'évaluation, et lignes directrices pour combiner les modules en programmes de durées et d'orientations variées.
  • Développer la bibliothèque de modules d'apprentissage couvrant des domaines tels que les fondements de l'IA, l'utilisation pratique de l'IA (rédaction de requêtes, flux de travail assistés par l'IA, outils sans code), l'IA responsable (éthique, biais, vie privée, supervision humaine) et les parcours d'application (résolution de problèmes, cas d'usage sectoriels, carrières, entrepreneuriat).
  • Produire du matériel pédagogique complet et prêt à être livré, y compris un guide d'animation exhaustif permettant aux personnes animatrices formées par Moment Numérique de livrer le programme sans votre présence, afin qu'il puisse être déployé à l'échelle d'un réseau d'animation en croissance et être transposé en formats numériques autoportés.
  • Configurer les modules en un parcours d'apprentissage pour notre première cohorte, incluant des projets appliqués et un modèle de projet de synthèse flexible, et en valider la cohérence, le rythme et la progression.
  • Créer des outils souples d'évaluation et de mesure d'impact (sondages de départ et de fin, vérifications des acquis, grilles d'évaluation) alignés sur les besoins de reddition de comptes du programme et des bailleurs de fonds.

2. Adapter le catalogue pour le numérique

  • Convertir les contenus existants destinés au personnel éducateur et à la jeunesse en expériences d'apprentissage autoportées et pédagogiquement rigoureuses sur notre plateforme numérique.
  • Concevoir en tenant compte des contraintes de la plateforme et au rythme de sa feuille de route, en partenariat étroit avec notre gestionnaire de produit numérique.
  • Établir des modèles et des normes réutilisables pour la conversion du présentiel vers le numérique, que d'autres personnes pourront appliquer.

3. Créer du contenu pour de nouveaux publics, avec inclusion et sensibilité culturelle

  • Développer progressivement des expériences d'apprentissage pour de nouveaux publics, notamment les parents, les travailleuses et travailleurs autonomes et les personnes aînées.
  • Créer du contenu original là où aucun guide interne n'existe, en collaborant avec le personnel des programmes à titre d'expertes et experts de contenu, et en validant auprès de véritables utilisatrices et utilisateurs (groupes consultatifs, tests utilisateurs, etc.).
  • Concevoir pour des personnes adultes en apprentissage autodirigé : peu de temps disponible, motivation personnelle comme moteur, et niveaux de confiance et de littératie en IA très variables.

4. Mesurer, entretenir et donner l'exemple

  • Recueillir la rétroaction des personnes participantes et animatrices; faire évoluer les modules et le matériel en conséquence.
  • Maintenir à jour les contenus liés à l'IA au fil de l'évolution des outils, des pratiques professionnelles et des besoins des personnes apprenantes.
  • Travailler de façon intégrée au sein du groupe Programmes et renforcer la confiance envers l'apprentissage numérique par une livraison visible et de grande qualité.

Votre profil

Nous recherchons un mélange rare de savoir-faire technique et d'expérience en éducation centrée sur l'humain. Si vous répondez à la plupart de ces critères, nous vous encourageons à postuler.

Conception pédagogique et apprentissage numérique

  • Solides bases en conception pédagogique et en sciences de l'apprentissage, avec une expérience démontrée de conversion de formations en présentiel vers des formats numériques et de formation en ligne.
  • Expérience de conception de curriculums ou de systèmes d'apprentissage modulaires et axés sur les compétences — pas uniquement de cours individuels.
  • Un portfolio de réalisations pédagogiques que vous avez créées (modules de cours, guides d'animation, expériences de formation en ligne, outils d'évaluation ou équivalents).

Expertise en IA appliquée

  • Maîtrise pratique crédible des outils et concepts actuels de l'IA — grands modèles de langage (LLM), outils d'IA générative, applications sans code ou à faible code, rédaction de requêtes, littératie des données et IA responsable — suffisamment approfondie pour concevoir un cours d'IA appliquée.
  • La capacité de traduire des concepts techniques complexes en un langage simple, engageant et accessible, ancré dans l'usage réel de l'IA dans les différents secteurs aujourd'hui.

Création de contenu et polyvalence des publics

  • Force en création de contenu et en rédaction : vous créez du matériel original, vous ne faites pas qu'adapter du contenu existant.
  • Expérience de conception pour un public adulte et en contexte d'apprentissage informel (autodirigé, contraint par le temps, mû par la motivation), et non uniquement en milieu scolaire (primaire-secondaire).
  • Expérience de conception pour des personnes apprenantes diversifiées et mal desservies, ou de travail auprès d'elles; une expérience auprès de jeunes marginalisés, vulnérables ou NEET constitue un atout important pour le projet phare.
  • Le bilinguisme (français/anglais) est un atout.

Votre façon de travailler

  • Contribution individuelle senior : autonomie, débrouillardise et aisance à assumer la responsabilité des résultats.
  • Collaboration avec les équipes produit; aisance à concevoir dans le respect des contraintes techniques et de la plateforme.
  • Vous savez rallier des alliés : vous convainquez vos collègues en démontrant la valeur de votre travail, pas en faisant du lobbying.

Travailler chez Moment numérique inclut:

  • 20 jours de vacances annuelles (incluant 5 jours en décembre pendant la fermeture des bureaux) ;
  • Des avantages sociaux collectifs, notamment une assurance médicale, une assurance de congés parentaux, une assurance dentaire, et un complément de REER ;
  • Travailler à domicile et un horaire flexible de 35 heures par semaine ;

  • Des opportunités de développement et de formation continue.

Moment Numérique est fier d'être un employeur qui défend l'égalité des chances, la collaboration, l'innovation et la diversité de pensée.

Nous sommes fiers d'être une équipe véritablement collaborative, innovante et diversifiée. Nous célébrons les grandes - et les petites - victoires. Nous rions souvent et aimons tisser des liens. Nous nous soutenons et nous nous aidons mutuellement à apprendre et à progresser. Nous sommes vraiment bons dans ce que nous faisons et nous y tenons beaucoup.   • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible working hours and remote work options
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Access to industry conferences and networking events
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
