jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a senior content leader to own the voice of two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform. Ad Age recently described us as "if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI." Your job is to turn a line like that into an argument the market repeats back to us. The split is roughly 80% Darkroom, 20% Shadow.

We are making a category bet on the forward-deployed marketer, the operator who sits inside a business and builds with AI rather than briefing the work out. We intend to make that a term of art through Darkroom: the article, the LinkedIn engine, the video, the webinars, the press. You own that campaign end to end.

You'll report to our VP of Marketing, who sets direction and makes the calls. You'll help shape the thinking behind it: how content maps to the funnel, which channels carry which offers, and what actually turns attention into pipeline. Then you build the content that proves it.

Our marketing operations manager owns the calendar, the publishing, and the deployment. You make the content that fills all of it, across LinkedIn, video, email, paid, and creator, and you brief our designer, video editor, and SEO specialist so one idea becomes a post, a video, an email, and an ad in the same week. This isn't a writing-only role.

Alongside content, you own the creative half of the creator program: who we work with, what we ask them to make, and the call on whether we go wide with many creators or deep with a few. You source and negotiate the partnerships and write the briefs. Marketing Ops runs the admin behind it. Creator content is one of our two strongest lead sources today and the one with the most room left in it.

This is a New York-based role operating in the EST Time Zone, hybrid out of our new NYC office, and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you'll do

  • Brand Narrative: Define and defend what Darkroom and Shadow say. Own the positioning arguments, the category bet, and the point of view that shows up everywhere else.

  • Funnel & Strategy: Work with the VP of Marketing on how content builds pipeline: which channels, which offers, which lead magnets, and what the content has to do at each stage. You help build the model, then you feed it.

  • LinkedIn & Video: Build our LinkedIn engine across the company page and our executives' accounts, including video made for the feed it runs in. This is where our buyers spend their day and where we have the most ground to take.

  • Creator Strategy & Briefs: Decide who we work with and what they make. Source creators, negotiate the partnerships, write the briefs, and set the strategy between a wide roster and a small group of anchor creators. Marketing Ops handles the CRM, deadlines, content collection and reporting.

  • Email & Newsletter: Own what goes into our newsletter and to our list. Marketing Ops handles deployment. The thinking, the cadence, and the reason anyone opens it are yours.

  • Shadow Content: Take Shadow's content from scattered to a funnel: posts into webinars and lead magnets into signups. Product marketing for a platform that sells to operators.

  • Paid Copy: Partner with our designer, video editor and performance team on the words behind our ads, so the organic and creator assets that work become the ads that work.

  • Editorial Direction: Brief the team, review the work, and hold a consistent standard across every surface both brands touch.

  • Events & Moments: Turn our NYC office, our activations, and our press into content programs instead of one-off posts.

  • Measurement: Work with Marketing Ops on the weekly scoreboard: reach, follower growth, earned media value, and how content traffic converts.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 5+ years in content, brand, or creator marketing, from an agency or a commerce brand, with B2B or pipeline accountability. SaaS or martech experience is a plus.

  • You have owned content that was accountable to a business number. You can explain how a post becomes traffic, becomes a conversion, becomes a lead, and you have been graded at the end of that chain. If content has always been someone else's funnel, this role is not for you.

  • You know this world. DTC, e-commerce, performance marketing, social commerce, AI tooling. You can write about TikTok Shop, retention, or attribution without a briefing and without getting it wrong.

  • You have sourced, negotiated with, and briefed creators yourself. You know what separates a brief that produces something usable from one that wastes everybody's month.

  • You have a public track record. A newsletter, bylines, a brand account you grew, a campaign that landed, a term you helped popularize. Send the link.

  • You get output out of people who don't report to you, and you can give a designer or an editor feedback that makes the next version better.

  • You arrive with a list. In the first interview, we will ask what you would change about our LinkedIn, our newsletter, and our creator content. We expect specifics.

  • You already work with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar daily and have shipped real work with them. We are a Claude-first company.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No published writing or no portfolio link.

  • Never sourced or briefed a creator yourself.

  • Content experience with no accountability for pipeline.

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a hands-on Paid Media & Tracking Assistant to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Paid Media & Tracking Assistant to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms. The ideal candidate has practical experience setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting advertising pixels, events, conversion tracking, and analytics systems, with a strong understanding of how paid traffic is measured and optimized.

You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

  • Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

  • Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

  • Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

  • Debug tracking issues and identify why an event or conversion is not firing correctly, rather than only setting up campaigns.

  • Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

  • Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

  • Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

  • Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

  • Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

  • Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

  • Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

  • Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

  • Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

  • Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

  • Familiarity with server-side tracking / Conversions API is a strong plus.

  • Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

  • Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and campaign performance reports.

  • Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious. You should be comfortable getting into the actual ad platforms and tracking tools, testing events yourself, investigating discrepancies, and figuring out why something is not working as expected.

The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.

You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

Je belt lauwe tot warme leads na en probeert afspraken te scoren voor jouw opdrachtgever.

Als je start als PSA word je getraind in het werken in Mijn DATA-collectief, de meest actuele B2B-database van Nederland waar jij jouw acties in gaat bijhouden. Je leert hoe je geautomatiseerd e-mails kunt versturen en je trajecten kunt bijhouden via acties. Jouw opdrachtgever heeft toegang tot hetzelfde systeem zodat jullie gezamenlijk gemakkelijk leads kunnen kwalificeren en hij/zij alle voortgang inzichtelijk heeft. Je gaat dus écht samenwerken om het beste uit iedere dag te halen.

Als PSA sta je direct in contact met je opdrachtgever. Je wordt door hem of haar gezien als een verlenging van hun salesafdeling. Hierdoor zijn de lijntjes kort en kun je gemakkelijk sparren over de juiste aanpak. Merk jij dat een bepaalde insteek beter werkt dan een andere? Dan kun je dat dus direct afstemmen. Doorgaan werk je vanuit huis, waarbij wij jou de software leveren om jouw werk succesvol te kunnen doen. In overleg kun je ook bij de opdrachtgever op kantoor werken. Kortom, je gaat écht hybride werken.

Met jouw inzet verhoog je meetbaar de omzet van je klanten door:

  • ervoor te zorgen dat de bedrijfsgegevens van de opdrachtgever altijd actueel zijn

  • prospects te selecteren, leads te genereren en telefonisch te benaderen

  • afspraken te boeken en te zorgen voor terugkoppeling en afstemming met je opdrachtgever en/of accountmanager

  • verkoopontspanning te bieden aan je opdrachtgever, door middel van het doorzetten van goede gesprekken of genereren van afspraken waar hij/zij alleen nog maar de sales hoeft in te koppen!

Hoe committed ben jij aan ons?

Omdat we gemerkt hebben dat veel mensen toch wel erg gemakkelijk instappen in de functie van Personal Sales Assistant, maar er even gemakkelijk weer uitstappen, hebben we een constructie bedacht die ons helpt de juiste kandidaten te selecteren en aan ons te binden, door middel van een beloningssysteem dat twee kanten op werkt en waarin wij jou belonen voor jouw commitment aan ons.

Wat houdt dit in?
Als jij ervoor kiest om jezelf een upgrade te geven als sales professional met de garantie op een leuke parttime (bij)baan, vol vrijheid, leuke opdrachten die je vanuit huis kunt invullen én de zekerheid van een continu inkomen, dan doen wij er alles aan om jou daarbij te helpen.

Zo bieden wij jou een training aan van 2 tot 6 weken, waarin we jou vingervlug maken in ons CRM-systeem en meteen ook je telefonische sales skills opkrikken, zodat jij jouw werk met NOG MEER zelfvertrouwen kunt doen. Maar daar vragen we WEL iets voor terug...

In ruil voor onze investering in jou om jou te trainen tot sales professional (met de kwalificaties die onze opdrachtgevers van jou en ons verwachten) en jou baangarantie te bieden, vragen we jou een Zelf-investering te doen. Die investering houdt in dat je de eerste 8 uur van de training (die bestaat uit de eerste fase van de training, waarin je de basisskills leert) IN EERSTE INSTANTIE niet betaald krijgt. Dan, als jij beide fases van de training door bent en 6 maanden naar tevredenheid voor ons werkt, krijg jij naast je wekelijkse uren uitbetaling die initiële 8 uur alsnog vergoed plus iets extra’s in de vorm van een eenmalige commitmentbonus à € 350,00.

Op deze manier zijn wij er zeker van dat jij er goed over nagedacht hebt of deze functie inderdaad DE functie voor jou is en dat je er 100% voor gaat. En ben JIJ verzekerd van een extra leuk zakcentje. WIN-WIN voor iedereen!

Dus ben jij ervan overtuigd dat jij de Personal Sales Assistant bent die wij zoeken? Laat het ons weten en solliciteer nu!

  • minstens 2 jaar commerciële werk- en belervaring, bijvoorbeeld als (assistent-) accountmanager, callcenter agent of medewerker commerciële binnendienst

  • vlotte computervaardigheden en, indien je vanuit huis werkt, een snelle/ stabiele internetverbinding

  • enig bedrijfsmatig inzicht om mee te kunnen denken met de klant is een pré!

jobs.description:
The Health & Wellness Specialist is a highly mobile, expert clinical resource who supports Experience Senior Living communities through hands-on guidance, temporary leadership coverage, stabilization support, and best-practice execution. This role is 100% travel-based and is deployed to communities experiencing vacancies, transitions, performance gaps, regulatory risk, or heightened operational need within the Health & Wellness and Memory Care functions.

The Specialist works side-by-side with community teams, providing clinical expertise, training, coaching, and direct operational support while reinforcing ESL standards, regulatory compliance, and resident care excellence. While this role does not hold permanent supervisory responsibility, it may temporarily perform essential functions of the Director of Health & Wellness during vacancies, onboarding periods, or short-term assignments.

Clinical Leadership & Operational Support

  • Serve as an on-site clinical expert and operational resource to Executive Directors, Directors of Health & Wellness, and wellness Teams.
  • Provide hands-on support and guidance in resident assessments, care planning, medication management, staffing, documentation, clinical oversight and clinical decision-making.
  • Temporarily assume Director of Health & Wellness /Director of Memory Care responsibilities during vacancies, leaves of absence, onboarding periods, or periods of increased operational need, ensuring continuity of care and regulatory compliance.
  • Provide clinical input, manage and support resident assessment process including move-ins, transfers, and care level appropriateness when requested.
  • Support communities in addressing resident and family concerns related to care delivery, clinical decisions, or transitions.
  • Promote person-centered care practices that uphold dignity, respect, and quality of life.

Training, Coaching & Capability Building

  • Deliver side-by-side training and coaching to Health & Wellness leaders and wellness team members, reinforcing ESL standards, policies, and best practices.
  • Support onboarding and transition of newly hired Directors of Health & Wellness through real-time guidance, mentoring, and skills check reinforcement.
  • Educate teams on resident rights, dignity, infection control, documentation standards, medication administration, and clinical workflows.
  • Reinforce accountability and consistency without assuming long-term people management authority.
  • Support communities in achieving and sustaining a “survey-ready” environment at all times.

Quality, Compliance & Risk Management

  • In partnership with Divisional support and Quality Assurance, participate in scheduled clinical audits, site visits, and operational reviews to assess compliance with ESL standards and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Identify trends in incidents, falls, medication errors, infections, and documentation gaps; partner with community and divisional leadership on corrective action planning.
  • Provide guidance during regulatory surveys, follow-up visits, or corrective action periods as directed by the SVP, Health & Wellness.
  • Ensure appropriate partnerships with ancillary service providers (home health, hospice, therapy, etc.) to support resident outcomes.

Collaboration & Travel

  • Partner closely with the SVP, Health & Wellness, Divisional Operations leaders, and community Executive Directors to prioritize deployments based on business need.
  • Maintain flexibility to deploy rapidly to communities across the operating and developing portfolio.
  • Provide timely feedback, observations, and recommendations following assignments to inform ongoing improvement efforts.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maintain required licensure across assigned states.
  • Participate in on-call or emergency clinical support as directed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned consistent with the scope and intent of the Specialist role.

Requirements

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
  • Registered Nurse (RN) preferred; LPN/LVN may be considered with significant senior living leadership experience.
  • Minimum three (3) years of clinical leadership experience in assisted living, memory care, or senior living health care operations in a senior living, recreation; multi-site or regional experience preferred.
  • Active, unrestricted nursing license in each assigned state (or ability to obtain).
  • Strong knowledge of assisted living regulations, clinical compliance, assessments, medication management, and quality assurance.
  • Ability to travel 100% of the time, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with systems such as Sherpa, UKG, OnShift and SharePoint preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet company driving standards required.

Benefits

We offer a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, life and voluntary life, 401k with employer matching, paid holidays, and up to 20 days PTO in the first three years.

jobs.description:
DBA Senior (SQL Server & Databricks)

+5 a 8 años en administración de bases de datos
Experiencia comprobable con SQL Server Enterprise
+2-3 años en plataformas Big Data / Databricks
Ingeniería en Sistemas, TI o afín

Habilidades Técnicas

SQL Server (Core)

  • Administración avanzada de SQL Server (2012 – 2022)
  • Configuración de alta disponibilidad:
  • Always On Availability Groups
  • Failover Clustering
  • Replicación (Transactional, Snapshot, Merge)
  • Performance tuning:
  • Query optimization
  • Indexing strategies
  • Execution plans
  • Seguridad:
  • Roles, permisos, encryption (TDE)
  • Auditorías y compliance
  • Backup & Recovery:
  • Estrategias PITR (Point-in-Time Recovery)
  • Automatización de respaldos
  • Troubleshooting:
  • Blocking, deadlocks, waits analysis

Databricks / Big Data

  • Desarrollo en Apache Spark (PySpark / SQL / Scala)
  • Manejo de Delta Lake
  • Optimización de pipelines en Databricks
  • Medallion Architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold)
  • Integración con:
  • Azure Data Factory / Synapse
  • APIs y fuentes externas
  • Manejo de clusters:
  • Autoscaling
  • Cost optimization
  • Data governance:
  • Unity Catalog
  • Data lineage

Data Engineering & Integración

  • ETL/ELT pipelines
  • Modelado de datos:
  • OLTP y OLAP
  • Star/Snowflake schema
  • Migración de datos:
  • On-prem → Cloud
  • Orquestación de workflows
  • Manejo de grandes volúmenes (Big Data)

Cloud (Deseable / Clave)

  • Azure (preferente):
  • Azure SQL
  • Azure Data Lake
  • Azure Databricks
  • AWS (deseable):
  • S3 + Databricks
  • Infraestructura como código (IaC) básico

Herramientas

  • SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)
  • Azure Data Studio
  • Databricks Workspace
  • Git (control de versiones)
  • PowerShell (automatización)
  • Azure DevOps / CI-CD
  • Monitoring:
  • Azure Monitor
  • Log Analytics
  • SQL Profiler / Extended Events

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar y monitorear instancias SQL Server críticas
  • Diseñar estrategias de alta disponibilidad y DRP
  • Optimizar rendimiento de bases de datos y queries
  • Implementar pipelines de datos en Databricks
  • Gestionar almacenamiento en Data Lake
  • Liderar migraciones hacia la nube
  • Definir estándares de modelado de datos
  • Garantizar seguridad, compliance y calidad de datos
  • Colaborar con equipos de Data Engineering y Analytics
  • Mentorear perfiles Jr/Mid

Soft Skills

  • Pensamiento analítico
  • Resolución de problemas complejos
  • Comunicación con stakeholders técnicos y negocio
  • Liderazgo técnico
  • Trabajo bajo presión (ambientes críticos)
  • Proactividad y ownership

jobs.title: Product Lead - Mobility & API Platforms
jobs.excerpt: This is not a single-product role.  You will own three distinct but connected product lines — and make sure they don’t just exist, but actually work together, scale, and win in the market.
jobs.description:
This is not a single-product role.

You will own three distinct but connected product lines — and make sure they don’t just exist, but actually work together, scale, and win in the market.

  • API Platform (core business, high-impact, revenue-driving)
  • Mobility Platform (IITS) (government-led deployments + enterprise use cases)
  • Navigation Product (Google Maps-based solution)

You’ll sit right in the middle of tech, business, and market reality — translating vision into execution.

What You’ll Own

1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and drive the roadmap across all three product lines
  • Prioritize features based on real market needs (not internal assumptions)
  • Align product direction with business goals and revenue opportunities

2. Market & Domain Understanding

  • Bring strong exposure to traffic monitoring / mobility / smart city ecosystems
  • Track market trends, competitors, and regulatory shifts (especially in public sector ecosystems)
  • Validate product-market fit continuously through real-world feedback

3. Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the bridge between engineering, business, and stakeholders
  • Translate business requirements into clear product specs and tech requirements
  • Work closely with engineering teams to ensure timely and scalable delivery

4. Stakeholder & Client Engagement

  • Work with government entities, enterprise clients, and internal leadership
  • Handle high-stakes conversations with clarity and confidence
  • Ensure product direction aligns with client expectations and deployment realities

5. Documentation & Communication

  • Own business-level documentation: PRDs, roadmaps, use cases, and proposals
  • Communicate complex ideas in a simple, structured way
  • Bring clarity when things get messy (because they will)

What We’re Looking For

  • 6–10 years in Product Management / Product Leadership
  • Strong experience in traffic monitoring, mobility tech, ITS, or smart city ecosystems
  • Proven ability to manage multiple products simultaneously
  • Experience working with APIs and platform-based products
  • Strong understanding of government or enterprise deployments
  • Excellent communication — both written and verbal
  • Ability to move between strategy and execution without getting lost in either
  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and building structure where none exists

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience with navigation systems / geospatial products / Google Maps integrations
  • Exposure to public sector projects or smart city initiatives
  • Strong commercial thinking — not just product, but business impact

jobs.excerpt: Symetrahas an exciting new opportunity to join our Benefits Division as a Customer Communications Manager.
jobs.description:
Symetrahas an exciting new opportunity to join our Benefits Division as a Customer Communications Manager.The person in this role will own the strategy, development, and delivery of customer communications that inform, engage, and build trust with our customers.

About the role

In this role, you will lead customer communications for the Benefits Division. You will partner closely with teams across the organization including, marketing, product, sales, account management, operations, compliance, and legal to deliver clear and accurate messaging that enhances the customer experience.

You will play a key role in translating complex business updates, operational changes, and regulatory requirements into communications that are easy for customers to understand and act on.

What you will do

  • Communication Strategy & Planning
    • Develop and implement communication strategies, processes, and workflows for Benefits customers.
    • Partner with leaders and key stakeholders to prioritize communication needs and align on timelines and deliverables.
    • Ensure customers receive consistent, clear, and timely information across communication channels.
  • Communication Development & Execution
    • Create, edit, and distribute customer-facing communications, including operational updates, service announcements, and regulatory notifications.
    • Manage communication logistics, including audience segmentation, distribution methods, and delivery platforms.
    • Support urgent communication needs related to business, operational, or customer-impacting events.
    • Monitor project timelines and coordinate communication from initiation through distribution.
    • Provide reporting and insights on communication initiatives and outcomes.
  • Governance & Compliance
    • Coordinate review and approval processes with compliance, legal, privacy, brand, and other internal partners.
    • Ensure communications meet regulatory requirements, company standards, and accessibility guidelines.

Why Work at Symetra

Here’s what some of our employees have to say about why they work at Symetra:

“We're big enough to make an impact on the country, but small enough to care and know who you are and what you're contributing to the organization. All new ideas are welcome!” - Stephanie F., VP Customer Service & Operations

"Just do it! Even if you feel like you may not be 100% qualified, apply. Sometimes we see potential in others that they can not see in themselves. You may be over qualified, or you may be the "something special" we are looking for to bring a unique, fresh approach to our company." - Ruby S., Associate EDX Analyst

What we offer you

Benefits and Perks

We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.

  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
  • Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
  • Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
  • Want more details? Check out ourSymetra Benefits Overview

Compensation

Salary Range: $106,400 - $177,300 plus eligibility for annual bonus program

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of experience developing and delivering customer, plan member, or client communications required.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, customer-friendly messaging.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple communication initiatives simultaneously.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience supporting communications in a regulated industry, such as insurance, financial services, healthcare, or a similar environment.
  • Knowledge of Group Benefits, Supplemental Health Benefits, and/or Stop Loss insurance products.
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM, email marketing platforms, customer communication platforms, or marketing automation tools.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and best practices for customer communications.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Ability to travel occasionally to support business needs.

Travel:

Required Training & Professional Development
All newly hired people leaders with direct reports are required to complete a comprehensive leadership development program within their first year. This program includes both virtual and in-person training. The in-person sessions will take place at Symetra’s corporate headquarters in Bellevue, Washington. Symetra covers all travel and accommodation expenses.

Reasonable Accommodations
Symetra is committed to providing equitable access to all job-related responsibilities, including required travel. If reasonable accommodations are needed for travel, Symetra’s HR department will work to provide appropriate solutions in alignment with individual needs and company policies.

We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.
Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we're guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they're buying, and we design products--and operate our company--to stand the test of time. We're committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.
For more information about our careers visit:
Work Authorization
Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.
Please review Symetra's Remote Network Minimum Requirements:
As a remote-first organization committed to providing a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees' internet connection:
  • Minimum Internet Speed:100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, in alignment with the FCC's definition of "broadband."
  • Internet Type:Fiber, Cable (e.g., Comcast, Spectrum), or DSL.
  • Not Permissible:Satellite (e.g., Starlink), cellular broadband (hotspot or otherwise), any other wireless technology, or wired dial-up.
When applying to jobs at Symetra you'll be asked to test your internet speed and confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra's standard as outlined above.

Identity Verification

Symetra is committed to fair and secure hiring practices. For all roles, candidates will be required (after the initial phone screen) to be on video for all interviews. Symetra will take affirmative steps at key points in the process to verify that a candidate is not seeking employment fraudulently, e.g. through use of a false identity.
Failure to comply with verification procedures may result in:
  • Disqualification from the recruitment process
  • Withdrawal of a job offer
  • Termination of employment and other criminal and/or civil remedies, if fraud is discovered

jobs.description:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brandsinclude Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore,which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About the Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Manager to join our Digital team. A Lead Product Manager operates across multiple product domains, influencing strategy beyond their immediate team. You’ll navigate ambiguity, align leaders and stakeholders around difficult decisions and elevate how product management is practiced across the organization.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and measurable outcomes across one or more product domains, ensuring roadmaps align with company strategy and deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Use customer research, analytics, experimentation, and business insight to identify and prioritize the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Lead complex product discovery efforts that span multiple teams, balancing customer value, business objectives, technical feasibility, and organizational priorities.
  • Make high-quality product decisions by synthesizing evidence, weighing tradeoffs, and creating clarity through ambiguity.
  • Partner with Engineering throughout delivery, supporting release planning, experimentation, and post-launch measurement.
  • Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, stakeholders, and leadership through thoughtful communication and influence rather than authority.
  • Raise the quality of product management by developing and following reusable frameworks, operating practices, and setting standards that help teams make better product decisions.
  • Champion experimentation and continuous learning, ensuring product investments are measured, validated, and iterated based on customer and business outcomes.
  • Lead AI-native product management by identifying emerging capabilities, developing reusable AI workflows, and helping the organization thoughtfully integrate AI to improve research, decision-making, execution, and operational effectiveness while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • 12+ years of product management experience delivering customer-facing digital products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing or another related field preferred.
  • Demonstrated success defining product strategy and delivering measurable customer and business outcomes across complex initiatives or multiple product domains.
  • Exceptional product judgment with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate tradeoffs, and make high-quality strategic decisions.
  • Strong experience defining product strategy, prioritization, experimentation, and roadmaps.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, make sound product decisions, and influence cross-functional teams.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Design, senior stakeholders, and senior leadership throughout the product lifecycle.
  • High degree of ownership, accountability, continuous learning, and bias toward action.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing large-scale customer-facing e-commerce or omnichannel digital products.
  • Experience with experimentation platforms and modern product analytics tools such as Heap, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.
  • Demonstrated curiosity for emerging AI technologies with hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to prototype ideas, automate workflows, and build lightweight solutions.
  • Experience integrating modern SaaS commerce technologies, including search, personalization, content management, payments, customer engagement, or related platforms.
Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
  • Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
  • Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
  • Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
  • Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, in a remote work location.

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go Tailoredbrands.com/working-here/people-culture.

Work-Life Balance

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:
  • Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development
  • Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend
  • Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday
The starting salary for this position is $141,100 - $180,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications. Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $220,000. Other compensation may include a 10% Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) bonus paid out according to policy. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.

The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with this job.

jobs.excerpt: Associate Director, Clinical Quality and Continuous Improvement OverviewProvides strategic QA oversight across clinical development procedures to ensure compliance with GCP requirements, regulatory expectations, and internal quality standards.
jobs.description:
Associate Director, Clinical Quality and Continuous Improvement

Overview

Provides strategic QA oversight across clinical development procedures to ensure compliance with GCP requirements, regulatory expectations, and internal quality standards.

Serves as the primary QA partner across clinical development activities by providing oversight of process adoption and compliance, contributing to operational process improvements, and leading enterprise and multi-study issue management. Ensures that quality events, audit and inspection learnings, and regulatory expectations are effectively incorporated into operational processes and study execution.

Partners closely with stakeholders across Development, clinical study teams, and Quality teams to drive sustainable quality outcomes through metrics, trend analysis, and root cause analysis, strengthening process effectiveness, enhancing compliance, and enabling consistent issue management across studies.

This position is open to remote working.

Key Responsibilities

1. Process Improvement & Quality System Enhancement

  • Represent QA in operational process improvement initiatives, influencing process design, execution, and compliance to ensure alignment with regulatory expectations, organizational strategy, and risk-based quality management principles.
  • Identify process inefficiencies and implement scalable, standardized solutions to enhance quality system performance.
  • Partner cross-functionally to embed quality into end-to-end processes.
  • Provide input into change management strategy(ies) for new and heavily revised processes.
  • Acts as a subject matter expert in driving scalable quality solutions within continuous improvement activities across clinical and, where applicable, pre-clinical (GLP) and post-market (PV) domains.

2. Process Adoption Monitoring & Compliance Assurance

  • Establish and maintain mechanisms to measure process adoption, compliance, and effectiveness following implementation of new or revised processes.
  • Lead targeted post-implementation oversight activities with process owners and study teams to evaluate alignment between updated procedural requirements and operational execution.
  • Identify gaps in process understanding or execution and partner with stakeholders to implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions that support effective remediation and sustained adoption.

3. Enterprise/Multi-Study Issue Management

  • Lead the management, tracking, and documentation of Quality Events (QEs) involving significant quality issues and/or multiple studiesto enable consistency across studies
  • Drive comprehensive, cross-study issue root cause analysis (RCA) efforts.
  • Establish and maintain standardized approaches for impact assessment, classification, and resolution of multi-study QEs and QEs that require systemic improvements.
  • Escalate recurring or systemic trends to Clinical Quality Risk & Portfolio Oversight leadership.
  • Translate insights from Clinical Quality Risk & Portfolio Oversight into enterprise-level actions for improvement.

4. Quality Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Represent QA in cross-functional teams, governance forums, and strategic initiatives to influence process design, execution, and compliance.
  • Partner with clinical operations, regulatory, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and compliance.
  • Provide QA guidance and subject matter expertise on process-related topics, continuous improvements, and methods for monitoring risks to ensure proactive issue escalation and improvements.
  • Influence and drive a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Top of Form

Bottom of Form

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or related field required.
  • Advanced degree preferred.
  • Continuous improvement certifications (including Lean Sigma, Change Management) preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in GCP Quality Assurance, Clinical Quality, or GCP-focused roles within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO environment.
  • Experience leading enterprise improvement efforts that include application of DMAIC/Lean methods and Change Management techniques preferred.
  • Strong experience in GCP regulations, inspection readiness, and audit/quality systems
  • Demonstrated experience in process improvement, quality systems, or operational excellence initiatives.
  • Experience with root cause analysis, CAPA management, and issue management frameworks.
  • Proven ability to work across multiple studies/programs and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Prior experience with quality metrics, data analytics, and compliance metrics to drive decision-making.
  • Deep knowledge of ICH GCP, FDA, EMA, and global clinical regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with regulatory inspections and audits (FDA, EMA, or other health authorities).

Knowledge & Skills

  • Ability to influence without direct authority and lead cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Strategic mindset with ability to balance big-picture transformation and operational execution.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to identify systemic trends.
  • Ability to translate data into actionable insights and business decisions.

U.S. Pay Range

$164,500.00 - $222,500.00

The pay range reflects the full-time base salary range we expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. Base pay will be determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education. This role is eligible for an annual short-term incentive award (e.g., bonus or sales incentive) and an annual long-term incentive award (e.g., equity).

Alnylam’s robust Total Rewards package is designed to support your overall health and well-being. We offer comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, a lifestyle reimbursement program, flexible spending and health savings accounts and a 401(k)with a generous company match. Eligible employees enjoy paid time off, wellness days, holidays, and two company-wide recharge breaks. We also offer generous family resources and leave. Our commitment to your well-being reflects our belief that caring for our people fuels the impact we create together.

Learn more about these and additional benefits offered by Alnylam by visiting the Benefits section of the Careers website:

About Alnylam

We are the leader in RNAi therapeutics – a revolutionary approach with the potential to transform the lives of people with rare and common diseases. Built on Nobel Prize-winning science, Alnylam has delivered the breakthroughs that made RNAi therapeutics possible and are just at the beginning of what’s possible. Our deep pipeline, late-stage programs, and bold vision reflect our core values: fierce innovation, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, open culture and commitment to people. We're proud to be a globally recognized top employer, where an authentic, inclusive culture and breakthrough thinking fuel one another.

The position supports a high-quality outpatient breast imaging program anchored by Health City and Baptist Health outpatient imaging centers throughout Palm Beach County. Physicians interpret a balanced mix of screening mammography, diagnostic mammography, breast ultrasound, and breast MRI studies while working alongside an experienced onsite breast imager who performs image-guided breast procedures.

The Data Platform teams at Netflix enable us to leverage data to bring joy to our members in many different ways. Spotlight on Data Platform Teams:

Storage and Movement Infrastructure

The Storage and Movement Infrastructure (SMI) team builds the core infrastructure that powers Netflix’s online data stores and data movement systems. Our mission is to amplify the effectiveness of these teams by delivering secure, scalable, and high‑leverage infrastructure abstractions that minimize duplicated effort, reduce operational risk, and accelerate time‑to‑delivery for Tier‑0, low‑latency, highly available services. We identify common challenges across Online Data Stores and Data Movement platforms—such as fleet management, schema management, control planes, security, and reliability—and turn them into shared, foundational primitives.

As part of SMI, you’ll work on platforms that sit at the heart of Netflix’s data ecosystem: a unified Schema Management Platform for Protobuf and Avro; a Fleet Management Platform for CI/CD and large stateful/stateless fleets; core Control Plane infrastructure for capacity, provisioning, and operations; and security and access management via consistent authentication/authorization layers. You’ll also help build resilience and reliability tooling, including SLI/SLO enablement, and a Fault Management platform for large fleets. This is a high‑impact, cross‑pillar team that partners closely with both Online Data Stores and Data Movement, shaping the paved path for how data services are operated at scale at Netflix.

Data Movement Platform - Abstractions

Provides a self-service, abstracted platform that empowers diverse user groups across Netflix to fulfill their data movement and processing needs. We own and operate Data Mesh and Data Bridge. They are the paved paths for real-time and batch data movement and transformation, with huge adoption among many teams at Netflix. We also focus on operational automation, reliability and data consistency. You will have the opportunity to work on a massive distributed system that operates thousands of pipelines and processes billions of records per second.

KeyValue

The KeyValue team (part of the Online Data Stores portfolio) offers a managed key value store to meet Netflix's operational data requirements across all lines of business. Our focus is on developing and maintaining a high-performance, reliable, and efficient key-value store. Additionally, we enhance developer productivity by providing a secure, intuitive and opinionated access layer for our backing storage engines including Cassandra.

This team is passionate about building innovative, efficient, performant and scalable offerings for our customers. Our team also engages with the Cassandra open source community, actively contributing to and responsibly stewarding the development and use of open source software.

Data Developer Experience

The Data Developer Experience (DDX) team at Netflix is dedicated to enhancing the experience of data practitioners—including Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, ML Engineers, and Data Scientists. As we evolve toward the next generation of our data platform, the DDX team is focused on boosting productivity by developing cutting-edge data tools and infrastructure that eliminate the friction and toil of building, maintaining, and leveraging data products. If you're passionate about shaping the future of developer experience, making it faster and easier for Netflix data practitioners to deliver outstanding data products, come join our team!

This would be your dream job if you enjoy:

  • Solving real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem-solving skills.

  • Architecting and building a robust, scalable, and highly available distributed infrastructure.

  • Leading cross-functional initiatives and collaborating with engineers, product managers, and TPM across teams.

  • Sharing our experiences with the open source communities and contributing to Netflix OSS.

About you:

  • You have 2+ years of experience in building large-scale distributed systems features or applications.

  • You are proficient in the design and development of RESTful web services.

  • Experienced in building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems

  • You are experienced in Java or other object-oriented programming languages.

  • Multi-threading is a challenge that you are comfortable tackling.

  • You have a BS in Computer Science or a related field.

jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 104351

Join us as a Transformation Engineer!

Your Mission

At Insight, we empower businesses to transform their operations through innovative cloud solutions. As a premier Workspace and Google Cloud partner, we guide our Customers through complex digital transformations, ensuring seamless adoption and maximizing ROI.

As a customer-facing Transformation Engineer within our Google Workspace Practice, you have a hybrid role, part business analyst, part data modeler, and part application developer. You will be responsible for designing, prototyping, and leading the deployment of scalable applications aimed at enhancing customer utilization of Google Workspace. You’re also hands-on, able to comprehensively test/troubleshoot and build functioning prototypes that prove out ideas and build confidence in the solutions you advocate.

The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on technical expertise with excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, concise business value. You will be known as an established contributor within the team and will develop a reputation with Customers for the quality of your work.You are out in front of our delivery organization, meeting with the spectrum of corporate and enterprise Customers that need our consultative work transformation services. You are excited to help build up Customer developers as they engage with AppSheet and Apps Script.

Expectations

Experience

  • 3+ years of AppSheet experience, having built and deployed multiple apps, with integrations and automation. Additionally, you have experience with complex integrations, governance, mentoring, and architectural input for no-code solutions.

Soft Skills

  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to business users and gather requirements effectively.

  • Strong written communication for creating app documentation, user guides, and process flows.

  • Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, end-users, IT teams, and other developers.

  • AppSheet engineers often work semi-independently, identifying opportunities and building solutions.

  • The no-code/low-code space, and AppSheet specifically, evolves rapidly. A strong desire for continuous learning is essential.

  • Precision in data modeling, expression writing, and configuration is critical to prevent errors.

  • Working with citizen developers and business users often requires patience and understanding of their technical comfort levels.

  • Ability to think outside the box to find novel ways to solve business challenges using AppSheet's capabilities.

Travel- less than 10% travel to Customer sites, conferences, and other related events.

Working Hours- While this role is primarily focused on North America, flexibility may be required due to SADA's, an Insight company, global presence.

Job Requirements

Certificates

  • Cloud Digital Leader, or complete within the first 30 days

  • Generative AI Leader, or complete within the first 60 days

  • Associate Cloud Engineeror able to complete within the first 180 days of employment.

Requirements

  • Ability to build sophisticated mobile and web applications from scratch, leveraging various AppSheet views (forms, dashboards, detail views, cards, maps, charts, etc.).

  • Strong proficiency in AppSheet's expression language for defining logic, calculations, conditional formatting, data validation, security rules, and dynamic behavior.

  • Designing and configuring AppSheet's automation features (events, processes, tasks) to create workflows, send notifications, generate reports, and integrate with other services.

  • Ability to design and manage relational data structures within AppSheet, including understanding table keys, references, and slices.

  • Implementing row-level security, column-level security, user roles, and deployment security best practices.

  • Strong expertise in Google Sheets (advanced formulas, data validation, pivot tables, queries, array formulas) is essential.

  • Experience connecting AppSheet to various data sources like Google Cloud SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL), BigQuery, Excel Online, Salesforce, Smartsheet, or other SQL/NoSQL databases.

  • Ability to integrate AppSheet with external systems and APIs, either directly or through intermediate services.

  • Proficiency in JavaScript and Google Apps Script to extend AppSheet's functionality, create custom integrations with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive), and automate more complex processes beyond native AppSheet Bots.

  • Excellent ability to break down complex problems into smaller, manageable components and design robust logic

  • A tenacity to analyze and solve problems logically, abstract key components from specific details and come up with creative solutions to any problem

  • Time management with the ability to manage multiple streams and concurrent customer projects.

Useful Qualifications

  • Direct experience working with a variety of cloud technologies as well as designing and recommending elegant solutions that drive business outcomes.

  • Experience with developing solutions for large data sets and cloud-based applications.

  • Broad knowledge of systems and application development techniques, database systems/structures, technology tools/products, programming languages.

  • Ability to lead an in-depth client meeting/workshop across a broad range of topics including discovery, cloud compliance and security.

  • Thought leadership with the ability to recommend cloud-native approaches to solve Customer business and technical challenges.

  • Understanding of best practices, design patterns and reference architectures with an uncanny ability to recommend these as needed.

Requisition Number: 105686

Regional Architect Manager

Southeast United States Region

Position Overview

The Regional Architect Manager leads a team of approximately 10 Solutions Architects in the Southeast United States, serving as both a hands-on technical leader and a people-first manager within Insight's North America Infrastructure Solutions organization. This role is part of Insight's presales Solutions Engineering and Architecture function, which designs outcome-based solutions that address complex client challenges across five core infrastructure domains:

1. Cloud, Compute & Storage

2. Security

3. Managed Services

4. AI & Automation

5. Networking, IoT & Edge

Reporting to the Regional Architect Director, who in turn reports to the Vice President of Architecture for North America Infrastructure Solutions, this manager serves as the critical link between Insight's regional sales teams and its technical delivery capabilities. The Regional Architect Manager ensures that every client engagement in the Southeast is grounded in architecturally sound, business-aligned solutions — while simultaneously building a high-performing team culture rooted in technical excellence, continuous learning, and Insight's core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony.

This is a true player/coach role. The Regional Architect Manager combines a diverse technical and industry background with a deep understanding of how technology impacts business environments — remaining hands-on in client-facing solution design while also providing coaching, mentoring, and technical leadership to Architects, Consultants, and Engineers across a broad spectrum of technology and business. This leader partners closely with regional Services Sales Directors, Market Development Executive (MDE) teams, and Insight's broader go-to-market leadership to drive services-led pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and elevate Insight's position as a trusted solutions partner across the Southeast.

Location

Fully remote with travel across the Southeast United States to support client engagements, team development, and regional sales collaboration. Additional travel may be required for national team meetings, partner summits, and industry events.

What You'll Do at Insight

Team Building & Technical Leadership

  • Build, develop, and lead a high-performing team of approximately 10 Solutions Architects in the Southeast region, organized around Insight's five infrastructure solution areas.
  • Foster a unified culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and client-first solutioning that aligns with the broader North America Architecture organization's standards.
  • Define resource allocation and coverage strategies to ensure presales capacity aligns with regional sales demand and growth priorities across the Southeast.
  • Develop career paths, technical certification strategies, and skills roadmaps to ensure your team stays ahead of evolving technology trends.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, technical readiness assessments, and coaching sessions for direct reports, driving both individual growth and team-level performance.
  • Actively aid, educate, and support peer Architects, Consultants, and Engineers across the broader organization — serving as a force multiplier for technical knowledge.

Presales Strategy & Solution Design

  • Own the presales technical strategy for the Southeast region, ensuring architecturally sound and commercially viable solutions are brought to every client engagement.
  • Partner with regional Services Sales Directors and MDE teams to qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy, and deliver compelling technical proposals and presentations.
  • Drive the adoption and regional customization of repeatable solution frameworks, reference architectures, and reusable assets across all five solution areas to accelerate time-to-proposal.
  • Establish and uphold standards of excellence for solution design, scoping accuracy, and technical proposal quality across the Southeast Architecture team.
  • Ensure all proposed solutions align with Insight's outcome-based services approach — translating technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes for clients.
  • Develop Insight proposals that dissect complex business and technical challenges and present clear, actionable solutions.

Client Engagement & Trusted Advisory

  • Own the overall technical relationship (trusted advisor) with pre-assigned accounts and other clients as needs arise across the Southeast region.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with senior IT leaders and key technical stakeholders at Insight's strategic accounts in the region.
  • Lead and participate in architectural workshops, discovery sessions, and whiteboarding engagements for enterprise and strategic accounts.
  • Identify client business and technical requirements for opportunities, championing technical solutions that provide the client the best chance of success.
  • Travel across the Southeast to support your team on complex, multi-domain opportunities and provide hands-on technical leadership on high-profile pursuits.
  • Represent Insight at regional industry events, partner summits, and executive forums as a thought leader in modern infrastructure solutions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Delivery, Managed Services, and Professional Services leadership to ensure seamless handoff from presales design to implementation and ongoing operations.
  • Collaborate with OEM and technology partners (e.g., hyperscalers, security vendors, networking/edge providers) to influence joint solutions and drive co-selling motions.
  • Align with regional sales leadership, including Area VPs and General Managers, to ensure presales architecture resources are strategically deployed against the highest-value opportunities.
  • Work closely with Field Marketing, Solutions Marketing, and Product teams to contribute to thought leadership content, client-facing collateral, and demand generation initiatives.
  • Provide technical input on major proposals, RFP responses, and strategic pursuits across the Southeast region.

Innovation, Strategy & Market Intelligence

jobs.description:
Construyendo sobre nuestro pasado. Listos para el futuro

Worley es una firma global de servicios profesionales compuesta por expertos en energía, productos químicos y recursos. Nos asociamos con clientes para entregar proyectos y crear valor durante la vida útil de sus activos. Estamos uniendo dos mundos, avanzando hacia fuentes de energía más sostenibles y al mismo tiempo ayudamos a proporcionar la energía, los productos químicos y los recursos que se necesitan ahora.

Objetivo del cargo:

Trabajar de forma autónoma a un nivel avanzado en tareas de dibujo y modelamiento, completando una amplia variedad de tareas mediante la aplicación de técnicas y prácticas de dibujo y modelamiento. Debe tener un conocimiento sustancial de buenas prácticas estándar de la industria relevantes para el desarrollo y control de entregables de dibujo y modelamiento. Puede proporcionar supervisión en relación con actividades de dibujo y modelamiento para un proyecto grande, o uno o más proyectos más pequeños.

Responsabilidades:

·Realizar ingenierías conceptuales, básicas y detalladas de proyectos de la industria Oil & Gas, Minería, Infraestructura, entre otros.

·Por lo general, tener experiencia relevante en la disciplina y un conocimiento y comprensión competente de las regulaciones, códigos, estándares de diseño y fabricación, y prácticas estándar de la industria. Adicionalmente debe tener conocimientos sólidos en la estimación de los costos de un proyecto y la redacción de contenidos de propuestas.

·Tomar decisiones responsables para la definición del curso de entregables de ingeniería, dibujo y modelamiento.

·Realizar sus funciones con base en una interacción y orientación técnica autoiniciada con el supervisor (gerente de la disciplina), para posteriormente influenciar sobre los objetivos y deberes de su equipo.

·Desarrollar, asignar y coordinar ofertas técnicas, documentos, planimetrías y levantamientos en campo.

·Elaborar las memorias de cálculo y documentos de soporte para los diseños.

·Iniciar, gestionar y, si es necesario, supervisar los requerimientos del proyecto de ingeniería eléctrica.

·Liderar equipos y brindar mentoría a ingenieros junior y dibujantes (proporcionar guía técnica, información de referencia, asignación de tareas, revisión y aprobación de entregables, entre otros).

·Participar en reuniones relevantes, preparar informes de progreso y seguir los procedimientos de verificación requeridos.

·Garantizar que el alcance del proyecto sea claro y que los cambios cumplan con los procesos de gestión de cambios del proyecto.

·Realizar visitas a campo según requerimientos del proyecto.

·Participar en el desarrollo, revisión y licitación de contratos técnicos.

¿Qué traerás?

  • Entre 5 y 20 años de experiencia como Ingeniero Eléctrico en los sectores de Oil & Gas y/o Refinería.
  • Tener experiencia en revisión y diseño de diagramas unifilares, diagramas de control, bases de diseño, listados de cargas y equipos eléctricos, dimensionamientos de equipos, especificaciones, hojas de datos y requisiciones.
  • Tener conocimientos en diseño de sistemas eléctricos de Alta, media y baja tensión.
  • Habilidad para el desarrollo de estudios eléctricos empleando programas como NEPLAN y ETAP.
  • Soporte en compra de equipos y evaluación técnica de ofertas.
  • Contar con conocimiento de normas técnicas como IEC, IEEE/ANSI.
  • Manejo de SPEL y revisión de modelos en Smart Plan 3D.
  • Tener manejo de programas como Dialux, AutoCAD, Navis Works

En caso de que necesites algún ajuste de accesibilidadpor favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación

Avanzando juntos

Estamos comprometidos a construir un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan hablar y ser escuchados. Brindamos igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todos los solicitantes y empleados calificados sin importar edad, raza, credo, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, ascendencia, estado de discapacidad, estado de veterano, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, información genética, estado civil. estatus, estatus de ciudadanía o cualquier otra base protegida por la ley.

Queremos que nuestra gente esté llena de energía y poder para impulsar un impacto sostenible. Por eso, nos centramos en una cultura inspirada en valores que genere brillantez a través de la pertenencia, la conexión y la innovación.

Estamos construyendo un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso. Crear un espacio donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan ser ellos mismos y ser escuchados.

jobs.title: Sr. Scrum Master/Project Manager
jobs.excerpt: “Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!
jobs.description:
“Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!”

WHO ARE WE?

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based out of San Antonio, TX, but are truly a remote and telecommuting company.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The Senior Scrum Master / Project Manager is the primary guiding authority for Agile ceremonies, structure, and delivery discipline across the engineering organization. This role sets and enforces the standard for how Agile is practiced organization-wide — directly coaching and overseeing a cohort of Scrum Masters across a broad portfolio of teams, while personally serving as the acting Scrum Master for a subset of teams to stay close to day-to-day delivery. The role owns the organization's Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework end-to-end, translating Jira and GitHub activity into trustworthy delivery and quality signals for engineering and business leadership. The Senior Scrum Master / Project Manager is also the primary Agile conduit between Product Management/Product Ownership and the engineering teams, ensuring scaled Agile practices connect roadmap intent to sprint execution cleanly and predictably.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

1. Agile Program Leadership & Scrum Master Coaching

  • Set and enforce the standard for Agile ceremonies and structure across 12 teams; directly coach and performance-support 6–7 Scrum Masters.
  • Maintain a consistent Agile operating model (definitions of ready/done, estimation, cadences, escalation paths) across all teams.
  • Resolve cross-team delivery impediments and run a Scrum Master community of practice.

2. Direct Scrum Mastery

  • Act as Scrum Master for 2 assigned teams — ceremonies, backlog hygiene, and impediment removal — to stay grounded in day-to-day delivery.

3. Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework

Own, implement, and evolve a comprehensive Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework spanning sprint execution, code review discipline, and defect accountability — from first commit through production — using Jira and GitHub as the systems of record.

  • Implement and maintain core delivery metrics in Jira — velocity, sprint predictability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, WIP, scope creep, and carryover rate — at team, sprint, and rolling-quarter cadence.
  • Implement code review rigor metrics from GitHub pull request activity, including change-requested rate, rework commits per PR, review cycles to approval, time in review, and senior reviewer
  • comment density; partner with engineering leadership to maintain branch protection rules and senior-reviewer group definitions that keep this data complete.
  • Own the defect discovery-by-phase taxonomy on the Bug issue type in Jira (Unit/TDD, Code Review, Dev/Integration Testing, QA/Release Testing, Production/Escaped) and the resulting metrics: defect detection distribution, escape rate, production escape rate, phase containment effectiveness, defect density, and mean time to detect.
  • Maintain the escaped-defect attribution chain, linking each bug ticket back to its originating story/task, the merged pull request(s) that implemented it, and the author and reviewers of record, via Jira links and GitHub smart-commit/PR referencing, enabling accountability rollups in either direction.
  • Own the recurring per-release and quarterly Contractor/Team Accountability Rollup reporting cycle, and ensure trend lines (improving, flat, or worsening) are reviewed with the relevant teams and leads, not just presented in aggregate.
  • Own the reporting and BI delivery mechanic for the framework — including administration of eazyBI (or equivalent BI layer) connected to Jira and GitHub — to produce recurring dashboards and reports for engineering and business stakeholders without requiring a separate data pipeline.
  • Continuously refine the framework's guiding principles: metrics must be actionable, paired for balance (speed vs. quality), system-focused rather than individual-focused (with defect attribution as the narrow, explicitly scoped exception), trend-driven, diagnostic rather than target-driven, and passively instrumented from existing Jira/GitHub workflow artifacts.

4. Agile Conduit for Product Management

  • Serve as the primary Agile conduit between Product Managers, Product Owners, and the engineering organization, translating roadmap and portfolio intent into scaled Agile execution across the 12 teams.
  • Apply scaled Agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum@Scale, or the organization's equivalent) to coordinate cross-team dependencies, program increment / release planning, and backlog alignment between Product and Engineering.
  • Facilitate program-level ceremonies (e.g., PI planning, scrum-of-scrums, cross-team dependency reviews) that connect Product Owner intent with the delivery capacity and constraints of the 12 teams.
  • Provide Product Management and Product Ownership with visibility into delivery health and quality signals from the Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework to inform prioritization and roadmap tradeoffs.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

Performance at this level is evaluated across four dimensions:

Agile Program Delivery

  • Ceremonies across all 12 teams consistently meet the organization's defined Agile standard, with impediments identified and escalated proactively rather than discovered after the fact.
  • The 2 directly run teams deliver predictably, with healthy sprint predictability and carryover metrics.

Metrics & Quality Accountability

  • The Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework remains accurate, current, and trusted — data completeness (linkage, tagging, discovery-phase fields) is maintained across teams.
  • Reporting and BI dashboards are delivered on a reliable cadence and are actively used by engineering and business leadership in decision-making.

Organizational Impact & Coaching

  • Scrum Masters who report into this role demonstrably improve in facilitation quality, impediment resolution, and Agile maturity over time.
  • Escaped-defect and code-review-rigor trends across teams move in a positive direction release over release.

Leadership & Communication

  • Serves as a trusted, low-friction conduit between Product and Engineering, with dependencies and tradeoffs surfaced early rather than at the point of conflict.
  • Communicates delivery risk, quality trends, and program status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Project Manager in a professional software development environment, including experience coaching or leading other Scrum Masters.
  • Demonstrated experience running Agile ceremonies and delivery practices across multiple concurrent teams.
  • Working knowledge of scaled Agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum@Scale, LeSS) and experience serving as a conduit between Product Management/Product Ownership and engineering teams.
  • Hands-on proficiency administering Jira for Agile delivery, including custom fields, workflows, and sprint/board configuration.
  • Working knowledge of GitHub pull request workflows, branch protection, and Jira–GitHub linkage (smart commits) sufficient to own a metrics framework built on that data.
  • Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and evolve delivery and quality metrics programs, and to translate them into reporting that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tooling and workflows.

WHAT SETS YOU APART?

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification; SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Program Consultant) a plus.
  • Direct experience administering eazyBI (or a comparable BI/reporting layer) against Jira and GitHub data.
  • Experience building or maturing a defect discovery and escaped-defect attribution framework.
  • Experience working in regulated environments with compliance requirements (HIPAA, HITECH, PCI DSS, or similar).

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The company sponsors health insurance, long-term disability, and life insurance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • 10 paid Holidays.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Work Anniversary Bonus.
  • Participation in the Employee of the Quarter Program.
  • Monthly $100 Connectivity Stipend Reimbursement.
  • RealTime matches employee 401K contributions at 100% of the first 3% invested and 50% of the next 2% invested.

All successful candidates must complete and pass reference and background checks.

The desired salary must be indicated for the application to be considered.

The pay rate is commensurate with experience and is determined on an individual basis after an interview has occurred.

Equal Opportunity Employer – RealTime eClinical Solutions strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in all of its policies and practices, including employment.

Your Right to Work – In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility.

Thank you for your interest in RealTime eClinical Solutions.
