jobs.description:
Arcadis jest wiodącą na świecie firmą dostarczającą zrównoważone rozwiązania w zakresie projektowania, inżynierii oraz konsultingu dla zasobów naturalnych i obiektów budowlanych.

Jesteśmy zespołem ponad 34 000 osób w ponad 30 krajach, których wspólnym celem jest poprawa jakości życia. Każdy z nas odgrywa ważną rolę. Dzięki sile wielu ciekawych umysłów możemy wspólnie rozwiązywać najbardziej złożone wyzwania świata i tworzyć jeszcze większy wpływ.

PROJECT PLANNER

lokalizacja: cała Polska

Zakres obowiązków:

  • Sporządzenie oraz nadzór nad harmonogramem projektu począwszy od fazy uzyskiwania pozwoleń administracyjnych, poprzez prowadzenie robót budowlanych, oraz odbiory techniczne i urzędowe.
  • Nadzór nad harmonogramem dostaw, montażu, testów i uruchomienia instalacji technologicznych.
  • Monitorowanie terminów dostaw kluczowych urządzeń oraz analiza ich wpływu na harmonogram projektu.
  • Inicjowanie i wdrażanie działań naprawczych w celu realizacji projektu w założonych ramach czasowych.
  • Sporządzanie raportów tygodniowych oraz miesięcznych, uczestnictwo w spotkaniach z koordynacyjnych z wykonawcami robót oraz inwestorem.
  • Aktywne wsparcie kierownika projektu oraz zespołu inspektorów nadzoru w zakresie terminowości prowadzonych robót.

Kwalifikacje i doświadczenie:

  • Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne; budownictwo lub pokrewne.
  • Praktyczna znajomość zależności harmonogramowych pomiędzy robotami budowlanymi, elektrycznymi oraz instalacją i uruchomieniem urządzeń technologicznych.
  • Co najmniej dwuletnie doświadczenie zawodowe w pełnieniu funkcji planisty w branży budowlanej przy realizacji projektów budowlanych, doświadczenie w realizacji projektów przemysłowych, energetycznych, infrastrukturalnych lub magazynów energii będzie dużym atutem.
  • Praktyczna wiedza z zakresu planowania procesów produkcyjnych, oraz zrozumienie zależności pomiędzy poszczególnymi branżami budowlanymi w trakcie prowadzenia robót budowlanych.
  • Dobra znajomość języka polskiego i angielskiego również w zakresie słownictwa budowlanego, umożliwiająca swobodną komunikację oraz pisanie raportów technicznych w tym języku.
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość programu MS Project oraz pakietu MS Office
  • Umiejętność pracy w zespole oraz wysokie umiejętności organizacyjne i interpersonalne.
  • Duża motywacja i zaangażowanie w wykonywaną pracę.
  • Prawo jazdy kat. B oraz mobilność.

Dlaczego Arcadis?

Możemy osiągać nasze cele wyłącznie wtedy, gdy każdy ma przestrzeń, by być najlepszą wersją siebie. Wierzymy, że wkład każdego pracownika ma znaczenie. Dlatego jako jedni z pionierów rozwijamy podejście oparte na kompetencjach, które umożliwia wykorzystanie unikalnego doświadczenia i wiedzy do kształtowania własnej kariery oraz maksymalizowania wpływu, jaki możemy wywierać razem.

W Arcadis wykonujesz pracę, która ma znaczenie — niezależnie od stanowiska przyczyniasz się do tworzenia zrównoważonych rozwiązań na rzecz bardziej prosperującej planety. Zostaw swój ślad: w swojej karierze, wśród współpracowników, u klientów, w swoim życiu i w świecie, który nas otacza. Razem możemy stworzyć trwałe dziedzictwo.

Dołącz do Arcadis. Twórz Dziedzictwo.

Nasze zobowiązanie w zakresie Równości, Różnorodności, Inkluzywności i Przynależności

Chcemy, abyś każdego dnia mógł/mogła wnosić do pracy to, co najlepsze — dlatego traktujemy równość bardzo poważnie i rozliczamy się z naszych działań. Naszą ambicją jest być pracodawcą z wyboru i zapewniać doskonałe miejsce pracy wszystkim naszym ludziom

Wierzymy, że różnorodne zespoły, łączące osoby o odmiennych doświadczeniach, tworzą najbardziej innowacyjne idee. Równość, różnorodność i inkluzja są kluczowymi elementami naszej misji poprawy jakości życia — realizujemy je wspólnie w ramach sześciu obszarów ED&I: Wiek, Niepełnosprawność, Wiara, Płeć, LGBT+ oraz Rasa. Zróżnicowany i wysoko wykwalifikowany zespół jest niezbędny do naszego sukcesu.

Przedział wynagrodzenia dla tego stanowiska wynosi 11'741 - 17'600 PLN brutto.

P&C-Atuação com rotinas de Recursos Humanos, trabalhando com soluções para gestão de Pessoas e Cultura, podendo fazer parte de subáreas como People Solutions, Talent Attraction, People Career e People Xperience.

Hiring Manager: [[hiringManagerName]]

Senior Field Clinical Engineer - Talent Pool

(Remote with up to 50% travel; desired candidate'ss location: Prague, Czech Republic)

Please note- this is only an opportunity to join our Talent Comunity, it is not linked to a specific vacancy.

About This Role

At Boston Scientific, your work helps advance innovative cardiac technologies that improve patients’ lives. As a Senior Field Clinical Engineer, you will play a key, hands-on role in supporting both pre- and post-market clinical trials, working directly with leading cardiac centers in Czechia and across Europe.

This role is ideal for someone who values autonomy, ownership, and close collaboration with clinicians. You will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of clinical trial activities at assigned sites, acting as a trusted clinical and technical partner for investigators and hospital teams. The position offers strong visibility within an international clinical organization and exposure to European-level clinical programs.

The role is based in the Czech Republic and requires regular travel within Czechia and across Europe to support clinical activities.

Work mode: Remote, with up to 50% travel.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you will serve as a key clinical interface between Boston Scientific and investigational sites. You will support studies from early site engagement through patient enrollment and follow-up, directly contributing to study quality, patient safety, and the successful development of future cardiac therapies.

You will work independently in the field while remaining closely connected to a collaborative, international clinical team.

What You Will Do:

  • Own the day-to-day execution of clinical trials within your assigned territory, ensuring sites are prepared, supported, and engaged throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for investigators and site staff, providing clinical, technical, and procedural expertise.
  • Support site qualification, initiation, and enrollment readiness activities, including IRB support and investigator training.
  • Deliver hands-on technical support during electrophysiology (EP) procedures and follow-up visits, working directly in cath lab and clinical environments.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with physicians and clinical teams, supporting sustained engagement in clinical programs.
  • Lead clinical initiatives and projects, contributing to continuous improvement of study execution and site performance.
  • Collaborate closely with internal clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders to ensure aligned and effective trial delivery.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Clinical Engineering, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
  • Experience in the medical device industry, clinical research, field clinical engineering, sales support, or as a cardiac physiologist.
  • Hands-on experience in electrophysiology (EP) ablation procedures.
  • Ability to work independently in a field-based role, with a proactive and collaborative mindset.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with physicians and clinical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%, including international travel within Europe.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with EP mapped ablation procedures
  • Familiarity with clinical trial operations, site management, and clinical documentation

What We Offer:

At Boston Scientific, we support our employees both professionally and personally. In this role, you can expect:

  • Private medical care, lunch card and life insurance
  • Annual performance-based bonus
  • Company car or car allowance to support frequent travel within Czechia and across Europe
  • Flexible working model with a remote setup and autonomy in organizing your field activities
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities, including technical training, clinical education, and participation in international projects
  • Collaboration within a highly skilled, international clinical team across Europe
  • The opportunity to work closely with leading hospitals and physicians while supporting clinical programs across Czechia and other European countries
  • A company culture focused on innovation, ethics, and meaningful patient impact

Requisition ID:625270

As a leader in medical science for more than 40 years, we are committed to solving the challenges that matter most – united by a deep caring for human life. Our mission to advance science for life is about transforming lives through innovative medical solutions that improve patient lives, create value for our customers, and support our employees and the communities in which we operate. Now more than ever, we have a responsibility to apply those values to everything we do – as a global business and as a global corporate citizen.

So, choosing a career with Boston Scientific (NYSE: BSX) isn’t just business, it’s personal. And if you’re a natural problem-solver with the imagination, determination, and spirit to make a meaningful difference to people worldwide, we encourage you to apply and look forward to connecting with you!

POSITION SUMMARY

Radiology Associates of Florida is excited to open a new remote overnight diagnostic radiology position to add to our growing team in emergency radiology.

Job Details:

  • 7 on 14 off schedule
  • Shift hours: Flexible start times starting at 9pm EST
  • W2 or 1099 options

What You Can Expect:

  • Case mix: Bread-and-butter emergency radiology, including trauma and strokes
  • No mammography required
  • MosaicOS™ is RP’s next-generation operating system for imaging. It’s a cloud-based, AI-native platform that brings everything a radiologist uses into one seamless environment. Instead of jumping between disconnected systems, your reporting, viewing, worklists and AI tools live in one place.
  • Internal moonlighting opportunities – read as much or as little as you prefer
  • Work tailored to your strengths, with subspecialty radiologist support available
  • Strong relationships with referring physicians and consistent clinical exposure to a defined group of facilities

We have crafted this role to have the convenience of a teleradiologist position with the stability, teamwork, and quality of a premier hybrid academic-private practice. While you will have the convenience of working from home, you will develop a relationship with your referring physicians and radiologist colleagues as you service a limited set of clients rather than a sprawling network across multiple time zones. This team of radiologists will work together, so no single radiologist will be working without support, even at night.

Not only will you be working with some of the best radiologists, but the practice will be providing you with Remote Radiology Assistants to improve your workflow and job satisfaction. They will make sure cases are ready for your interpretation by making sure all images and prior studies are available. They will prepare your report templates with filled-in contrast doses, prior reports, and numerical measurements. This will minimize non-clinical distractions and data entry tasks.

We enjoy a state-of-the-art unified PACS software suite that aggregates all our sites onto one smart worklist, which distributes cases intelligently based on your workload and areas of expertise. Built into PACS are convenient collaboration tools that make it easy to share cases and consult with colleagues remotely as it would be in a communal reading room. There are also built-in communication tools to reach our 24/7 radiology assistant concierges and IT support, minimizing your need to pick up the phone. We also have a growing suite of artificial intelligence support tools to automatically handle repetitive tasks like searching for evidence-based guidelines, and free access to point-of-care decision support solutions.

We offer competitive pay with bonus opportunities and abundant 100%-voluntary per-click moonlighting on your off weeks. Expect a full suite of benefits and pre-tax salary deductions for education and business expenses. Our dedicated staff will handle all licensing and credentialing needs.

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW

RAF is a leading radiology practice in Florida. We serve the most prestigious, established health systems in the state, including on the east and west coasts, the Florida Panhandle, and the Keys. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibility in study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at the cutting edge, encouraging subspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, and facilitating collaboration and consultation between our radiologists.

Our state-of-the-art IT suite includes universal PACS across the practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets. Mosaic Reporting™ uses ambient AI and large language models (LLMs) to structure reports as you speak naturally. You can dictate as if you’re teaching a fellow. Just describe what you see, and Mosaic builds the structured report automatically, even inserting normal findings for you.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders. We are the teaching physicians for the University of South Florida Department of Radiology in Tampa. In Sarasota, our physicians’ staff the Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists work and socialize together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to know us better!

Get to know our practice!

  • Candidates must be a Doctor of Medicine or Osteopathy and residency trained in the practice of Diagnostic Radiology
  • Board eligible or certified by the American Board of Radiology or the American Osteopathic Board of Radiology
  • Candidates with fellowship training in any sub-specialty will be considered in addition to non-fellowship trained General Radiologists
  • Medical license or the ability to obtain a license in the state of FL
  • Fellows and residents welcome to apply

The voice that turns a quiet client database into real conversations about buying or selling.

Real Estate Agent

$4–$6/hr USD - DOE

Fully remote

Tools

Contact list (previously used Follow Up Boss and RealGeeks), email, SMS/text platform, Facebook, Instagram

Role Overview

This role reactivates our client's existing database of past clients, referrals, and leads through email, text, and social media outreach — generating renewed interest in buying or selling a home. The Real Estate Sales Executive does not close deals; they generate and qualify interest, then hand off warm conversations to the agents for closing.

Key Responsibilities

Database Outreach & Reactivation

  • Send emails and text messages to contacts in the client's database to reopen the conversation about buying or selling
  • Track outreach activity: who was contacted, who responded, and who needs follow-up
  • Personalize outreach based on each contact's history (past client, old lead, referral)

Social Media Outreach

  • Reach out to relevant contacts via Facebook and Instagram messages
  • Identify and engage people showing buying or selling signals on social platforms
  • Keep messaging warm and personal — this is relationship reactivation, not cold advertising

Lead Qualification & Handoff

  • Identify when a contact shows genuine interest in buying or selling
  • Log conversation context clearly so the agents can pick it up without missing anything
  • Hand off qualified conversations promptly so momentum isn't lost

Tracking & Reporting

  • Keep a simple, current record of outreach activity and responses
  • Flag which messages get replies and which contacts are warming up

Who Will Succeed

This role is steady, repetitive, and relationship-driven. The person who thrives here doesn't get discouraged by silence or 'no' — they stay warm, consistent, and genuinely curious about people.

  • You're comfortable with repetitive outreach and don't take non-responses personally
  • You write and message in a natural, warm tone — never scripted or salesy
  • You're organized — nothing you send or hear back goes untracked
  • You're comfortable on social media and know how to message people without feeling like a stranger
  • You use AI tools to draft and personalize outreach faster, without losing the human touch
  • You know the difference between generating interest and closing a deal — and you're energized by the first part

    Experience & Skills
  • Required: Some familiarity with real estate concepts (buying/selling process, what a lead or database contact looks like) — not necessarily an expert
  • Required: Some experience with outreach, ISA (inside sales), or lead generation work — cold or warm outreach experience counts

  • Required: AI expertise — genuinely skilled with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) for drafting, personalizing, and speeding up outreach; this is a real capability, not casual use, and will be assessed
  • Required: Full overlap with Pacific Time required — not partial coordination
  • Required: Comfortable managing outreach across multiple channels (email, SMS, Facebook, Instagram) at once

    -Preferred:     Prior experience with a real estate CRM or database system

Pre-Sales Solutions Architect - AWS

This role is eligible for full-time remote employment within the US or can be hybrid in our Durham, NC office 2-3 days/week. Please note that we unfortunately cannot sponsor H1B visas at this time. Aprio participates in the US Government's eVerify Program.

Who We Are

Modern enterprises run their most critical applications in complex, cloud-native environments, and the threats keep multiplying: outages, ransomware, bad actors, human error. Most disaster recovery tools stop at backing up data. We’ve built the next generation of cloud resiliency and disaster recovery for AWS with an automated, application-aware platform that recovers a company's entire application stack, not isolated resources, in under an hour. We protect production workloads for enterprises that cut across multiple industries like healthcare, financial services, and SaaS — the kind of companies that can't afford downtime.

At Arpio, we believe great companies are built by people who take ownership, move with urgency, and consistently deliver results. We just closed our $15M Series A to expand into new clouds and build out our roadmap, which means we're growing the team right now, and your work will directly shape where we go next.

This isn't simply another job. It's an opportunity to help build a company.

About the Role

As a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect at Arpio, you will play a pivotal role in our Go-to-Market team. This dynamic and rewarding position requires a mix of technical expertise, cloud infrastructure passion, and sales acumen. You will engage in both pre-sales and post-sales processes, collaborating closely with our account team to convert opportunities into success stories.

In this role, you will serve as the technical lead between clients, partners, and our internal teams. You will be responsible for working alongside the sales team in delivering Proof of Concept (POC) engagements through the entire sales cycle; helping prospects understand not just what Arpio does, but why it is the right answer for their specific AWS environment.

We move fast, hold ourselves accountable to outcomes, and treat every customer relationship as something worth protecting. If you are energized by solving hard technical problems, thrive in ambiguity, and want to help build a function from the ground up, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Pre-Sales & Deal Execution

  • Contribute to regional sales, POC, and GTM strategy alongside New Logo and Strategic Growth AEs
  • Discover and create prospect-specific, quantifiable value statements that directly impact deals, translating RTO/RPO gaps, downtime costs, and ransomware exposure into business cases that resonate with both technical and economic buyers
  • Lead product demonstrations and POC engagements end-to-end, tailored to each prospect's AWS environment and resilience requirements
  • Respond to RFPs, security questionnaires, and enterprise procurement documentation with accuracy and speed

Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Listen first. Understand the customer's problem deeply before proposing a solution; respond quickly and communicate proactively throughout every evaluation
  • Develop and maintain working relationships with AWS and Azure field teams to support co-sell motions
  • Travel regionally to client sites as required

Internal Collaboration & Enablement

  • Work closely with Account Executives and internal stakeholders across product, marketing, and customer success
  • Feed technical insights, product gaps, and competitive intelligence back to product and engineering. Your field observations shape our roadmap
  • Help build the solutions engineering playbook from the ground up; your patterns become the foundation for future SE hires
  • Be a reliable member of the team, providing coverage and support to customers and peers when needed

How We Work

At Arpio, we care about the outcome as much as the effort it took to get there. We take initiative, follow through, and report back on what we learned along the way. That same instinct shows up in how we treat customers and each other: we respond quickly, speak honestly and openly, and trust our teammates to take direct feedback as a chance to grow. We move like a startup because we are one, spending wisely and treating every dollar and every customer like they matter, because they do. If that's how you like to work, you'll fit in well here. For this role, that looks like:

  • You prepare before every call. You know the prospect’s stack, their likely concerns, and what a successful POC looks like before you join the meeting
  • You are honest about what the product can and cannot do. Your credibility with technical buyers is your most valuable asset — you don’t oversell
  • You own the outcome. You track your own work, identify risks early, and ask for help before it’s too late
  • You execute with urgency and diligence, every customer, every deal, and every day counts
  • You share what you learn. Wins, losses, and near-misses all make the team better when knowledge isn’t siloed
  • You assume positive intent in interactions with colleagues and customers, and you welcome direct feedback as an opportunity to grow
  • You are comfortable with the ambiguity of an early-stage company and energized by the chance to shape how things are done

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical sales role in B2B SaaS
  • Hands-on experience with AWS. You understand how these environments are architected, not just how to talk about them
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical evaluations and POCs from scoping through completion in enterprise or upper mid-market accounts
  • Strong technical depth in one or more of: cloud infrastructure, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, cybersecurity, data protection, or ransomware resilience
  • Ability to consult at all levels - C-suite, infrastructure leads, security teams, procurement, and finance
  • Experience presenting technical cloud solutions to clients and channel partners
  • Proven ability to complete RFPs, security questionnaires, and enterprise procurement documentation
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills
  • Ability to work as part of a team in an innovative and fast-paced startup environment while delivering to deadlines
  • Passion for staying current with cloud infrastructure and DR trends, and a willingness to continuously develop your skillset

Salary and Benefits

  • Competitive salary + Equity
  • Arpio will cover 100% of your personal medical premiums, 100% of your life insurance premium, and 75% of your personal premiums for vision and dental (because the insurance companies won’t let us pay 100%). For your dependents, Arpio will cover 75% of medical, dental, and vision premiums. No life insurance is included.
  • For fully remote employees, a $125 home office stipend or $250 company-subsidized co-working membership
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Small, collaborative team environment
  • Opportunity to work on the cutting edge of cloud technology

Follow up and increase the performance of each sales representative in the region by making double visits and carrying out periodical coaching. This is a first level of sales management.

As a National Account Manager, you will own the entertainment business, uniquely positioned for a bold leader who is craving full ownership and accountability. This person is the expert related to sourcing, food and beverage and operational execution, working to drive strong performance through marketing and culinary initiatives and influencing entertainment decision makers to drive Kraft Heinz AFH product sales and visibility.

This is not a traditional sales role. We are searching for a candidate who shows a high level of ownership for their business and is adept at selling solutions and has a proven track record to win new business. The right candidate will be eager to be an influential leader and activator key partners from day one. This role reports to the Associate Director of Chain Restaurant Sales with dotted line reporting to AD Equipment, and strong connectivity with Head of BAP/Sr Manager BAP.

  • ​​Liaise between Kraft Heinz and entertainment to develop influential relationships with key decision makers across procurement, culinary and entertainment teams.

  • ​Ensures continued flawless execution and implementation of expansion initiatives over the course of the term for product and equipment.

  • ​Provide onsite operational training related to KHC products and equipment.

  • ​Proactively owns S&OP communication and collaboration with hypercare team related to forecasting, PO management, supply updates, fill rates, on time delivery, waste mitigation, etc.

  • ​Leads strategic planning with F&B to secure new biz, equipment, innovation and/or renovation launches (including co creation). ​

Expected Experience & Required Skills

  • ​​​Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.

  • ​5 to 7 years proven sales experience required centered around profitable volume growth, and breadth and depth of customer relationships and influence.

  • ​Experience in restaurant, culinary, and/or distributor industry.

  • ​Strong interpersonal skills with ability to influence independently across various levels of stakeholders internally and externally.

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is seeking an EMEA Sales Senior Account Manager for Smart Spaces & Local Government. In this role, you will own strategic relationships with leading cities, public-sector organizations, and smart-space operators, positioning NVIDIA’s platforms and AI Factory strategy as the engine for modernizing public services and competitiveness across the region. You will uncover and develop new opportunities, expand NVIDIA’s regional footprint, and work with cross-functional teams to accelerate adoption of AI and Digital Twins in city environments. In the Senior Account Manager role, passionate about Enterprise Sales, you will lead strategic relationships with leading cities, local governments, and smart-space operators. You will present NVIDIA’s platform, ecosystem, and AI Factory strategy as the driving force behind improvements in public services, economic competitiveness, and citizens’ daily lives. You will identify new opportunities, expand NVIDIA’s footprint across regions, and work with cross-functional teams to accelerate AI and Digital Twin adoption in city environments.

What you will be doing:

  • Crafting revenue growth for NVIDIA’s Smart Cities, Smart Spaces, and Local Government solutions—with a focus on AI Factories, digital twins, physical infrastructure intelligence, generative AI, and computer vision.

  • Build robust pipeline and supporting governments deploy AI responsibly across mobility, urban planning, sustainability, energy efficiency, public safety, inspection, and citizen services.

  • Developing long-term relationships with senior city leaders, CIOs, CTOs, ministers, mayors’ offices, public-sector agencies, and ecosystem partners to position NVIDIA as their trusted AI transformation partner.

  • Lead a robust pipeline connected to priority initiatives: digital twins for planning, VLM-powered video analytics, agentic AI for public service automation, and sovereign AI strategies for local governments

  • Engage with various NVIDIA technology partners and identify areas of collaboration from technical to business needs.

  • Influencing industry standards and guidelines, helping build policy, governance models, and responsible AI approaches across European and EMEA public-service markets.

  • Driving talent development and local capacity building, helping cities create innovation hubs and develop the next generation of public-sector AI skills

What we need to see:

  • BSc in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

  • 8+ years of proven ability in technology systems, AI platforms, cloud/edge software, or vertical public-sector transformation.

  • Experience working with public-sector entities, including local government, city councils, ministries, smart-city authorities, urban mobility agencies, or critical infrastructure operators.

  • Strong negotiation, opportunity management, and deal-closing abilities.

  • Ability to build influence across political, technical, and operational collaborators.

  • Excellent communication and executive-presence skills, with the ability to present sophisticated AI concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Leadership skills: self-starter, autonomous, high integrity, and collaborative.

  • Ability to travel across EMEA.

  • Language requirements: Proficient in English, German.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Proven success with large city or national digital-transformation projects.

  • Experience delivering AI or digital twin outcomes with measurable community impact.

  • Passion for NVIDIA’s mission, AI innovation, and building sovereign AI capabilities with governments.

  • Ability to articulate critical thinking clearly—both the “why” and the “how.”

  • Inspirational communication style capable of mobilizing partners and collaborators.

As an Area Distributor Manager (ADM),- Dallas, Texas, you will play a critical front-line sales role, driving Kraft Heinz’s Away From Home market share and profitability within a designated geographic territory. This is not a traditional sales role—we are looking for a candidate who takes full ownership of their business, excels at selling solutions, and has a proven track record of winning new business. The ideal candidate will be a leader, influencer, and activator from day one, collaborating with both internal and external stakeholders. This role provides direct contributions to Kraft Heinz’s business growth while offering valuable sales experience that can be leveraged for future career opportunities.

Location: Dallas, Texas

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

· Lead the assigned geographic market in the Foodservice Field Sales organization, driving branded market share and profitability in alignment with Kraft Heinz values.

· Execute all elements of the Foodservice ADM playbook to ensure market success.

· Develop and implement profitable sales strategies with local distributors, collaborate with brokers and assist operators as needed.

· Build and maintain strong distributor relationships, supporting local events and initiatives.

· Drive penetration of high-priority SKUs, focusing on strategic, branded, and profit-oriented products.

· Identify and manage a pipeline of high-value sales opportunities, collaborating with the Sales Operations Planning team, Finance and Supply.

· Own the bottom-up sales planning process for your territory, crafting data-driven proposals based on customer needs and market insights.

· Lead the full sales cycle—from generating interest to securing commitments and closing deals.

· Meet and exceed assigned revenue targets.

· Manage trade budgets related to distributors, as well as business and travel expenses.

· Execute quarterly and annual sales and marketing priorities, including new product launches and limited-time offers.

· Support the Sales Ops & Planning team by accurately forecasting product demand and submitting Volume Submission Forms (VSFs) for new and renewed business.

· Establish Joint Business Plans (JBP) with distributors, ensuring regular reviews and execution of agreed-upon actions.

· Support the Order to Cash process by assisting with distributor orders, resolving invoice discrepancies, and managing payment-related issues.

· Experience in direct sales, account management, or business development within the foodservice or hospitality industry is beneficial.

· Ability to analyze sales data, market trends, and financial reports to make informed business decisions. Includes the ability to leverage data to track sales performance, plan effectively, and develop winning strategies.

jobs.description:
Description

Asst Director , Product Research, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a nimble, high-performance team addressing a strategic and high-visibility opportunity for a Fortune 100 company? Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions is working to develop solutions for the future of transportation, and we’re seeking a consultant to support product research and development for new mobility insurance products. You will be responsible for drafting and maintaining coverage language and forms, in addition to assessing product compliance. You will also prepare and collaborate on internal filings, as well as analyze competitor filings. Join us as we work with the firms that are changing the way people and goods move – including autonomous vehicles, ridehail, car sharing, subscription, micromobility, and more.

This role requires a highly adaptive and innovative approach to coverage design, including development of manuscript solutions for emerging mobility and autonomous vehicle risks where traditional insurance frameworks may not yet exist. The role will operate at the intersection of product, underwriting, claims, legal, and strategy to help shape scalable insurance solutions for evolving transportation models.

This role will help drive the development of mobility segment products and segment strategies to help us stay ahead of and capitalize on the disruptions we see and anticipate in the transportation space. A key to success in this role (and for the success of our team) will be the ability to adapt the traditional capabilities of commercial lines and personal lines insurance products to appropriately address the coverage needs of our mobility customers.

The role will play a key part in evaluating and designing coverage approaches for emerging risks associated with autonomous vehicles, teleoperation, platform liability, mixed fleet models, and evolving mobility ecosystems — often in environments where market standards and regulatory frameworks are still developing.

As part of the Mobility Solutions team, you will be involved with a top priority cross-business unit initiative aimed at positioning our company for success as transportation evolves. With a number of new mobility products already in market, this role will be responsible for executing on opportunities to improve and expand our portfolio.

Responsibilities:

• Product Development – You will be responsible for managing multiple Mobility product form and contract initiatives, including the preparation of filings. You'll analyze information from various resources and be able to make recommendations while working with others across LMMS. You will be innovating with other teams in order to design and develop coverage language for new products in a fast-paced environment.

• Coverage Innovation & Emerging Risk Design– Design and evolve manuscript coverage solutions for emerging mobility and AV exposures. Evaluate novel liability and operational models involving autonomous systems, teleoperation, platform liability, and mixed fleet structures. Partner across underwriting, claims, legal, actuarial, and strategy teams to develop commercially viable and scalable coverage approaches in areas where market standards are still emerging.

• Market/Product Research – You’ll be responsible for answering inquiries related to coverages, forms, manuscripts, and contracts. You will monitor bureau and state legislative activity, evaluating impacts to our existing Mobility products, as well as how competitors address coverage. Your insights on the current and competitor coverage landscape will be key to driving towards our profitability goals.

• Project Management - You will drive and coordinate cross-functional coverage initiatives, working closely with teammates in other functions (including partnerships, underwriting, pricing, and claims) and business units to build on our competitive advantage and enhance our positioning in the marketplace. Typical coverage work will be focused on pursuing new business opportunities, renewing key accounts, building critical capabilities, and building thought leadership in the marketplace.

Ideal candidate:

• Prior product experience with analyzing and drafting commercial insurance policy contracts, as well as preparing filings and responding to objections.

• Experience drafting manuscript coverage language and navigating complex or non-standard insurance structures strongly preferred.

• Project management experience working cross-functionally with multiple stakeholders.

• Prior experience pulling and reviewing competitor filings beneficial.

• Highly developed critical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.

• Prior experience in Claims, Underwriting, and/or Compliance in the insurance industry is helpful.

• Experience with Commercial Auto and/or General Liability products is preferable.

• Experience with emerging mobility, autonomous vehicle, transportation network company (TNC), specialty casualty, or other evolving risk environments is strongly preferred.

• Track record of framing decisions and recommending trade-offs.

• Demonstrated ability to build relationships and influence others (both with and without authority).

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple initiatives.

Qualifications
  • Master's degree or equivalent in mathematics, economics, statistics, or other quantitative field
  • Minimum 6 years relevant work experience, typically 8 years
  • PhD or equivalent research beneficial
  • Expert skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (eg, SAS, Emblem)
  • Must have exceptional planning, analytical, decision making, communication, and project management skills
  • Experience managing projects preferred

Job Summary:

Reviews new and existing small to mid contract risks submitted by assigned field offices to confirm compliance with Liberty Mutual Surety's underwriting strategies, guidelines and marketing objectives. Utilizes objective perspective to identify omissions in underwriting detail, if any, confirm attributes and/or weaknesses of case and ratifies parameters of credit recommended for specific risks, with primary objective of achieving profitability for the department. Makes appropriate recommendations to senior Home Office staff on business above authority level or outside of standard underwriting guidelines. Manage audit function associated with the Surety Plus contract book of business using analytical tools.

Liberty Mutual Surety, a business unit of Liberty Mutual Insurance, is the world’s largest globally Surety, including in the United States. Conducting business worldwide through fronting relationships and Liberty-owned subsidiaries, we provide bonds in over 60 countries for construction firms, manufacturers and suppliers, and commercial enterprises on an account and transactional basis. We are committed to building mutually profitable relationships by providing smart business solutions, ease of doing business, and consistent, responsive service. Liberty Mutual Surety is dedicated to the communities we serve and highly values a diverse workforce in more than 18 countries.

Responsibilities:

  • Underwrites new and existing contract account submissions of a wide range in size and complexity utilizing underwriting authority granted by Chief Underwriting Officer.
  • Makes thorough evaluations and assessments of a contractor's financial, technical, organizational, and management capacities, as well as a subjective judgment of character, normally based upon data/insights provided by the field organization. In some cases, will meet with client to facilitate above assessments.
  • Monitors existing contract book of business from an underwriting standpoint using analytical tools.
  • Continuously evaluates the qualitative characteristics of the business (new and existing) in each of the field offices assigned to be his/her responsibility.
  • Assesses and identifies changes in all aspects of the business including, but not limited to, work program to financial strength criteria, nature of work performed (inherent risk), accuracy and timeliness of data flow, and exposure analyses.
  • Coordinates and surfaces issues to more senior Home Office staff and Bond Managers in the field offices on a regular and timely basis.

If the selected candidate lives within 50 miles of a GRS office, then the selected candidate should be prepared to come into the office two days/week. This policy is subject to change.

Ideally, the selected candidate can work a standard Pacific Time Zone schedule.

  • A minimum of 10 years of experience with progressive surety underwriting responsibility expected.
  • Prior field experience, including management experience, with an emphasis on underwriting large/complex obligations/programs desired.
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully manage underwriting oversight, preferably in multiple offices.
  • Must possess in-depth knowledge of surety industry, products, and operations, including the ability to analyze highly complex obligations/programs.

Description

Lead With Expertise. Deliver Impact That Matters. Grow With a Company That Invests in You.

At Liberty Mutual, we show up for people in their toughest moments, and we show up for our employees with the same commitment. Our Complex Casualty Claims Team is expanding, and we’re seeking a Senior Claims Resolution Specialist who brings deep technical expertise, sharp critical thinking, and a passion for doing what’s right. We are currently hiring for the Northwest Regionsdue to this growth.

If you’re energized by the challenge of managing high‑exposure, complex, and catastrophic injury claims, and you want to work in an environment where professionalism, integrity, and empathy guide everything we do, this is the role for you.

🌟 What Makes This Role Special

You Own the Complex Work

You’ll be the point person on severe and catastrophic auto and homeowner’s casualty claims, navigating litigation, partnering with counsel, and driving strategy.

Your Expertise Is Valued

Your judgment plays a key role in shaping outcomes. You’ll influence decisions on some of our most significant claims, backed by leaders who respect your experience.

Flexibility Meets Purpose

This role is remote or hybrid depending on location, with only a modest two days a month expectationif you live near a hub.

You’ll Keep Growing

From advanced technical training to mentorship opportunities, we’re dedicated to helping you expand your impact.

Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an active FL or TX All‑Lines Adjuster License (CEs current) may qualify for a $2,500 sign‑on bonus.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage the investigation, evaluation, and resolution of complex auto and homeowner’s casualty claims.
  • Assess coverage, liability, and damages; recommend settlement strategies and escalate appropriately for authority review.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Collaborate closely with trial counsel; attend mediations, arbitrations, trials, hearings, and conferences.
  • Prepare detailed litigation and trial reports for local management and Home Office.
  • Communicate effectively with policyholders, witnesses, attorneys, and claimants to gather information and provide guidance.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports.
  • Maintain accurate reserves, recommending increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Safeguard financial and confidential information across all claim files.
  • Oversee billing practices of outside and in‑house counsel to ensure compliance and cost efficiency.
  • May assist as a resource to the team, stepping in for the Claims Team Manager when needed or mentoring colleagues; or representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • Participate in special projects at the direction of leadership.

What You Bring -Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, high‑stakes environment
  • Professionalism, empathy, and exceptional communication skills

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote. Candidates located in the Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in the Mountain and Pacific Timeregions.

Chandler, AZ

Clifton Park, NY

Columbus, OH
Indianapolis, IN
Lake Mary, FL
Liberty Lake, WA
Marlton, NJ
Plano, TX
Suwanee, GA
Warrenville, IL

Westborough, MA

Travel: 10% for mediations, arbitrations, trials, or in‑person events.

Training That Sets You Up for Success

Your growth begins on day one. Active engagement and reliable attendance during training are mandatory and crucial to your success in this high‑impact role.

About the Role

Agency Distribution Solutions (ADS) is seeking a motivated and customer-focused Product Owner I / Product Owner II to help deliver innovative digital products and platform capabilities that power Comparion Insurance Agency and Liberty Mutual Insurance Agency (LMIA). The Product Owner has a deep understanding of customer problems, translates them into actionable product requirements, and ensures Agile teams remain focused on delivering the highest-value outcomes.

This is an excellent opportunity for a developing product professional who is passionate about technology, customer experience, collaboration, and continuous improvement while gaining exposure to strategic products supporting agency growth and modernization.

Lead With Expertise. Deliver Impact That Matters. Grow With a Company That Invests in You.

At Liberty Mutual, we show up for people in their toughest moments, and we show up for our employees with the same commitment. We are currently seeking a Senior Claims Resolution Specialist for our Complex Casualty Team in the Central Region. We are looking for someone who brings deep technical expertise, sharp critical thinking, and a passion for doing what’s right.

If you’re energized by the challenge of managing high‑exposure, complex, and catastrophic injury claims, and you want to work in an environment where professionalism, integrity, and empathy guide everything we do, this is the role for you.

🌟 What Makes This Role Special

You Own the Complex Work

You’ll be the point person on severe and catastrophic auto and homeowner’s casualty claims, navigating litigation, partnering with counsel, and driving strategy.

Your Expertise Is Valued

Your judgment plays a key role in shaping outcomes. You’ll influence decisions on some of our most significant claims, backed by leaders who respect your experience.

Flexibility Meets Purpose

This role is remote or hybrid depending on location, with only a modest two days a month expectationif you live near a hub.

You’ll Keep Growing

From advanced technical training to mentorship opportunities, we’re dedicated to helping you expand your impact.

Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an active FL or TX All‑Lines Adjuster License (CEs current) may qualify for a $2,500 sign‑on bonus.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage the investigation, evaluation, and resolution of complex auto and homeowner’s casualty claims.
  • Assess coverage, liability, and damages; recommend settlement strategies and escalate appropriately for authority review.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Collaborate closely with trial counsel; attend mediations, arbitrations, trials, hearings, and conferences.
  • Prepare detailed litigation and trial reports for local management and Home Office.
  • Communicate effectively with policyholders, witnesses, attorneys, and claimants to gather information and provide guidance.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports.
  • Maintain accurate reserves, recommending increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Safeguard financial and confidential information across all claim files.
  • Oversee billing practices of outside and in‑house counsel to ensure compliance and cost efficiency.
  • May assist as a resource to the team, stepping in for the Claims Team Manager when needed or mentoring colleagues; or representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • Participate in special projects at the direction of leadership.

What You Bring -Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, high‑stakes environment
  • Professionalism, empathy, and exceptional communication skills

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote. Candidates located in the Eastern,Central, or Mountain time zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in thoseregions.

Your growth begins on day one. Active engagement and reliable attendance during training are mandatory and crucial to your success in this high‑impact role.

jobs.excerpt: EdOpsSchool Finance ManagerEdOps’s School Finance Manager position is ideal for school finance leaders ready to bring their expertise to a portfolio of schools and shape our nationwide finance offering alongside committed and experienced finance peers.
jobs.description:
EdOpsSchool Finance Manager

EdOps’s School Finance Manager position is ideal for school finance leaders ready to bring their expertise to a portfolio of schools and shape our nationwide finance offering alongside committed and experienced finance peers.

The School Finance Manager serves a portfolio of 5-8 schools, acting as those schools’ outsourced CFOs. Like on-staff CFOs, they leverage team members to analyze backwards-looking financial data and deliver strategic financial advice aligned with their schools’ mission and goals, build relationships with school leaders and boards, proactively notice and solve client problems, and generally act as key members of clients’ leadership teams. Internally, School Finance Managers drive innovations to our products, and the development and refinement of best practices when it comes to school finance.

Reports to Finance Director or above. Location flexible (this is a remote position). Part time arrangements possible for exceptional candidates.

Who we are:

EdOps is a B-Corp which partners with schools to provide expert support in finance, accounting, and student data management, helping education leaders make informed decisions while minimizing the financial, operational, and compliance burdens of running a school. Simply put, we make it easier for school leaders to increase student achievement. Our experience working with a wide range of schools – from newly authorized charter schools to independent schools with century-long histories, and from microschools to multi-campus networks – allows us to provide high-quality finance, accounting, and student data support across diverse educational environments.

Our team of over 100 professionals currently serves over 100 independent and public charter schools and networks across D.C., Louisiana, Maryland, Missouri, Michigan, New Jersey, and New York. We are serious about being the best possible partners to schools, and it shows in our 93% annual client retention rate. We work hard at being a rewarding, enjoyable workplace where staff can grow professionally and make an impact. We are looking for education focused, accounting and finance loving, collaborative people to join our team.

What you will do:

  • Act as an outsourced CFO for a portfolio of 5-8 schools, advising these schools’ leaders and Boards on matters pertaining to financial and operational policies, strategic decisions, and long-term financial planning.
  • Produce forward-looking financial forecasts, set budgets, and lead finance strategy development in a way that aligns with school goals and reflects EdOps’s commitment to equity and anti-racism.
  • Attend finance committee or board meetings to present and explain finance strategy.
  • Analyze, model, and solve problems on a wide range of business issues.
  • Engage in client listening and endeavor to proactively identify and solve clients’ financial challenges - either directly, or through engaging other teams at EdOps.
  • Provide development and informal oversight to School Finance Specialists and School Finance Analysts on school-specific processes. (For clarity, Finance Specialists and Finance Analysts report to dedicated People Managers; this position’s oversight of their work is relatively informal.)
  • Actively contribute to EdOps’s internal research, development and innovation of our finance product.

What you will accomplish:

  • By Year 1 you will have:
    • Solve small, real problems for schools on a daily basis.
    • Advise school leaders on nuanced, long term strategic financial decisions (i.e., facilities projects, staffing models, school expansion).
    • Develop close, trusting partnership with C-Level school leadership which will allow you to provide the best advice and support.
    • Present important financial information to a school’s Board of Directors.
    • Sharpen you expertise in strategic school finance, from multi-year budget development to internal process refinement
    • Work with 5-8 schools in different stages of growth and with different academic models.
  • By Year 3 you will have:
    • Contribute to the development and refinement of EdOps’s standard finance product, as well as our suite of best practices.
    • Lead project-based or market development work beyond your school portfolio..
    • Continue to solve real problems, small and large, for schools every day.

Who you are:

  • Care about education and outcomes for students as much as you care about budgets, forecasts and efficient financial processes.
  • Find joy in solving financial problems for individual schools. The little things make schools actually work.
  • Able to zoom in and out between high level strategic perspective and detailed, daily financial work.
  • Desire to be involved in the financial processes from input to analysis. We are outsourced CFOs but sometimes we are also controllers, accountants, and everything in between.
  • Strong in independent problem solving. We are a very collaborative community that supports each other, but our School Finance Managers are independent and solve new problems every day.
  • Energized by being in a customer service role. We are here first and foremost to serve our school clients.
  • Committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Open to learning and growing in these areas together so that each of us can contribute to building a culture of equity and support our schools in advancing these values. Please see more on EdOps' commitment here.

What you need:

  • Experience excelling in a School Finance Management role (i.e., led finance function for a school, led part of a finance function in larger school organization)
  • Experience as part of a School Leadership Team or working very closely with a School Leadership Team.
  • Comfort with accounting. A CPA or extensive expertise is not required, but experience navigating accounting software and reading and analyzing financial reports is a must.
  • Intermediate Excel knowledge, such as formulas like vlookups and sumifs, because Excel will be your best friend at times.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable with all diagnostic interpretations including STAT/ER cases and will play a key role in supporting emergency and inpatient imaging needs during overnight hours. The case mix includes CT, MRI, ultrasound, and plain films from busy emergency departments and inpatient services, offering a dynamic and engaging overnight workflow. Radiologists in this role benefit from optimized worklists and balanced case distribution designed to promote efficiency and minimize unnecessary interruptions during overnight shifts.

The position also leverages Radiology Partners’ Mosaic AI Operating System, an advanced technology platform that uses artificial intelligence and workflow automation to prioritize studies, improve turnaround times, and reduce administrative burden so radiologists can focus on high-quality diagnostic interpretation.

The city’s public transit makes commuting a breeze, while O'Hare and Midway airports connect residents to global destinations. If you're looking for a city with a welcoming atmosphere, affordable cost of living, and endless opportunities for fun and exploration, Chicago is a perfect choice!

Position Description & Requirements

Position Summary

Radiology Associates of Florida is excited to announce an exciting opportunity for a Neuroradiologist to join our expending remote division. This role offers a Monday-to-Friday schedule with typical day shift hours, and participation in our monthly tumor board conference series an average of once a month. We have crafted this role to have the convenience of a teleradiologist position with the stability, teamwork and quality of a premier hybrid academic-private practice. There is also a $50K Commencement Bonus! While you will have the convenience of working from home, you will develop a relationship with your referring physicians and radiologist colleagues as you service a limited set of clients rather than a sprawling network across multiple time zones. This team of radiologists will work together, so no single radiologist will be working without support.

This role will require a neuroradiologist who is comfortable handling a diverse range of cases, with approximately 70% of clinical reads focused on neuroradiology. This role will provide expert analysis and support for emergency and general diagnostic imaging, as well as collaborating with neurosurgeons to review and interpret imaging related to pre-operative planning, intra-operative assessments, and post-operative evaluations and well as analyzing neuroimaging studies for oncology patients, including tumor detection, staging, and monitoring of treatment response.

We enjoy a state-of-the-art unified PACS software suite that aggregates all of our sites onto one smart worklist, which distributes cases intelligently based on your workload and areas of expertise. Built into PACS are convenient collaboration tools that make it as easy to share cases and consult with colleagues remotely as it would be in a communal reading room. There are also built-in communication tools to reach our 24/7 radiology assistant concierges and IT support, minimizing your need to pick up the phone. We also have a growing suite of artificial intelligence support tools to automatically handle repetitive tasks like searching for evidence-based guidelines, and free access to point-of-care decision support solutions.

We offer competitive pay with bonus opportunities and abundant 100%-voluntary per-click moonlighting on your off weeks. Expect a full suite of benefits and pre-tax salary deductions for education and business expenses. Additionally, we offer 10 weeks of PTO to partners. Our dedicated staff will handle all licensing and credentialing needs.

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW

RAF is a leading radiology practice in Florida. We serve the most prestigious, established health systems in the state, including on the east and west coasts, the Florida Panhandle, and the Keys. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibility in study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at the cutting edge, encouraging subspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, and facilitating collaboration and consultation between our radiologists. Our state-of-the-art IT suite includes universal PACS across the practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders. We are the teaching physicians for the University of South Florida Department of Radiology in Tampa. In Sarasota, our physicians’ staff the Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists work and socialize together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to know us better!

Get to know our practice!

jobs.description:
IT@JH Financial Systems is seeking a Developerwho will support administrative departments and business units, including HR, Finance, Payroll, and shared services, that rely on the ServiceNow platform for case management and service delivery. The position focuses on supporting platform configuration and enhancements, working within ServiceNow and integrated enterprise systems rather than managing end user devices such as laptops or mobile hardware. Assignments are a mix of ticket-based work (e.g., configuration updates, defect resolution, access requests) and task level contributions to project-based initiatives, such as new service onboarding and workflow automation. The role operates under close to moderate supervision, collaborating with senior developers, project management, and business stakeholders while following established service management processes, development standards, and release practices.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

  • The responsibilities listed below are typical examples of the work performed by this position.
  • Not all duties assigned to this position are included, nor is it expected that everyone in this position will be assigned every job responsibility.

Analysis & Requirements Gathering

  • Under direct supervision support business/clinical/education problems by meeting with clients and more Sr. IT colleagues to observe and understand current processes and the issues related to those processes. Contribute to written documentation of findings to share with the client and other IT colleagues.
  • Review system requirements by meeting with clients and Sr. IT colleagues and researching existing technology to understand the business requirements for new applications.

Design & Development

  • Contribute to the development of detailed tasks by analyzing project scope and milestones for projects in order to ensure product is delivered in a timely fashion according to software lifecycle standards.
  • Contribute to functional/technical specifications by reviewing the provided system requirements, assist with putting them into functional and technical descriptions for use by programmers and business analysts to develop technical solutions.
  • Assist with the development/change of data input, files/database structures, data transformation, algorithms, and data output by using appropriate computer language/tools to provide technical solution for application development tasks.
  • Assist with documentation of code and associated processes by adhering to development methodologies, adding code comments and appropriate documentation to various knowledge-based system(s) to simplify code maintenance and to improve the support.

Testing & Documentation

  • Assist with the creation and documentation of test scenarios using the appropriate testing tools to validate and verify application functionality.
  • Assist with the testing of all changes by using the appropriate test scenarios to ensure all delivered solutions work as expected and errors are handled in a meaningful way.
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of documentation by writing audience-appropriate materials to serve as technical and/or end-user references.

Implementation & Maintenance

  • Assist with the Implementation of changes by adhering to the change management policies and procedures for any given project to communicate to all parties the nature, significance, and risk factors of the solution.
  • Assist in the monitoring of changes and resolution of problems by responding to problems as they occur, by reviewing all processing and output of the newly implemented solution, and by proactively ensuring the solution works successfully to satisfy the customer requirements and to provide a smooth transition to the new solution.
  • Provide support by triaging and resolving issues to ensure prompt, effective service.
  • Other duties as assigned.

In Addition to the Duties Described Above

  • Configure and maintain ServiceNow record producers, workflows, and case management structures.
  • Support and troubleshoot platform enhancements, defects, and configuration updates.
  • Assist with integrations and data workflows (e.g., TalkDesk, Workday, SAP) including testing and validation.
  • Perform Move/Add/Change (MAC) requests across supported services and modules.
  • Contribute to identity and access configuration, including SSO and role mapping.
  • Participate in testing, UAT support, and go live readiness activities.
  • Support hypercare and ongoing platform operations, including documentation and Knowledge updates.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • No prior professional experience required.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

Join us in fostering a collaborative environment where your skills and ideas will help drive strategic decision-making and long-term growth. Reporting directly to the Associate Director of Finance for Central IT, this role is integral to the efficient financial management of a diverse IT portfolio. This position performs complex analysis and planning to assist management in establishing and controlling budgets, setting financial goals, making projections and meeting fiscal objectives. Performs activities in support of various functions, e.g., budgeting, financial planning, revenue and expenditure monitoring against budget, reconciliations and changes, and consolidation. Extracts financial data from various accounting and information systems and generates reports. Performs complex statistical cost and financial analysis of reports and data and prepares reports for management to improve financial performance and compliance. Provides data-based recommendations on critical financial business decisions.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

Review financial needs and explore alternative financing methods.

  • Keep abreast of laws and regulations that impact compliance and act as a resource for administrative and financial staff.

IT@JH Research Computing is seeking a HPC Scientific Software Engineer to support faculty, researchers, and students engaged in high-performance and AI-driven research across Johns Hopkins University. The position is responsible for deploying, optimizing, and maintaining scientific software and computational workflows on advanced HPC Systems and related infrastructure. Working primarily within Linux-based environments, the engineer manages and troubleshoots complex software stacks, containerized applications, and GPU-accelerated workloads using tools such as SLURM, Easy build, Spack, etc. The role combines ticket-based user support with long-term project work, collaborating closely with interdisciplinary research groups to enhance system performance, streamline data-intensive workflows, and integrate cutting-edge technologies. The position operates with significant independence while coordinating regularly with systems engineers and research computing leadership to ensure reliable, high-efficiency computing resources that advance the university’s scientific mission.

Software Deployment and Design (15%)

  • Develop and refine deployment strategies for scientific software on HPC and AI systems.
  • Design computational workflows, selecting optimal software configurations, and utilizing tools like Ansible for automation.
  • Assist teams in implementing, tuning, and optimizing AI models and gateway applications (e.g., XDMoD, Coldfront, Open OnDemand, CryoSPARC Live, SBGrid, AI Agents).

Performance Optimization (20%)

  • Analyze and optimize the performance of AI models and HPC applications, focusing on GPU-enabled computing.
  • Implement parallel processing, distributed computing, and resource management techniques for efficient job execution.

Integration and Optimization (15%)

  • Develop, debug, and maintain software tools, libraries, and frameworks supporting HPC and AI workloads.
  • Collaborate with the system team and software vendors (e.g., NVIDIA, Intel, Matlab) to optimize systems for maximum performance.
  • Utilize CUDA, DNN, TensorRT, and Intel Compilers to enhance system performance.

HPC Scientific Software Support (30%)

  • Manage and support scientific software deployment across HPC, cloud-based, and colocation facilities.
  • Oversee installation, configuration, and maintenance of HPC packages with tools like CMake, Make, EasyBuild, Spack, and Lua module files.

Collaboration and Mentorship (5%)

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including researchers, data scientists, and software developers, to address complex HPC/AI challenges.
  • Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of continuous learning.

Technical Support and Training Workshops and Troubleshooting (15%)

  • Resolve complex technical issues and perform root cause analysis for HPC/AI software challenges.
  • Implement effective solutions to prevent recurrence and improve system reliability
  • Provide training workshops for researchers and students, focusing on troubleshooting, optimizing workflows, and effectively using HPC systems.

Learning and Development (5%)

  • Stay current with advances in HPC and AI technologies and methodologies.
  • Incorporate new research findings into existing systems to improve performance and capabilities.

Container Orchestration (5%)

  • Develop and manage container orchestration strategies to ensure scalability, reliability, and security of applications.
  • Oversee the container lifecycle from creation and deployment to scaling and removal.

Documentation and Compliance (5%)

  • Create comprehensive documentation for system designs, performance metrics, and project status.
  • Ensure compliance with security and regulatory standards for all HPC and AI systems.

Other duties as assigned.



Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience in scientific computing environments and applications.
  • Hands-on experience with SLURM, for job scheduling.
